name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_apply_mem
statement:
theorem card_filter_apply_mem [DecidableEq α] {s D : Finset α} (hD : D ⊆ s) {n : ℕ}
    (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ((Fintype.piFinset fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ s).filter fun x ↦ x j ∈ D).card
      = D.card * s.card ^ n

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_exists_apply_mem_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_exists_apply_mem_le [DecidableEq α] {s D : Finset α} (hD : D ⊆ s) (n : ℕ) :
    ((Fintype.piFinset fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ s).filter fun x ↦ ∃ i, x i ∈ D).card
      ≤ (n + 1) * D.card * s.card ^ n

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_piFinset_one
statement:
theorem card_filter_piFinset_one (A : Fin 1 → Finset α) (R : (Fin 1 → α) → Prop)
    [DecidablePred R] :
    ((Fintype.piFinset A).filter R).card = ((A 0).filter fun a ↦ R ![a]).card

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_piFinset_two
statement:
theorem card_filter_piFinset_two [DecidableEq α] (A : Fin 2 → Finset α)
    (R : (Fin 2 → α) → Prop) [DecidablePred R] :
    ((Fintype.piFinset A).filter R).card =
      ((A 0 ×ˢ A 1).filter fun p => R ![p.1, p.2]).card

name: RegularityLemmata.card_piFinset_one
statement:
theorem card_piFinset_one (A : Fin 1 → Finset α) :
    (Fintype.piFinset A).card = (A 0).card

name: RegularityLemmata.card_piFinset_two
statement:
theorem card_piFinset_two (A : Fin 2 → Finset α) :
    (Fintype.piFinset A).card = (A 0).card * (A 1).card

name: RegularityLemmata.filter_piFinset_two_image
statement:
theorem filter_piFinset_two_image [DecidableEq α] (A : Fin 2 → Finset α)
    (R : (Fin 2 → α) → Prop) [DecidablePred R] :
    ((Fintype.piFinset A).filter R).image (finTwoArrowEquiv α) =
      (A 0 ×ˢ A 1).filter fun p => R ![p.1, p.2]

name: RegularityLemmata.finTwoArrowEquiv_lowerFace
statement:
@[simp] theorem finTwoArrowEquiv_lowerFace (v : Fin 3 → α) (i : Fin 3) :
    finTwoArrowEquiv α (lowerFace v i) = (v (i.succAbove 0), v (i.succAbove 1))

name: RegularityLemmata.finTwoArrowEquiv_lowerFace_one
statement:
theorem finTwoArrowEquiv_lowerFace_one (v : Fin 3 → α) :
    finTwoArrowEquiv α (lowerFace v 1) = (v 0, v 2)

name: RegularityLemmata.finTwoArrowEquiv_lowerFace_two
statement:
theorem finTwoArrowEquiv_lowerFace_two (v : Fin 3 → α) :
    finTwoArrowEquiv α (lowerFace v 2) = (v 0, v 1)

name: RegularityLemmata.finTwoArrowEquiv_lowerFace_zero
statement:
theorem finTwoArrowEquiv_lowerFace_zero (v : Fin 3 → α) :
    finTwoArrowEquiv α (lowerFace v 0) = (v 1, v 2)

name: RegularityLemmata.image_finTwoArrowEquiv_piFinset
statement:
theorem image_finTwoArrowEquiv_piFinset [DecidableEq α] (A : Fin 2 → Finset α) :
    (Fintype.piFinset A).image (finTwoArrowEquiv α) = A 0 ×ˢ A 1

name: RegularityLemmata.lowerFace_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem lowerFace_apply {j : ℕ} (v : Fin (j + 1) → α) (i : Fin (j + 1)) (k : Fin j) :
    lowerFace v i k = v (i.succAbove k)

name: RegularityLemmata.lowerFace_injective
statement:
theorem lowerFace_injective {j : ℕ} {v : Fin (j + 1) → α} (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (i : Fin (j + 1)) : Function.Injective (lowerFace v i)

name: RegularityLemmata.mem_map_finTwoArrowEquiv
statement:
theorem mem_map_finTwoArrowEquiv (P : Finset (Fin 2 → α)) (w : Fin 2 → α) :
    finTwoArrowEquiv α w ∈ P.map (finTwoArrowEquiv α).toEmbedding ↔ w ∈ P

name: RegularityLemmata.succAbove_faces_three
statement:
theorem succAbove_faces_three :
    ((0 : Fin 3).succAbove 0 = 1 ∧ (0 : Fin 3).succAbove 1 = 2) ∧
    ((1 : Fin 3).succAbove 0 = 0 ∧ (1 : Fin 3).succAbove 1 = 2) ∧
    ((2 : Fin 3).succAbove 0 = 0 ∧ (2 : Fin 3).succAbove 1 = 1)

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_piFinset_succAbove
statement:
theorem sum_piFinset_succAbove {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] {n : ℕ}
    (A : Fin (n + 1) → Finset α) (j : Fin (n + 1)) (f : (Fin (n + 1) → α) → M) :
    ∑ w ∈ Fintype.piFinset A, f w
      = ∑ rest ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun i ↦ A (j.succAbove i)), ∑ b ∈ A j,
          f (Fin.insertNth j b rest)

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_densityOn_sub_densityOn_le
statement:
theorem abs_densityOn_sub_densityOn_le :
    |densityOn S p - densityOn S q| ≤ densityOn S fun x => ¬(p x ↔ q x)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_le_of_densityOn_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_le_of_densityOn_le (h : densityOn S p ≤ c) :
    ((S.filter p).card : ℝ) ≤ c * S.card

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_le_of_tupleDensity_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_le_of_tupleDensity_le {c : ℝ} (h : tupleDensity R A ≤ c) :
    (tupleCount R A : ℝ) ≤ c * ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_mono_subset
statement:
theorem card_filter_mono_subset (p : β → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (h : S ⊆ T) :
    (S.filter p).card ≤ (T.filter p).card

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_product_le_of_tupleDensity_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_product_le_of_tupleDensity_le {c : ℝ} (h : tupleDensity R₂ A₂ ≤ c) :
    (((A₂ 0 ×ˢ A₂ 1).filter fun p => R₂ ![p.1, p.2]).card : ℝ)
      ≤ c * (((A₂ 0).card : ℝ) * (A₂ 1).card)

name: RegularityLemmata.densityOn_add_not
statement:
theorem densityOn_add_not (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    densityOn S p + densityOn S (fun x => ¬ p x) = 1

name: RegularityLemmata.densityOn_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem densityOn_empty : densityOn (∅ : Finset β) p = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.densityOn_le_one
statement: theorem densityOn_le_one : densityOn S p ≤ 1

name: RegularityLemmata.densityOn_mono_pred
statement: theorem densityOn_mono_pred (h : ∀ x ∈ S, p x → q x) : densityOn S p ≤ densityOn S q

name: RegularityLemmata.densityOn_mul_card
statement:
theorem densityOn_mul_card (S : Finset β) (p : β → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    densityOn S p * (S.card : ℝ) = ((S.filter p).card : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.densityOn_nonneg
statement: theorem densityOn_nonneg : 0 ≤ densityOn S p

name: RegularityLemmata.densityOn_not
statement:
theorem densityOn_not (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    densityOn S (fun x => ¬ p x) = 1 - densityOn S p

name: RegularityLemmata.le_card_filter_of_le_densityOn
statement:
theorem le_card_filter_of_le_densityOn (h : c ≤ densityOn S p) :
    c * S.card ≤ ((S.filter p).card : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.le_card_filter_of_le_tupleDensity
statement:
theorem le_card_filter_of_le_tupleDensity {c : ℝ} (h : c ≤ tupleDensity R A) :
    c * ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ) ≤ (tupleCount R A : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.le_card_filter_product_of_le_tupleDensity
statement:
theorem le_card_filter_product_of_le_tupleDensity {c : ℝ} (h : c ≤ tupleDensity R₂ A₂) :
    c * (((A₂ 0).card : ℝ) * (A₂ 1).card)
      ≤ (((A₂ 0 ×ˢ A₂ 1).filter fun p => R₂ ![p.1, p.2]).card : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.sq_densityOn_mul_card
statement:
theorem sq_densityOn_mul_card (S : Finset β) (p : β → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    densityOn S p ^ 2 * (S.card : ℝ) = ((S.filter p).card : ℝ) ^ 2 / (S.card : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleCount_add_neg
statement:
theorem tupleCount_add_neg :
    tupleCount R A + tupleCount (fun x ↦ ¬ R x) A = (Fintype.piFinset A).card

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleCount_eq_tupleDensity_mul
statement:
theorem tupleCount_eq_tupleDensity_mul :
    (tupleCount R A : ℝ) = tupleDensity R A * ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleCount_le_card
statement: theorem tupleCount_le_card : tupleCount R A ≤ (Fintype.piFinset A).card

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleCount_mono
statement: theorem tupleCount_mono (h : ∀ i, A' i ⊆ A i) : tupleCount R A' ≤ tupleCount R A

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_add_neg
statement:
theorem tupleDensity_add_neg (hne : ∀ i, (A i).Nonempty) :
    tupleDensity R A + tupleDensity (fun x => ¬ R x) A = 1

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_eq_count_div
statement:
theorem tupleDensity_eq_count_div :
    tupleDensity R A = (tupleCount R A : ℝ) / (Fintype.piFinset A).card

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_eq_zero_of_box_empty
statement:
theorem tupleDensity_eq_zero_of_box_empty (h : Fintype.piFinset A = ∅) :
    tupleDensity R A = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_eq_zero_of_side_empty
statement: theorem tupleDensity_eq_zero_of_side_empty {i : ι} (hi : A i = ∅) : tupleDensity R A = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_le_one
statement: theorem tupleDensity_le_one : tupleDensity R A ≤ 1

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_neg
statement:
theorem tupleDensity_neg (hne : ∀ i, (A i).Nonempty) :
    tupleDensity (fun x => ¬ R x) A = 1 - tupleDensity R A

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_nonneg
statement: theorem tupleDensity_nonneg : 0 ≤ tupleDensity R A

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_one_eq
statement:
theorem tupleDensity_one_eq {A : Fin 1 → Finset α} {R : (Fin 1 → α) → Prop} [DecidablePred R] :
    tupleDensity R A = densityOn (A 0) fun a ↦ R ![a]

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_two_eq
statement:
theorem tupleDensity_two_eq :
    tupleDensity R₂ A₂ =
      (((A₂ 0 ×ˢ A₂ 1).filter fun p => R₂ ![p.1, p.2]).card : ℝ)
        / (((A₂ 0).card : ℝ) * (A₂ 1).card)

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_mul_mul_sub_mul_mul_le
RegularityLemmata.abs_mul_sub_mul_le
statement:
theorem abs_mul_sub_mul_le {x y d e : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ 1) (he : |e| ≤ 1) :
    |x * y - d * e| ≤ |x - d| + |y - e|

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_sum_bilinear_le
RegularityLemmata.engel_defect_lower
statement:
theorem engel_defect_lower {a b p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q) :
    (a + b) ^ 2 / (p + q) + p * (a / p - (a + b) / (p + q)) ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2 / p + b ^ 2 / q

name: RegularityLemmata.exp_neg_le_one_sub_add_sq_half
statement:
theorem exp_neg_le_one_sub_add_sq_half {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    Real.exp (-x) ≤ 1 - x + x ^ 2 / 2

name: RegularityLemmata.sq_sum_mul_le_sum_mul_sum_sq_mul
statement:
theorem sq_sum_mul_le_sum_mul_sum_sq_mul {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (a m : ι → ℝ)
    (I : Finset ι) (hm : ∀ i ∈ I, 0 ≤ m i) :
    (∑ i ∈ I, a i * m i) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i ∈ I, m i) * ∑ i ∈ I, a i ^ 2 * m i

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_filter_neg_le_sum_mul
statement:
theorem sum_filter_neg_le_sum_mul {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {c : ι → ℝ} (I : Finset ι)
    (hc0 : ∀ i ∈ I, 0 ≤ c i) (hc1 : ∀ i ∈ I, c i ≤ 1) (y : ι → ℝ) :
    ∑ i ∈ I.filter (fun i => y i < 0), y i ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, c i * y i

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_mul_le_sum_filter_nonneg
statement:
theorem sum_mul_le_sum_filter_nonneg {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {c : ι → ℝ} (I : Finset ι)
    (hc0 : ∀ i ∈ I, 0 ≤ c i) (hc1 : ∀ i ∈ I, c i ≤ 1) (y : ι → ℝ) :
    ∑ i ∈ I, c i * y i ≤ ∑ i ∈ I.filter (fun i => 0 ≤ y i), y i

name: RegularityLemmata.titu_finset
statement:
theorem titu_finset {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (f g : ι → ℝ) (I : Finset ι)
    (hg : ∀ i ∈ I, 0 ≤ g i) (hfg : ∀ i ∈ I, g i = 0 → f i = 0) :
    (∑ i ∈ I, f i) ^ 2 / (∑ i ∈ I, g i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, f i ^ 2 / g i

name: RegularityLemmata.titu_three
statement:
theorem titu_three {a b c p q r : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (ha : p = 0 → a = 0) (hb : q = 0 → b = 0) (hc : r = 0 → c = 0) :
    (a + b + c) ^ 2 / (p + q + r) ≤ a ^ 2 / p + b ^ 2 / q + c ^ 2 / r

name: RegularityLemmata.titu_two
statement:
theorem titu_two {a b p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (ha : p = 0 → a = 0) (hb : q = 0 → b = 0) :
    (a + b) ^ 2 / (p + q) ≤ a ^ 2 / p + b ^ 2 / q

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_sub_finsetMass_le
RegularityLemmata.exists_pos_of_finsetMass_pos
statement:
theorem exists_pos_of_finsetMass_pos (hw : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ w x) (h : 0 < finsetMass w A) :
    ∃ x ∈ A, 0 < w x

name: RegularityLemmata.finsetMass_add
statement:
theorem finsetMass_add (w w' : X → ℝ) (A : Finset X) :
    finsetMass (fun x => w x + w' x) A = finsetMass w A + finsetMass w' A

name: RegularityLemmata.finsetMass_biUnion
RegularityLemmata.finsetMass_biUnion_le
statement:
theorem finsetMass_biUnion_le [DecidableEq X] {w : X → ℝ} {κ : Type*} [DecidableEq κ]
    {s : Finset κ} {t : κ → Finset X} (hw : ∀ x ∈ s.biUnion t, 0 ≤ w x) :
    finsetMass w (s.biUnion t) ≤ ∑ k ∈ s, finsetMass w (t k)

name: RegularityLemmata.finsetMass_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem finsetMass_empty (w : X → ℝ) : finsetMass w ∅ = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.finsetMass_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
statement: theorem finsetMass_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero (h : ∀ x ∈ A, w x = 0) : finsetMass w A = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.finsetMass_mono
statement:
theorem finsetMass_mono (hw : ∀ x ∈ B, 0 ≤ w x) (h : A ⊆ B) :
    finsetMass w A ≤ finsetMass w B

name: RegularityLemmata.finsetMass_nonneg
statement: theorem finsetMass_nonneg (hw : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ w x) : 0 ≤ finsetMass w A

name: RegularityLemmata.finsetMass_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem finsetMass_one (A : Finset X) :
    finsetMass (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) A = (A.card : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.finsetMass_smul
statement:
theorem finsetMass_smul (c : ℝ) (w : X → ℝ) (A : Finset X) :
    finsetMass (fun x => c * w x) A = c * finsetMass w A

name: RegularityLemmata.finsetMass_union_le
statement:
theorem finsetMass_union_le [DecidableEq X] {w : X → ℝ} {A B : Finset X}
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ A ∪ B, 0 ≤ w x) : finsetMass w (A ∪ B) ≤ finsetMass w A + finsetMass w B

name: RegularityLemmata.finsetMass_union_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem finsetMass_union_of_disjoint [DecidableEq X] (w : X → ℝ) (h : Disjoint A B) :
    finsetMass w (A ∪ B) = finsetMass w A + finsetMass w B

name: RegularityLemmata.relMass_le_one
statement:
theorem relMass_le_one [DecidableEq X] {C : Finset X} (hw : ∀ x ∈ C, 0 ≤ w x)
    (S : Finset X) : relMass w S C ≤ 1

name: RegularityLemmata.relMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem relMass_nonneg [DecidableEq X] {C : Finset X} (hw : ∀ x ∈ C, 0 ≤ w x)
    (S : Finset X) : 0 ≤ relMass w S C

name: RegularityLemmata.relMass_self_of_pos
statement:
theorem relMass_self_of_pos [DecidableEq X] {C : Finset X} (h : 0 < finsetMass w C) :
    relMass w C C = 1

name: RegularityLemmata.weightedSum_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem weightedSum_empty (w : X → ℝ) (f : X → ℝ) : weightedSum w ∅ f = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.weightedSum_one
statement:
theorem weightedSum_one (w : X → ℝ) (A : Finset X) :
    weightedSum w A (fun _ => 1) = finsetMass w A

RegularityLemmata.RectKernel.op_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem RectKernel.op_apply (f : RectKernel X Y) (y : Y) (x : X) :
    f.op y x = f x y

name: RegularityLemmata.RectKernel.op_op
statement: @[simp] theorem RectKernel.op_op (f : RectKernel X Y) : f.op.op = f

name: RegularityLemmata.RectKernel.pullback_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem RectKernel.pullback_apply (f : RectKernel X Y) (u : X' → X) (v : Y' → Y)
    (x : X') (y : Y') : f.pullback u v x y = f (u x) (v y)

name: RegularityLemmata.RectKernel.pullback_id
statement: @[simp] theorem RectKernel.pullback_id (f : RectKernel X Y) : f.pullback id id = f

name: RegularityLemmata.RectKernel.pullback_pullback
statement:
theorem RectKernel.pullback_pullback {X'' Y'' : Type*} (f : RectKernel X Y)
    (u : X' → X) (v : Y' → Y) (u' : X'' → X') (v' : Y'' → Y') :
    (f.pullback u v).pullback u' v' = f.pullback (u ∘ u') (v ∘ v')

name: RegularityLemmata.RectKernel.restrict_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem RectKernel.restrict_apply (f : RectKernel X Y) (A : Finset X) (B : Finset Y)
    (x : {x // x ∈ A}) (y : {y // y ∈ B}) : f.restrict A B x y = f x.val y.val

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_rectAverage_le
statement:
theorem abs_rectAverage_le {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x)
    (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) (hf : IsAbsBoundedOnRectangle f C A B) :
    |rectAverage f wX wY A B| ≤ C

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_rectAverage_le_inv_of_lt_abs_rectSum
statement:
theorem abs_rectAverage_le_inv_of_lt_abs_rectSum (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x)
    (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) {S : Finset X} {T : Finset Y} (hS : S ⊆ A) (hT : T ⊆ B) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hwit : ε * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B) < |rectSum f wX wY S T|)
    (hsq : rectSqMass f wX wY A B ≤ finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B) :
    |rectAverage f wX wY S T| ≤ 1 / ε

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_rectSum_le
statement:
theorem abs_rectSum_le {C : ℝ} (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)
    (hf : IsAbsBoundedOnRectangle f C A B) :
    |rectSum f wX wY A B| ≤ C * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B)

name: RegularityLemmata.finsetMass_mul_pos_of_lt_abs_rectSum
statement:
theorem finsetMass_mul_pos_of_lt_abs_rectSum (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x)
    (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) {S : Finset X} {T : Finset Y} (hS : S ⊆ A) (hT : T ⊆ B) {ε : ℝ}
    (hwit : ε * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B) < |rectSum f wX wY S T|) :
    0 < finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B

name: RegularityLemmata.rectAverage_const
statement:
theorem rectAverage_const (c : ℝ) (hA : 0 < finsetMass wX A) (hB : 0 < finsetMass wY B) :
    rectAverage (fun _ _ => c) wX wY A B = c

name: RegularityLemmata.rectAverage_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem rectAverage_mem_Icc {a b : ℝ} (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)
    (hA : 0 < finsetMass wX A) (hB : 0 < finsetMass wY B)

name: RegularityLemmata.rectAverage_mem_unitInterval
statement:
theorem rectAverage_mem_unitInterval (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)

name: RegularityLemmata.rectAverage_nonneg
statement:
theorem rectAverage_nonneg (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)

name: RegularityLemmata.rectAverage_op

name: RegularityLemmata.rectAverage_smul_weight_left
statement:
theorem rectAverage_smul_weight_left {c : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (f : RectKernel X Y)
    (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (A : Finset X) (B : Finset Y) :

name: RegularityLemmata.rectBlockEnergy_le_mass
statement:
theorem rectBlockEnergy_le_mass (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)

name: RegularityLemmata.rectBlockEnergy_le_rectSqMass

theorem rectBlockEnergy_le_rectSqMass (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :

name: RegularityLemmata.rectBlockEnergy_nonneg
statement:
theorem rectBlockEnergy_nonneg (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :

name: RegularityLemmata.rectBlockEnergy_op
statement:

theorem abs_averageOn_sub_averageOn_le_of_levelSets [DecidableEq α] {φ : α → ℝ}
    {A Q : Finset α} {β ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hQ : Q ⊆ A) (hQne : Q.Nonempty)
    (hrange : ∀ x ∈ A, φ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hlevels : ∀ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r → (r : ℝ) * ν ≤ 1 →
      |(((A.filter fun x ↦ (r : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x) ∩ Q).card : ℝ) / Q.card
        - ((A.filter fun x ↦ (r : ℝ) * ν ≤ φ x).card : ℝ) / A.card| ≤ β) :

name: RegularityLemmata.prefix_trichotomy
statement:
theorem prefix_trichotomy : ∀ x y : List Bool,
    x <+: y ∨ y <+: x ∨ ∃ (z : List Bool) (b : Bool), BranchBelow b z x ∧ BranchBelow (!b) z y
  | [], _ => Or.inl List.nil_prefix
  | _ :: _, [] => Or.inr (Or.inl List.nil_prefix)
  | a :: x, c :: y => by
      by_cases hac : a = c
      · subst hac
        rcases prefix_trichotomy x y with hp | hp | ⟨z, b, h1, h2⟩
        · exact Or.inl (List.cons_prefix_cons.mpr ⟨rfl, hp⟩)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (List.cons_prefix_cons.mpr ⟨rfl, hp⟩))
        · refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨a :: z, b, ?_, ?_⟩)
          · rw [BranchBelow, List.cons_append]
            exact List.cons_prefix_cons.mpr ⟨rfl, h1⟩
          · rw [BranchBelow, List.cons_append]
            exact List.cons_prefix_cons.mpr ⟨rfl, h2⟩
      · refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨[], a, ?_, ?_⟩)
        · rw [BranchBelow, List.nil_append]
          exact List.cons_prefix_cons.mpr ⟨rfl, List.nil_prefix⟩
        · have hb : (!a) = c

statement: theorem ext {e₁ e₂ : InternalEmbedding s t} (h : ∀ x, e₁ x = e₂ x) : e₁ = e₂

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.fork_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem fork_cons (x : InternalNode t) (f g : InternalEmbedding s t) (hf hg) (b : Bool)
    (y : InternalNode s) : fork x f g hf hg (consInternal b y) = bif b then g y else f y

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.fork_root
statement:
@[simp] theorem fork_root (x : InternalNode t) (f g : InternalEmbedding s t) (hf hg) :
    fork x f g hf hg (root s) = x

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.id_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem id_apply (x : InternalNode s) : id s x = x

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.id_comp
statement: @[simp] theorem id_comp (f : InternalEmbedding s t) : comp (id t) f = f

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.injective
statement: theorem injective (e : InternalEmbedding s t) : Function.Injective e

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.isStrictPrefix_preserved
statement:
theorem isStrictPrefix_preserved (e : InternalEmbedding s t) (x y : InternalNode s)
    (h : IsStrictPrefix x.1 y.1) : IsStrictPrefix (e x).1 (e y).1

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.singleton_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem singleton_apply (x : InternalNode t) (y : InternalNode 1) :
    singleton x y = x

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.extendProper_internal
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendProper_internal (e : InternalEmbedding s t) (x : InternalNode s) :
    (extendProper e).internal x = e x

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.extendProper_leaf_val
statement:
theorem extendProper_leaf_val (e : InternalEmbedding s t) (l : LeafNode s) (hl : l.1 ≠ []) :
    ((extendProper e).leaf l).1
      = padWordToLength t ((e (leafParent l hl)).1 ++ [l.1.getLast hl])

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.extendProper_leaf_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendProper_leaf_zero (e : InternalEmbedding 0 t) (l : LeafNode 0) :
    ((extendProper e).leaf l).1 = List.replicate t false

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.extendProper_toInternal
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendProper_toInternal (e : InternalEmbedding s t) :
    (extendProper e).toInternal = e

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.leafParent_append_getLast
statement:
theorem leafParent_append_getLast (l : LeafNode s) (hl : l.1 ≠ []) :
    (leafParent l hl).1 ++ [l.1.getLast hl] = l.1

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.leafParent_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem leafParent_val (l : LeafNode s) (hl : l.1 ≠ []) :
    (leafParent l hl).1 = l.1.dropLast

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.leafPrefix_length_le
statement:
theorem leafPrefix_length_le (e : InternalEmbedding s t) (l : LeafNode s) :
    (leafPrefix e l).length ≤ t

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.leafPrefix_of_ne_nil
statement:
theorem leafPrefix_of_ne_nil (e : InternalEmbedding s t) (l : LeafNode s) (hl : l.1 ≠ []) :
    leafPrefix e l = (e (leafParent l hl)).1 ++ [l.1.getLast hl]

name: RegularityLemmata.InternalEmbedding.leafPrefix_of_nil
statement:
@[simp] theorem leafPrefix_of_nil (e : InternalEmbedding s t) (l : LeafNode s) (hl : l.1 = []) :
    leafPrefix e l = []

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.branch_leaf_preserved
statement:
theorem branch_leaf_preserved (e : ProperEmbedding s t) (b : Bool) (x : InternalNode s)
    (l : LeafNode s) (h : BranchBelow b x.1 l.1) :
    BranchBelow b (e.internal x).1 (e.leaf l).1

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.comp_id
statement: @[simp] theorem comp_id (f : ProperEmbedding s t) : comp f (id s) = f

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.comp_internal
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_internal {u : ℕ} (g : ProperEmbedding t u) (f : ProperEmbedding s t)
    (x : InternalNode s) : (comp g f).internal x = g.internal (f.internal x)

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.comp_leaf
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_leaf {u : ℕ} (g : ProperEmbedding t u) (f : ProperEmbedding s t)
    (l : LeafNode s) : (comp g f).leaf l = g.leaf (f.leaf l)

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.ext
statement:
theorem ext {e₁ e₂ : ProperEmbedding s t} (hi : ∀ x, e₁.internal x = e₂.internal x)
    (hl : ∀ l, e₁.leaf l = e₂.leaf l) : e₁ = e₂

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.id_comp
statement: @[simp] theorem id_comp (f : ProperEmbedding s t) : comp (id t) f = f

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.id_internal
statement: @[simp] theorem id_internal (x : InternalNode s) : (id s).internal x = x

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.id_leaf
statement: @[simp] theorem id_leaf (l : LeafNode s) : (id s).leaf l = l

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.internal_injective
statement: theorem internal_injective (e : ProperEmbedding s t) : Function.Injective e.internal

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.internal_ne_leaf
statement:
theorem internal_ne_leaf (e : ProperEmbedding s t) (x : InternalNode s) (l : LeafNode s) :
    (e.internal x).1 ≠ (e.leaf l).1

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.leaf_injective
statement: theorem leaf_injective (e : ProperEmbedding s t) : Function.Injective e.leaf

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.length_internal
statement:
@[simp] theorem length_internal (e : ProperEmbedding s t) (x : InternalNode s) :
    (e.internal x).1.length < t

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.length_leaf
statement:
@[simp] theorem length_leaf (e : ProperEmbedding s t) (l : LeafNode s) :
    (e.leaf l).1.length = t

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.toInternal_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem toInternal_apply (e : ProperEmbedding s t) (x : InternalNode s) :
    e.toInternal x = e.internal x

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.toInternal_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem toInternal_comp {u : ℕ} (g : ProperEmbedding t u) (f : ProperEmbedding s t) :
    (comp g f).toInternal = InternalEmbedding.comp g.toInternal f.toInternal

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.toInternal_id
statement: @[simp] theorem toInternal_id (s : ℕ) : (id s).toInternal = InternalEmbedding.id s

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.vertex_injective
statement: theorem vertex_injective (e : ProperEmbedding s t) : Function.Injective e.vertex

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.vertex_of_internal
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertex_of_internal (e : ProperEmbedding s t) (x : InternalNode s) :
    e.vertex (internalToTree x) = internalToTree (e.internal x)

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.vertex_of_leaf
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertex_of_leaf (e : ProperEmbedding s t) (l : LeafNode s) :
    e.vertex (leafToTree l) = leafToTree (e.leaf l)

name: RegularityLemmata.ProperEmbedding.vertex_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertex_val (e : ProperEmbedding s t) (x : TreeNode s) :
    (e.vertex x).1
      = if h : x.1.length < s then (e.internal ⟨x.1, h⟩).1
        else (e.leaf ⟨x.1, le_antisymm x.2 (not_lt.mp h)⟩).1

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_properEmbedding_of_child_branches
statement:
theorem exists_properEmbedding_of_child_branches {s t : ℕ}
    (f : (x : List Bool) → x.length ≤ s → List Bool)
    (hint : ∀ x (hx : x.length < s), (f x (by omega)).length < t)
    (hstep : ∀ x (hx : x.length < s) b,
      ∃ w, f (x ++ [b]) (by simp; omega) = f x (by omega) ++ [b] ++ w) :
    ∃ e : ProperEmbedding s t, ∀ x : InternalNode s,
      (e.internal x).1 = f x.1 (by have := x.2; omega)

name: RegularityLemmata.padWordToLength_length
statement:
theorem padWordToLength_length {t : ℕ} {w : List Bool} (h : w.length ≤ t) :
    (padWordToLength t w).length = t

name: RegularityLemmata.padWordToLength_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem padWordToLength_nil (t : ℕ) : padWordToLength t [] = List.replicate t false

name: RegularityLemmata.prefix_padWordToLength
statement: theorem prefix_padWordToLength (t : ℕ) (w : List Bool) : w <+: padWordToLength t w

name: RegularityLemmata.binaryTreeRamsey
statement:
theorem binaryTreeRamsey (m : ℕ) (t : Fin m → ℕ)
    (color : InternalNode ((∑ i, t i) + 1) → Fin m) :
    ∃ (i : Fin m) (e : InternalEmbedding (t i + 1) ((∑ i, t i) + 1)),
      ∀ x, color (e x) = i

name: RegularityLemmata.binaryTreeRamsey_proper
statement:
theorem binaryTreeRamsey_proper (m : ℕ) (t : Fin m → ℕ)
    (color : InternalNode ((∑ i, t i) + 1) → Fin m) :
    ∃ (i : Fin m) (e : ProperEmbedding (t i + 1) ((∑ i, t i) + 1)),
      ∀ x, color (e.internal x) = i

name: RegularityLemmata.binaryTreeRamsey_proper_const
statement:
theorem binaryTreeRamsey_proper_const (m t : ℕ) (color : InternalNode (m * t + 1) → Fin m) :
    ∃ (c : Fin m) (e : ProperEmbedding (t + 1) (m * t + 1)), ∀ x, color (e.internal x) = c

name: RegularityLemmata.binaryTreeRamsey_two
statement:
theorem binaryTreeRamsey_two (a b : ℕ) (color : BinaryTreeTwoColoring (a + b + 1)) :
    (∃ e : InternalEmbedding (a + 1) (a + b + 1), ∀ x, color (e x) = 0) ∨
    (∃ e : InternalEmbedding (b + 1) (a + b + 1), ∀ x, color (e x) = 1)

name: RegularityLemmata.binaryTreeRamsey_two_proper
statement:
theorem binaryTreeRamsey_two_proper (a b : ℕ) (color : BinaryTreeTwoColoring (a + b + 1)) :
    (∃ e : ProperEmbedding (a + 1) (a + b + 1), ∀ x, color (e.internal x) = 0) ∨
    (∃ e : ProperEmbedding (b + 1) (a + b + 1), ∀ x, color (e.internal x) = 1)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.card_piFinset_split
statement:
theorem card_piFinset_split [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)] [∀ i, Fintype (V i)]
    (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (A : ∀ i, Finset (V i)) :
    (Fintype.piFinset A).card
      = (Fintype.piFinset fun i : σ.Left => A i.1).card
        * (Fintype.piFinset fun i : σ.Right => A i.1).card

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.glue_apply_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem glue_apply_left {xL : ∀ i : σ.Left, V i.1} {xR : ∀ i : σ.Right, V i.1}
    {i : Fin n} (hi : i ∈ σ.left) : σ.glue xL xR i = xL ⟨i, hi⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.glue_apply_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem glue_apply_right {xL : ∀ i : σ.Left, V i.1} {xR : ∀ i : σ.Right, V i.1}
    {i : Fin n} (hi : i ∉ σ.left) : σ.glue xL xR i = xR ⟨i, hi⟩

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.glue_injective_iff
statement:
theorem glue_injective_iff {α : Type*} (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (xL : σ.Left → α)
    (xR : σ.Right → α) :
    Function.Injective (σ.glue (V := fun _ => α) xL xR) ↔
      Function.Injective xL ∧ Function.Injective xR ∧
        Disjoint (Set.range xL) (Set.range xR)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.glue_reindex
statement:
theorem glue_reindex (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (xL : ∀ i : σ.Left, V i.1) (xR : ∀ i : σ.Right, V i.1) :
    (σ.reindex π).glue (V := fun i => V (π i))
        (fun i => xL ⟨π i.1, mem_reindex_left.mp i.2⟩)
        (fun i => xR ⟨π i.1, fun h => i.2 (mem_reindex_left.mpr h)⟩)
      = fun i => σ.glue xL xR (π i)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.glue_restrict
statement:
@[simp] theorem glue_restrict (x : ∀ i, V i) :
    σ.glue (σ.restrictLeft x) (σ.restrictRight x) = x

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.isProper_iff
statement:
theorem isProper_iff {σ : CoordinateSplit n} :
    σ.IsProper ↔ σ.left.Nonempty ∧ ∃ i, i ∉ σ.left

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.mem_reindex_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_reindex_left {σ : CoordinateSplit n} {π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)}
    {i : Fin n} : i ∈ (σ.reindex π).left ↔ π i ∈ σ.left

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.mem_right_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_right_iff {σ : CoordinateSplit n} {i : Fin n} :
    i ∈ σ.right ↔ i ∉ σ.left

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.mem_singleton_left
statement: @[simp] theorem mem_singleton_left {i j : Fin n} : j ∈ ((singleton i : CoordinateSplit n)).left ↔ j = i

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.oneVsRest_apply
statement:
theorem oneVsRest_apply (R : (∀ i, V i) → Prop) (i : Fin n) (v : V i)
    (rest : ∀ j : {j : Fin n // j ≠ i}, V j.1) :
    oneVsRest R i v rest ↔ R (fun j => if h : j = i then h ▸ v else rest ⟨j, h⟩)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.reindexLeftEquiv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem reindexLeftEquiv_val (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (i : (σ.reindex π).Left) : (σ.reindexLeftEquiv π i).1 = π i.1

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.reindexRel_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem reindexRel_apply (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (R : (∀ i, V i) → Prop)
    (y : ∀ i, V (π i)) : reindexRel π R y ↔ R (Equiv.piCongrLeft V π y)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.reindexRel_comp
statement:
theorem reindexRel_comp (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (R : (∀ i, V i) → Prop)
    (x : ∀ i, V i) : reindexRel π R (fun i => x (π i)) ↔ R x

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.reindexRightEquiv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem reindexRightEquiv_val (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (i : (σ.reindex π).Right) : (σ.reindexRightEquiv π i).1 = π i.1

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.reindex_isProper
statement:
theorem reindex_isProper (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (σ.reindex π).IsProper ↔ σ.IsProper

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.restrictLeft_glue
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictLeft_glue (xL : ∀ i : σ.Left, V i.1) (xR : ∀ i : σ.Right, V i.1) :
    σ.restrictLeft (σ.glue xL xR) = xL

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.restrictLeft_reindex
statement:
theorem restrictLeft_reindex (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (x : ∀ i, V i) :
    (σ.reindex π).restrictLeft (V := fun i => V (π i)) (fun i => x (π i))
      = fun i => σ.restrictLeft x (σ.reindexLeftEquiv π i)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.restrictLeft_swap
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictLeft_swap (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (x : ∀ i, V i) (i : σ.swap.Left) :
    σ.swap.restrictLeft x i = σ.restrictRight x (σ.swapLeftEquiv i)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.restrictRight_glue
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictRight_glue (xL : ∀ i : σ.Left, V i.1) (xR : ∀ i : σ.Right, V i.1) :
    σ.restrictRight (σ.glue xL xR) = xR

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.restrictRight_reindex
statement:
theorem restrictRight_reindex (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (x : ∀ i, V i) :
    (σ.reindex π).restrictRight (V := fun i => V (π i)) (fun i => x (π i))
      = fun i => σ.restrictRight x (σ.reindexRightEquiv π i)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.restrictRight_swap
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictRight_swap (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (x : ∀ i, V i) (i : σ.swap.Right) :
    σ.swap.restrictRight x i = σ.restrictLeft x (σ.swapRightEquiv i)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.singletonLeftEquiv_symm_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem singletonLeftEquiv_symm_val (i : Fin n) (u : PUnit.{1}) :
    ((singletonLeftEquiv i).symm u).1 = i

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.singletonRightEquiv_symm_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem singletonRightEquiv_symm_val (i : Fin n) (j : {j : Fin n // j ≠ i}) :
    ((singletonRightEquiv i).symm j).1 = j.1

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.singletonRightEquiv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem singletonRightEquiv_val (i : Fin n) (j : (singleton i).Right) :
    (singletonRightEquiv i j).1 = j.1

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.singleton_isProper
statement: theorem singleton_isProper (i : Fin n) : (singleton i).IsProper ↔ ∃ j, j ≠ i

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.splitEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem splitEquiv_apply (x : ∀ i, V i) :
    σ.splitEquiv V x = (σ.restrictLeft x, σ.restrictRight x)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.splitEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem splitEquiv_symm_apply
    (p : (∀ i : σ.Left, V i.1) × (∀ i : σ.Right, V i.1)) :
    (σ.splitEquiv V).symm p = σ.glue p.1 p.2

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.splitRel_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem splitRel_apply (R : (∀ i, V i) → Prop) (xL : ∀ i : σ.Left, V i.1)
    (xR : ∀ i : σ.Right, V i.1) : σ.splitRel R xL xR ↔ R (σ.glue xL xR)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.splitRel_reindex
statement:
theorem splitRel_reindex (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (R : (∀ i, V i) → Prop) (xL : ∀ i : σ.Left, V i.1) (xR : ∀ i : σ.Right, V i.1) :
    (σ.reindex π).splitRel (V := fun i => V (π i)) (reindexRel π R)
        (fun i => xL ⟨π i.1, mem_reindex_left.mp i.2⟩)
        (fun i => xR ⟨π i.1, fun h => i.2 (mem_reindex_left.mpr h)⟩)
      ↔ σ.splitRel R xL xR

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.splitRel_swap
statement:
theorem splitRel_swap (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (R : (∀ i, V i) → Prop)
    (xL : ∀ i : σ.swap.Left, V i.1) (xR : ∀ i : σ.swap.Right, V i.1) :
    -- Routing the indices through `swapLeftEquiv.symm` instead would make the carrier read
    -- `V ↑(e.symm i)` rather than `V ↑i`. The two are `rfl`-equal but not syntactically
    -- aligned, and elaborating the dependent application can reject that mismatch.
    σ.swap.splitRel R xL xR
      ↔ σ.splitRel R (fun i => xR ⟨i.1, fun h => (mem_right_iff.mp h) i.2⟩)
          (fun i => xL ⟨i.1, mem_right_iff.mpr i.2⟩)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.swapLeftEquiv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem swapLeftEquiv_val (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (i : σ.swap.Left) :
    (σ.swapLeftEquiv i).1 = i.1

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.swapRightEquiv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem swapRightEquiv_val (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (i : σ.swap.Right) :
    (σ.swapRightEquiv i).1 = i.1

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.swap_glue
statement:
theorem swap_glue (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (xL : ∀ i : σ.swap.Left, V i.1)
    (xR : ∀ i : σ.swap.Right, V i.1) :
    σ.swap.glue xL xR
      = σ.glue (fun i => xR ⟨i.1, fun h => (mem_right_iff.mp h) i.2⟩)
          (fun i => xL ⟨i.1, mem_right_iff.mpr i.2⟩)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.swap_isProper
statement: theorem swap_isProper (σ : CoordinateSplit n) : σ.swap.IsProper ↔ σ.IsProper

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.swap_left
statement: @[simp] theorem swap_left (σ : CoordinateSplit n) : σ.swap.left = σ.right

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.swap_right
statement: theorem swap_right (σ : CoordinateSplit n) : σ.swap.right = σ.left

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.swap_swap
statement: @[simp] theorem swap_swap (σ : CoordinateSplit n) : σ.swap.swap = σ

name: RegularityLemmata.FiniteBox.mem_tuples
statement:
@[simp] theorem FiniteBox.mem_tuples [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {A : FiniteBox V}
    {x : ∀ i, V i} : x ∈ A.tuples ↔ ∀ i, x i ∈ A i

name: RegularityLemmata.FiniteBox.reindex_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem FiniteBox.reindex_apply {ι' : Type*} (e : ι' ≃ ι) (A : FiniteBox V) (j : ι') :
    A.reindex e j = A (e j)

name: RegularityLemmata.boxDensity_add_compl_of_pos
RegularityLemmata.boxDensity_apply
statement:
theorem boxDensity_apply [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (A : FiniteBox V)
    (p : (∀ i, V i) → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    boxDensity w A p = boxPredMass w A p / boxMass w A

name: RegularityLemmata.boxDensity_compl_of_pos
RegularityLemmata.boxDensity_false
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxDensity_false [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ)
    (A : FiniteBox V) : boxDensity w A (fun _ => False) = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.boxDensity_le_one
statement:
theorem boxDensity_le_one [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ} {A : FiniteBox V}
    [DecidablePred p] (hw : ∀ i, ∀ v ∈ A i, 0 ≤ w i v) : boxDensity w A p ≤ 1

name: RegularityLemmata.boxDensity_nonneg
statement:
theorem boxDensity_nonneg [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ} {A : FiniteBox V}
    [DecidablePred p] (hw : ∀ i, ∀ v ∈ A i, 0 ≤ w i v) : 0 ≤ boxDensity w A p

name: RegularityLemmata.boxDensity_of_boxMass_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxDensity_of_boxMass_eq_zero [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ}
    {A : FiniteBox V} [DecidablePred p] (h : boxMass w A = 0) : boxDensity w A p = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.boxDensity_of_eq_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxDensity_of_eq_empty [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ)
    {A : FiniteBox V} [DecidablePred p] {i : ι} (hi : A i = ∅) : boxDensity w A p = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.boxDensity_reindex
statement:
theorem boxDensity_reindex {ι' : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι']
    [DecidableEq ι'] (e : ι' ≃ ι) (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (A : FiniteBox V)
    (p : (∀ i, V i) → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    boxDensity (V := fun j => V (e j)) (fun j => w (e j)) (A.reindex e)
        (fun y => p (Equiv.piCongrLeft V e y)) = boxDensity w A p

name: RegularityLemmata.boxDensity_true_of_pos
statement:
theorem boxDensity_true_of_pos [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ} {A : FiniteBox V}
    (h : 0 < boxMass w A) : boxDensity w A (fun _ => True) = 1

name: RegularityLemmata.boxMass_apply
statement:
theorem boxMass_apply [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (A : FiniteBox V) :
    boxMass w A = ∑ x ∈ A.tuples, tupleWeight w x

name: RegularityLemmata.boxMass_eq_prod_finsetMass
statement:
theorem boxMass_eq_prod_finsetMass [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ)
    (A : FiniteBox V) : boxMass w A = ∏ i, finsetMass (w i) (A i)

name: RegularityLemmata.boxMass_mono
RegularityLemmata.boxMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem boxMass_nonneg [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ} {A : FiniteBox V}
    (hw : ∀ i, ∀ v ∈ A i, 0 ≤ w i v) : 0 ≤ boxMass w A

name: RegularityLemmata.boxMass_of_eq_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxMass_of_eq_empty [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ)
    {A : FiniteBox V} {i : ι} (hi : A i = ∅) : boxMass w A = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.boxMass_of_isEmpty
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxMass_of_isEmpty [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [IsEmpty ι] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ)
    (A : FiniteBox V) : boxMass w A = 1

name: RegularityLemmata.boxMass_one
statement:
theorem boxMass_one [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : FiniteBox V) :
    boxMass (fun _ _ => (1 : ℝ)) A = ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.boxMass_reindex
statement:
theorem boxMass_reindex {ι' : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι']
    [DecidableEq ι'] (e : ι' ≃ ι) (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (A : FiniteBox V) :
    boxMass (V := fun j => V (e j)) (fun j => w (e j)) (A.reindex e) = boxMass w A

name: RegularityLemmata.boxPredMass_add_compl
statement:
theorem boxPredMass_add_compl [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (A : FiniteBox V)
    (p : (∀ i, V i) → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    boxPredMass w A p + boxPredMass w A (fun x => ¬ p x) = boxMass w A

name: RegularityLemmata.boxPredMass_apply
statement:
theorem boxPredMass_apply [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (A : FiniteBox V)
    (p : (∀ i, V i) → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    boxPredMass w A p = ∑ x ∈ A.tuples.filter p, tupleWeight w x

name: RegularityLemmata.boxPredMass_false
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxPredMass_false [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ)
    (A : FiniteBox V) : boxPredMass w A (fun _ => False) = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.boxPredMass_le_boxMass
statement:
theorem boxPredMass_le_boxMass [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ} {A : FiniteBox V}
    [DecidablePred p] (hw : ∀ i, ∀ v ∈ A i, 0 ≤ w i v) : boxPredMass w A p ≤ boxMass w A

name: RegularityLemmata.boxPredMass_mono
RegularityLemmata.boxPredMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem boxPredMass_nonneg [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ} {A : FiniteBox V}
    [DecidablePred p] (hw : ∀ i, ∀ v ∈ A i, 0 ≤ w i v) : 0 ≤ boxPredMass w A p

name: RegularityLemmata.boxPredMass_of_eq_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxPredMass_of_eq_empty [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ)
    {A : FiniteBox V} [DecidablePred p] {i : ι} (hi : A i = ∅) : boxPredMass w A p = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.boxPredMass_reindex
statement:
theorem boxPredMass_reindex {ι' : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι']
    [DecidableEq ι'] (e : ι' ≃ ι) (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (A : FiniteBox V)
    (p : (∀ i, V i) → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    boxPredMass (V := fun j => V (e j)) (fun j => w (e j)) (A.reindex e)
        (fun y => p (Equiv.piCongrLeft V e y)) = boxPredMass w A p

name: RegularityLemmata.boxPredMass_true
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxPredMass_true [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ)
    (A : FiniteBox V) : boxPredMass w A (fun _ => True) = boxMass w A

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_tuples_reindex
statement:
theorem sum_tuples_reindex {ι' : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι']
    [DecidableEq ι'] (e : ι' ≃ ι) (A : FiniteBox V) (f : (∀ i, V i) → ℝ) :
    ∑ y ∈ (A.reindex e).tuples, f (Equiv.piCongrLeft V e y) = ∑ x ∈ A.tuples, f x

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleWeight_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem tupleWeight_apply [Fintype ι] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (x : ∀ i, V i) :
    tupleWeight w x = ∏ i, w i (x i)

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem tupleWeight_nonneg [Fintype ι] {w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ} {x : ∀ i, V i}
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i (x i)) : 0 ≤ tupleWeight w x

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleWeight_reindex
statement:
theorem tupleWeight_reindex {ι' : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype ι'] (e : ι' ≃ ι)
    (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (y : ∀ j : ι', V (e j)) :
    tupleWeight (V := fun j => V (e j)) (fun j => w (e j)) y
      = tupleWeight w (Equiv.piCongrLeft V e y)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxGlue_apply_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxGlue_apply_left (σ : CoordinateSplit n)
    (AL : FiniteBox (fun i : σ.Left => V i.1)) (AR : FiniteBox (fun i : σ.Right => V i.1))
    (i : σ.Left) : σ.boxGlue AL AR i.1 = AL i

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxGlue_apply_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxGlue_apply_right (σ : CoordinateSplit n)
    (AL : FiniteBox (fun i : σ.Left => V i.1)) (AR : FiniteBox (fun i : σ.Right => V i.1))
    (i : σ.Right) : σ.boxGlue AL AR i.1 = AR i

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxGlue_boxLeft_boxRight
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxGlue_boxLeft_boxRight (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (A : FiniteBox V) :
    σ.boxGlue (σ.boxLeft A) (σ.boxRight A) = A

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxLeft_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxLeft_apply (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (A : FiniteBox V) (i : σ.Left) :
    σ.boxLeft A i = A i.1

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxLeft_boxGlue
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxLeft_boxGlue (σ : CoordinateSplit n)
    (AL : FiniteBox (fun i : σ.Left => V i.1)) (AR : FiniteBox (fun i : σ.Right => V i.1)) :
    σ.boxLeft (σ.boxGlue AL AR) = AL

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxLeft_reindex
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxLeft_reindex (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (A : FiniteBox V)
    (i : (σ.reindex π).Left) :
    (σ.reindex π).boxLeft (V := fun i => V (π i)) (fun i => A (π i)) i
      = σ.boxLeft A (σ.reindexLeftEquiv π i)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxLeft_swap
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxLeft_swap (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (A : FiniteBox V) (i : σ.swap.Left) :
    σ.swap.boxLeft A i = σ.boxRight A (σ.swapLeftEquiv i)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxMass_boxLeft_of_left_eq_empty
statement:
theorem boxMass_boxLeft_of_left_eq_empty (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (hσ : σ.left = ∅)
    (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (A : FiniteBox V) :
    boxMass (V := fun i : σ.Left => V i.1) (fun i => w i.1) (σ.boxLeft A) = 1

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxMass_boxRight_of_left_eq_univ
statement:
theorem boxMass_boxRight_of_left_eq_univ (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (hσ : σ.left = Finset.univ)
    (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (A : FiniteBox V) :
    boxMass (V := fun i : σ.Right => V i.1) (fun i => w i.1) (σ.boxRight A) = 1

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxMass_glue
statement:
theorem boxMass_glue (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ)
    (AL : FiniteBox (fun i : σ.Left => V i.1)) (AR : FiniteBox (fun i : σ.Right => V i.1)) :
    boxMass w (σ.boxGlue AL AR)
      = boxMass (V := fun i : σ.Left => V i.1) (fun i => w i.1) AL
        * boxMass (V := fun i : σ.Right => V i.1) (fun i => w i.1) AR

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxMass_of_left_eq_empty
statement:
theorem boxMass_of_left_eq_empty (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (hσ : σ.left = ∅) (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ)
    (A : FiniteBox V) :
    boxMass w A = boxMass (V := fun i : σ.Right => V i.1) (fun i => w i.1) (σ.boxRight A)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxMass_of_left_eq_univ
statement:
theorem boxMass_of_left_eq_univ (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (hσ : σ.left = Finset.univ)
    (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (A : FiniteBox V) :
    boxMass w A = boxMass (V := fun i : σ.Left => V i.1) (fun i => w i.1) (σ.boxLeft A)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxMass_split
statement:
theorem boxMass_split (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (A : FiniteBox V) :
    boxMass w A
      = boxMass (V := fun i : σ.Left => V i.1) (fun i => w i.1) (σ.boxLeft A)
        * boxMass (V := fun i : σ.Right => V i.1) (fun i => w i.1) (σ.boxRight A)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxMass_split_swap
statement:
theorem boxMass_split_swap (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (A : FiniteBox V) :
    boxMass (V := fun i : σ.swap.Left => V i.1) (fun i => w i.1) (σ.swap.boxLeft A)
        * boxMass (V := fun i : σ.swap.Right => V i.1) (fun i => w i.1) (σ.swap.boxRight A)
      = boxMass (V := fun i : σ.Left => V i.1) (fun i => w i.1) (σ.boxLeft A)
        * boxMass (V := fun i : σ.Right => V i.1) (fun i => w i.1) (σ.boxRight A)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxRight_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxRight_apply (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (A : FiniteBox V) (i : σ.Right) :
    σ.boxRight A i = A i.1

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxRight_boxGlue
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxRight_boxGlue (σ : CoordinateSplit n)
    (AL : FiniteBox (fun i : σ.Left => V i.1)) (AR : FiniteBox (fun i : σ.Right => V i.1)) :
    σ.boxRight (σ.boxGlue AL AR) = AR

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxRight_reindex
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxRight_reindex (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (A : FiniteBox V)
    (i : (σ.reindex π).Right) :
    (σ.reindex π).boxRight (V := fun i => V (π i)) (fun i => A (π i)) i
      = σ.boxRight A (σ.reindexRightEquiv π i)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.boxRight_swap
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxRight_swap (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (A : FiniteBox V) (i : σ.swap.Right) :
    σ.swap.boxRight A i = σ.boxLeft A (σ.swapRightEquiv i)

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.mem_tuples_iff_split
statement:
theorem mem_tuples_iff_split (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (A : FiniteBox V) (x : ∀ i, V i) :
    x ∈ A.tuples ↔
      σ.restrictLeft x ∈ (σ.boxLeft A).tuples ∧ σ.restrictRight x ∈ (σ.boxRight A).tuples

name: RegularityLemmata.CoordinateSplit.mem_tuples_iff_splitEquiv
statement:
theorem mem_tuples_iff_splitEquiv (σ : CoordinateSplit n) (A : FiniteBox V) (x : ∀ i, V i) :
    x ∈ A.tuples ↔
      (σ.splitEquiv V x).1 ∈ (σ.boxLeft A).tuples ∧
        (σ.splitEquiv V x).2 ∈ (σ.boxRight A).tuples

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_sub_finsetMass_unionTuples_le
statement:
theorem abs_sub_finsetMass_unionTuples_le [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    {w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ} {F G : Finset (FiniteBox V)}
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ unionTuples F ∆ unionTuples G, 0 ≤ tupleWeight w x) :
    |finsetMass (tupleWeight w) (unionTuples F)
        - finsetMass (tupleWeight w) (unionTuples G)| ≤ boxUnionError w F G

name: RegularityLemmata.boxMass_eq_finsetMass_tupleWeight
statement:
theorem boxMass_eq_finsetMass_tupleWeight [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ)
    (A : FiniteBox V) : boxMass w A = finsetMass (tupleWeight w) A.tuples

name: RegularityLemmata.boxUnionError_apply
statement:
theorem boxUnionError_apply [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (F G : Finset (FiniteBox V)) :
    boxUnionError w F G = finsetMass (tupleWeight w) (unionTuples F ∆ unionTuples G)

name: RegularityLemmata.boxUnionError_comm
statement:
theorem boxUnionError_comm [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (F G : Finset (FiniteBox V)) :
    boxUnionError w F G = boxUnionError w G F

name: RegularityLemmata.boxUnionError_nonneg
statement:
theorem boxUnionError_nonneg [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    {w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ} {F G : Finset (FiniteBox V)}
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ unionTuples F ∆ unionTuples G, 0 ≤ tupleWeight w x) :
    0 ≤ boxUnionError w F G

name: RegularityLemmata.boxUnionError_of_unionTuples_eq
statement:
theorem boxUnionError_of_unionTuples_eq [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) {F G : Finset (FiniteBox V)} (h : unionTuples F = unionTuples G) :
    boxUnionError w F G = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.boxUnionError_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem boxUnionError_self [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) (F : Finset (FiniteBox V)) : boxUnionError w F F = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.boxUnionError_triangle
statement:
theorem boxUnionError_triangle [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    {w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ} {F G H : Finset (FiniteBox V)}
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ (unionTuples F ∆ unionTuples G) ∪ (unionTuples G ∆ unionTuples H),
      0 ≤ tupleWeight w x) :
    boxUnionError w F H ≤ boxUnionError w F G + boxUnionError w G H

name: RegularityLemmata.finsetMass_unionTuples_le
statement:
theorem finsetMass_unionTuples_le [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    {w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ} {F : Finset (FiniteBox V)}
    (hw : ∀ x ∈ unionTuples F, 0 ≤ tupleWeight w x) :
    finsetMass (tupleWeight w) (unionTuples F) ≤ ∑ A ∈ F, boxMass w A

name: RegularityLemmata.finsetMass_unionTuples_of_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem finsetMass_unionTuples_of_pairwiseDisjoint [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)] (w : ∀ i, V i → ℝ) {F : Finset (FiniteBox V)}
    (h : (F : Set (FiniteBox V)).PairwiseDisjoint FiniteBox.tuples) :
    finsetMass (tupleWeight w) (unionTuples F) = ∑ A ∈ F, boxMass w A

name: RegularityLemmata.mem_unionTuples
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_unionTuples [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    {F : Finset (FiniteBox V)} {x : ∀ i, V i} :
    x ∈ unionTuples F ↔ ∃ A ∈ F, x ∈ A.tuples

name: RegularityLemmata.unionTuples_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem unionTuples_empty [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)] :
    unionTuples (∅ : Finset (FiniteBox V)) = ∅

name: RegularityLemmata.unionTuples_singleton
statement:
@[simp] theorem unionTuples_singleton [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    (A : FiniteBox V) : unionTuples {A} = A.tuples

name: RegularityLemmata.unionTuples_subset
statement:
theorem unionTuples_subset [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)]
    {F G : Finset (FiniteBox V)} (h : F ⊆ G) : unionTuples F ⊆ unionTuples G

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_forward_monochromatic_chain
statement:
theorem exists_forward_monochromatic_chain (χ : V → V → Fin r) :
    ∀ (t : ℕ) (S : Finset V), (r + 1) ^ t ≤ S.card →
    ∃ (v : Fin t → V) (c : Fin t → Fin r),
      (∀ i, v i ∈ S) ∧ Function.Injective v ∧
      ∀ i j : Fin t, i < j → χ (v i) (v j) = c i

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_monochromatic_subchain
statement:
theorem exists_monochromatic_subchain (χ : V → V → Fin r) {s : ℕ} (S : Finset V)
    (hS : multicolorRamseyBound r s ≤ S.card) :
    ∃ (v : Fin s → V) (c : Fin r), (∀ i, v i ∈ S) ∧ Function.Injective v ∧
      ∀ i j : Fin s, i < j → χ (v i) (v j) = c

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_pairDensity_sub_mul_le
statement:
theorem abs_pairDensity_sub_mul_le (hA : A' ⊆ A) (hB : B' ⊆ B) :
    |pairDensity R A' B' - pairDensity R A B| * ((A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ))
      ≤ ((A \ A').card : ℝ) * (B.card : ℝ) + (A.card : ℝ) * ((B \ B').card : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.le_pairCount_of_le_pairDensity
statement:
theorem le_pairCount_of_le_pairDensity {c : ℝ} (h : c ≤ pairDensity R A B) :
    c * (A.card : ℝ) * B.card ≤ (pairCount R A B : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.le_pairDensity_of_forall_le_singleton
statement:
theorem le_pairDensity_of_forall_le_singleton {c : ℝ} (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (h : ∀ y ∈ B, c ≤ pairDensity R A {y}) : c ≤ pairDensity R A B

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_add_not
statement:
theorem pairCount_add_not :
    pairCount R A B + pairCount (fun a b => ¬ R a b) A B = A.card * B.card

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_biUnion
statement:
theorem pairCount_biUnion [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (R : α → β → Prop)
    [DecidableRel R] {C : Finset α} {D : Finset β}
    (sC : Finset (Finset α)) (sD : Finset (Finset β))
    (hCdisj : (sC : Set (Finset α)).PairwiseDisjoint id) (hCcover : sC.biUnion id = C)
    (hDdisj : (sD : Set (Finset β)).PairwiseDisjoint id) (hDcover : sD.biUnion id = D) :
    pairCount R C D = ∑ p ∈ sC ×ˢ sD, pairCount R p.1 p.2

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_congr
statement:
theorem pairCount_congr {S : α → β → Prop} [DecidableRel S]
    (h : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ B, (R x y ↔ S x y)) : pairCount R A B = pairCount S A B

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_empty_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairCount_empty_left (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (B : Finset β) :
    pairCount R ∅ B = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_empty_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairCount_empty_right (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (A : Finset α) :
    pairCount R A ∅ = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_eq_pairDensity_mul
statement:
theorem pairCount_eq_pairDensity_mul :
    (pairCount R A B : ℝ) = pairDensity R A B * (((A.card) : ℝ) * B.card)

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_eq_sum_left
statement:
theorem pairCount_eq_sum_left :
    pairCount R A B = ∑ x ∈ A, (B.filter fun y => R x y).card

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_eq_sum_right
statement:
theorem pairCount_eq_sum_right :
    pairCount R A B = ∑ y ∈ B, (A.filter fun x => R x y).card

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_le_add
statement:
theorem pairCount_le_add :
    pairCount R A B
      ≤ pairCount R A' B' + (A \ A').card * B.card + A.card * (B \ B').card

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_le_of_pairDensity_le
statement:
theorem pairCount_le_of_pairDensity_le {c : ℝ} (h : pairDensity R A B ≤ c) :
    (pairCount R A B : ℝ) ≤ c * (A.card : ℝ) * B.card

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_mono
statement:
theorem pairCount_mono (hA : A' ⊆ A) (hB : B' ⊆ B) :
    pairCount R A' B' ≤ pairCount R A B

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_singleton_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairCount_singleton_left (x : α) :
    pairCount R {x} B = (B.filter fun y => R x y).card

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_singleton_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairCount_singleton_right (y : β) :
    pairCount R A {y} = (A.filter fun x => R x y).card

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_swapRel
statement:
theorem pairCount_swapRel (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) :
    pairCount (swapRel R) B A = pairCount R A B

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_add_not
statement:
theorem pairDensity_add_not (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty) :
    pairDensity R A B + pairDensity (fun a b => ¬ R a b) A B = 1

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_congr
statement:
theorem pairDensity_congr {S : α → β → Prop} [DecidableRel S]
    (h : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ B, (R x y ↔ S x y)) : pairDensity R A B = pairDensity S A B

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_empty_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairDensity_empty_left (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (B : Finset β) :
    pairDensity R ∅ B = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_empty_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairDensity_empty_right (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (A : Finset α) :
    pairDensity R A ∅ = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_eq_count_div
statement:
theorem pairDensity_eq_count_div :
    pairDensity R A B = (pairCount R A B : ℝ) / (((A.card) : ℝ) * B.card)

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_le_of_forall_singleton_le
statement:
theorem pairDensity_le_of_forall_singleton_le {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h : ∀ y ∈ B, pairDensity R A {y} ≤ c) : pairDensity R A B ≤ c

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_le_one
statement: theorem pairDensity_le_one : pairDensity R A B ≤ 1

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_nonneg
statement: theorem pairDensity_nonneg : 0 ≤ pairDensity R A B

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_not
statement:
theorem pairDensity_not (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty) :
    pairDensity (fun a b => ¬ R a b) A B = 1 - pairDensity R A B

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_singleton_left
statement:
theorem pairDensity_singleton_left (x : α) :
    pairDensity R {x} B = ((B.filter fun y => R x y).card : ℝ) / B.card

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_singleton_right
statement:
theorem pairDensity_singleton_right (y : β) :
    pairDensity R A {y} = ((A.filter fun x => R x y).card : ℝ) / A.card

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_swapRel
statement:
theorem pairDensity_swapRel (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) :
    pairDensity (swapRel R) B A = pairDensity R A B

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_card_biUnion_cast
statement:
theorem sum_card_biUnion_cast [DecidableEq α] {C : Finset α} (sC : Finset (Finset α))
    (hdisj : (sC : Set (Finset α)).PairwiseDisjoint id) (hcover : sC.biUnion id = C) :
    (∑ C' ∈ sC, (C'.card : ℝ)) = (C.card : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.swapRel_swapRel
statement: @[simp] theorem swapRel_swapRel (R : α → β → Prop) : swapRel (swapRel R) = R

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_sub_lt_of_densityBucket_eq
statement:
theorem abs_sub_lt_of_densityBucket_eq {α x y : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hy : 0 ≤ y) (h : densityBucket α x = densityBucket α y) : |x - y| < α

name: RegularityLemmata.densityBucket_lt_of_le_one
statement:
theorem densityBucket_lt_of_le_one {α x : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) :
    densityBucket α x < ⌊1 / α⌋₊ + 1

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_bucketAligned_subfamily
statement:
theorem exists_bucketAligned_subfamily {K n t : ℕ}
    (Rk : Fin K → V → V → Prop) [inst : ∀ k, DecidableRel (Rk k)]
    (A : Fin n → Finset V) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α)
    (hn : multicolorRamseyBound
        (Fintype.card ((Fin K → Fin (⌊1 / α⌋₊ + 1))
          × (Fin K → Fin (⌊1 / α⌋₊ + 1)))) t ≤ n) :
    ∃ g : Fin t → Fin n, Function.Injective g ∧
      ∀ k : Fin K, ∀ i j i' j' : Fin t, i < j → i' < j' →
        |pairDensity (Rk k) (A (g i)) (A (g j))
            - pairDensity (Rk k) (A (g i')) (A (g j'))| < α ∧
        |pairDensity (Rk k) (A (g j)) (A (g i))
            - pairDensity (Rk k) (A (g j')) (A (g i'))| < α

name: RegularityLemmata.le_add_of_ceil_div_pred_eq
statement:
theorem le_add_of_ceil_div_pred_eq {x y c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (h : ⌈x / c⌉₊ - 1 = ⌈y / c⌉₊ - 1) : x ≤ y + c

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_comp_mem_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_comp_mem_le {n : ℕ} (E : Finset (Fin n → α)) (x : Fin n → Fin k)
    (i₀ : Fin n) :
    ((Fintype.piFinset fun _ : Fin k => s).filter fun f => f ∘ x ∈ E).card
      ≤ E.card * s.card ^ (k - 1)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_injectiveTuplesOn
statement:
theorem card_injectiveTuplesOn (s : Finset α) :
    (injectiveTuplesOn ι s).card = s.card.descFactorial (Fintype.card ι)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_injectiveTuplesOn_add_card_nonInjectiveTuplesOn
statement:
theorem card_injectiveTuplesOn_add_card_nonInjectiveTuplesOn (s : Finset α) :
    (injectiveTuplesOn ι s).card + (nonInjectiveTuplesOn ι s).card
      = s.card ^ Fintype.card ι

name: RegularityLemmata.card_injectiveTuplesOn_pos_iff
statement:
theorem card_injectiveTuplesOn_pos_iff (s : Finset α) :
    0 < (injectiveTuplesOn ι s).card ↔ Fintype.card ι ≤ s.card

name: RegularityLemmata.card_nonInjectiveMaps_le
statement:
theorem card_nonInjectiveMaps_le :
    (nonInjectiveMaps ι β).card
      ≤ Fintype.card ι * Fintype.card ι * Fintype.card β ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_nonInjectiveTuplesOn_le
statement:
theorem card_nonInjectiveTuplesOn_le (s : Finset α) (k : ℕ) :
    (nonInjectiveTuplesOn (Fin k) s).card ≤ k.choose 2 * s.card ^ (k - 1)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_tupleRange_of_injective
statement:
theorem card_tupleRange_of_injective [DecidableEq α] {n : ℕ} {v : Fin n → α}
    (hv : Function.Injective v) : (tupleRange v).card = n

name: RegularityLemmata.div_descFactorial_sub_div_pow_le
statement:
theorem div_descFactorial_sub_div_pow_le {n k : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hc0 : 0 ≤ c)
    (hc : c ≤ (n.descFactorial k : ℝ)) :
    c / (n.descFactorial k : ℝ) - c / (n : ℝ) ^ k ≤ (k.choose 2 : ℝ) / n

name: RegularityLemmata.div_pow_le_div_descFactorial
statement:
theorem div_pow_le_div_descFactorial {n k : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hc0 : 0 ≤ c)
    (hc : c ≤ (n.descFactorial k : ℝ)) :
    c / (n : ℝ) ^ k ≤ c / (n.descFactorial k : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_comp_perm_of_tupleRange_eq
RegularityLemmata.half_pow_le_injectiveTupleCount
statement:
theorem half_pow_le_injectiveTupleCount [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {n : ℕ} (hn1 : 1 ≤ n)
    (hn : 2 * n ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card α) :
    (Fintype.card α : ℝ) ^ n / 2 ≤ (injectiveTupleCount α n : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.injectiveTupleCount_add_card_nonInjectiveMaps
statement:
theorem injectiveTupleCount_add_card_nonInjectiveMaps [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {n : ℕ} :
    injectiveTupleCount α n + (nonInjectiveMaps (Fin n) α).card = Fintype.card α ^ n

name: RegularityLemmata.injectiveTupleCount_eq_descFactorial
statement:
theorem injectiveTupleCount_eq_descFactorial [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (n : ℕ) :
    injectiveTupleCount α n = (Fintype.card α).descFactorial n

name: RegularityLemmata.injectiveTupleCount_le_pow
statement:
theorem injectiveTupleCount_le_pow [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (n : ℕ) :
    injectiveTupleCount α n ≤ Fintype.card α ^ n

name: RegularityLemmata.injectiveTupleCount_pos_of_le
statement:
theorem injectiveTupleCount_pos_of_le [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {n : ℕ}
    (h : n ≤ Fintype.card α) : 0 < injectiveTupleCount α n

name: RegularityLemmata.mem_injectiveTuples
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_injectiveTuples [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {n : ℕ} {f : Fin n → α} :
    f ∈ injectiveTuples α n ↔ Function.Injective f

name: RegularityLemmata.mem_injectiveTuplesOn
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_injectiveTuplesOn {f : ι → α} :
    f ∈ injectiveTuplesOn ι s ↔ (∀ i, f i ∈ s) ∧ Function.Injective f

name: RegularityLemmata.mem_nonInjectiveMaps
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_nonInjectiveMaps {f : ι → β} :
    f ∈ nonInjectiveMaps ι β ↔ ¬ Function.Injective f

name: RegularityLemmata.mem_nonInjectiveTuplesOn
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_nonInjectiveTuplesOn {f : ι → α} :
    f ∈ nonInjectiveTuplesOn ι s ↔ (∀ i, f i ∈ s) ∧ ¬ Function.Injective f

name: RegularityLemmata.nonInjectiveMaps_ratio_le
statement:
theorem nonInjectiveMaps_ratio_le (hβ : 0 < Fintype.card β) :
    ((nonInjectiveMaps ι β).card : ℝ) / (Fintype.card β : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι
      ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) ^ 2 / (Fintype.card β : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.not_injective_iff_exists_lt_eq
statement:
theorem not_injective_iff_exists_lt_eq {k : ℕ} {T : Fin k → α} :
    ¬ Function.Injective T ↔ ∃ i j, i < j ∧ T i = T j

name: RegularityLemmata.pow_le_descFactorial_add_choose_mul
statement:
theorem pow_le_descFactorial_add_choose_mul (n k : ℕ) :
    n ^ k ≤ n.descFactorial k + k.choose 2 * n ^ (k - 1)

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_comm
statement: theorem editDistance_comm : editDistance R₁ R₂ A = editDistance R₂ R₁ A

theorem editDistance_eq_tupleCount_not_of_forall (h : ∀ x ∈ Fintype.piFinset A, R₂ x) :

statement:
theorem editDistance_eq_tupleCount_of_forall_not (h : ∀ x ∈ Fintype.piFinset A, ¬ R₂ x) :

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_le_card
statement:
theorem editDistance_le_card :

statement:
theorem editDistance_le_of_le_tupleDensity {ε : ℝ} (hd : 1 - ε ≤ tupleDensity R₁ A)

statement:
theorem editDistance_le_of_tupleDensity_le {ε : ℝ} (hd : tupleDensity R₁ A ≤ ε)

    (editDistance R₁ R₂ A : ℝ) ≤ ε * ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_le_sum_chain
statement:
theorem editDistance_le_sum_chain {m : ℕ}
    (Rs : Fin (m + 1) → (ι → α) → Prop) [∀ i, DecidablePred (Rs i)]
    (A : ι → Finset α) :
    editDistance (Rs 0) (Rs (Fin.last m)) A
      ≤ ∑ i : Fin m, editDistance (Rs i.castSucc) (Rs i.succ) A

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_mono_box
statement:
theorem editDistance_mono_box (h : ∀ i, A i ⊆ B i) :

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_self
statement: @[simp] theorem editDistance_self : editDistance R₁ R₁ A = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_triangle

theorem editDistance_triangle :

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_univ_le_injective_add_nonInjective

theorem editDistance_univ_le_injective_add_nonInjective [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] :
    editDistance R₁ R₂ (fun _ => Finset.univ)
      ≤ ((editSet R₁ R₂ fun _ => Finset.univ).filter Function.Injective).card

statement:
theorem hedgePotential_congr (h : ∀ s < t, ℓ s = ℓ' s) :

name: RegularityLemmata.hedgePotential_succ
statement:
theorem hedgePotential_succ [Nonempty ι] :
    hedgePotential η ℓ (t + 1)
      = hedgePotential η ℓ t * ∑ i, hedgeProb η ℓ t i * Real.exp (-η * ℓ t i)

name: RegularityLemmata.hedgePotential_succ_le
statement:
theorem hedgePotential_succ_le [Nonempty ι] (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hℓ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ℓ t i ∧ ℓ t i ≤ 1) :
    hedgePotential η ℓ (t + 1)
      ≤ hedgePotential η ℓ t * (1 - η * hedgeExpectedLoss η ℓ t + η ^ 2 / 2)

name: RegularityLemmata.hedgePotential_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem hedgePotential_zero : hedgePotential η ℓ 0 = Fintype.card ι

statement: theorem hedgeProb_le_one : hedgeProb η ℓ t i ≤ 1

name: RegularityLemmata.hedgeProb_nonneg

statement: theorem hedgeProb_sum_one_fin [NeZero m] : ∑ i, hedgeProb η ℓm t i = 1

name: RegularityLemmata.hedgeWeight_comp_equiv
statement:

    hedgeWeight η (fun s j => ℓ s (e j)) t = fun j => hedgeWeight η ℓ t (e j)

statement: theorem hedgeWeight_le_hedgePotential : hedgeWeight η ℓ t i ≤ hedgePotential η ℓ t

statement: theorem hedgeWeight_pos : 0 < hedgeWeight η ℓ t i

name: RegularityLemmata.hedgeWeight_succ
statement:
theorem hedgeWeight_succ :

name: RegularityLemmata.hedgeWeight_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem hedgeWeight_zero : hedgeWeight η ℓ 0 i = 1

name: RegularityLemmata.hedge_regret
statement:
theorem hedge_regret (hη : 0 < η) {T : ℕ} (hℓ : ∀ t < T, ∀ i, 0 ≤ ℓ t i ∧ ℓ t i ≤ 1)
    (i₀ : ι) :
    ∑ t ∈ range T, hedgeExpectedLoss η ℓ t
      ≤ ∑ t ∈ range T, ℓ t i₀ + Real.log (Fintype.card ι) / η + η * T / 2

name: RegularityLemmata.hedge_regret_fin
statement:
theorem hedge_regret_fin (hη : 0 < η) {T : ℕ} (hℓ : ∀ t < T, ∀ i, 0 ≤ ℓm t i ∧ ℓm t i ≤ 1)
    (i₀ : Fin m) :
    ∑ t ∈ range T, hedgeExpectedLoss η ℓm t
      ≤ ∑ t ∈ range T, ℓm t i₀ + Real.log m / η + η * T / 2

name: RegularityLemmata.log_hedgePotential_le
statement:
theorem log_hedgePotential_le [Nonempty ι] (hη : 0 ≤ η) {T : ℕ}
    (hℓ : ∀ t < T, ∀ i, 0 ≤ ℓ t i ∧ ℓ t i ≤ 1) :
    Real.log (hedgePotential η ℓ T)
      ≤ Real.log (Fintype.card ι) - η * ∑ t ∈ range T, hedgeExpectedLoss η ℓ t
        + η ^ 2 * T / 2

name: RegularityLemmata.log_hedgePotential_succ_le
statement:
theorem log_hedgePotential_succ_le [Nonempty ι] (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hℓ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ℓ t i ∧ ℓ t i ≤ 1) :
    Real.log (hedgePotential η ℓ (t + 1))
      ≤ Real.log (hedgePotential η ℓ t) - η * hedgeExpectedLoss η ℓ t + η ^ 2 / 2

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_hedgeWeight_pos

theorem IsHomogeneousPair.of_abs_pairDensity_sub_le [DecidableRel R] {γ : ℝ}

name: RegularityLemmata.IsHomogeneousPair.restrict
statement:
theorem IsHomogeneousPair.restrict {ρA ρB : ℝ} (h : IsHomogeneousPair R A B ε)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hρA : 0 < ρA) (hρB : 0 < ρB) (hA : A' ⊆ A) (hB : B' ⊆ B)
    (hAc : ρA * (A.card : ℝ) ≤ (A'.card : ℝ)) (hBc : ρB * (B.card : ℝ) ≤ (B'.card : ℝ)) :
    IsHomogeneousPair R A' B' (ε / (ρA * ρB))

name: RegularityLemmata.IsHomogeneousPair.subset_zero
statement:
theorem IsHomogeneousPair.subset_zero (h : IsHomogeneousPair R A B 0)
