name: RegularityLemmata.abs_pairDensity_sub_le_of_grow
statement:
theorem abs_pairDensity_sub_le_of_grow [DecidableRel R] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    {A' : Finset α} {B' : Finset β} {s k : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hA : A' ⊆ A) (hB : B' ⊆ B)
    (hA'c : s ≤ A'.card) (hB'c : s ≤ B'.card)
    (hAc : A.card ≤ A'.card + k) (hBc : B.card ≤ B'.card + k) :
    |pairDensity R A B - pairDensity R A' B'| ≤ 2 * k * ((s : ℝ) + k) / s ^ 2

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_pairDensity_sub_le_of_grow_one
statement:
theorem abs_pairDensity_sub_le_of_grow_one [DecidableRel R] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hA : A' ⊆ A) (hB : B' ⊆ B)
    (hA'c : s ≤ A'.card) (hB'c : s ≤ B'.card)
    (hAc : A.card ≤ A'.card + 1) (hBc : B.card ≤ B'.card + 1) :
    |pairDensity R A B - pairDensity R A' B'| ≤ 2 * ((s : ℝ) + 1) / s ^ 2

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_pairDensity_sub_le_of_relative_grow
statement:
theorem abs_pairDensity_sub_le_of_relative_grow [DecidableRel R] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    {A' : Finset α} {B' : Finset β} {cX cY : ℝ}
    (hA : A' ⊆ A) (hB : B' ⊆ B) (hA'ne : A'.Nonempty) (hB'ne : B'.Nonempty)
    (hAc : (A.card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + cX) * A'.card)
    (hBc : (B.card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + cY) * B'.card) :
    |pairDensity R A B - pairDensity R A' B'| ≤ cX + cY + 2 * cX * cY

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousPair_def
statement:
theorem isHomogeneousPair_def [inst : DecidableRel R] :
    IsHomogeneousPair R A B ε ↔ pairDensity R A B ≤ ε ∨ 1 - ε ≤ pairDensity R A B

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousPair_not_iff
statement:
theorem isHomogeneousPair_not_iff :
    IsHomogeneousPair (fun a b => ¬ R a b) A B ε ↔ IsHomogeneousPair R A B ε

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousPair_of_half_le
statement:
theorem isHomogeneousPair_of_half_le (R : α → β → Prop) (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β)
    (hε : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ ε) : IsHomogeneousPair R A B ε

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousPair_singleton
statement:
theorem isHomogeneousPair_singleton [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (R : α → β → Prop)
    (a : α) (b : β) : IsHomogeneousPair R {a} {b} 0

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousPair_swapRel_iff
statement:
theorem isHomogeneousPair_swapRel_iff :
    IsHomogeneousPair (swapRel R) B A ε ↔ IsHomogeneousPair R A B ε

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_restrict_le
statement:
theorem pairDensity_restrict_le {S : α → β → Prop} [DecidableRel S] {c ρA ρB : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hρA : 0 < ρA) (hρB : 0 < ρB) (hA : A' ⊆ A) (hB : B' ⊆ B)
    (hAc : ρA * (A.card : ℝ) ≤ (A'.card : ℝ)) (hBc : ρB * (B.card : ℝ) ≤ (B'.card : ℝ))
    (hS : (pairCount S A B : ℝ) ≤ c * (A.card : ℝ) * B.card) :
    pairDensity S A' B' ≤ c / (ρA * ρB)

name: RegularityLemmata.IsHomogeneousCell.mono
statement:
theorem IsHomogeneousCell.mono (h : IsHomogeneousCell R A ε) (hε : ε ≤ ε') :
    IsHomogeneousCell R A ε'

name: RegularityLemmata.IsHomogeneousCell.of_abs_tupleDensity_sub_le
statement:
theorem IsHomogeneousCell.of_abs_tupleDensity_sub_le [DecidableEq ι] [DecidablePred R] {γ : ℝ}
    (h : IsHomogeneousCell R A' ε)
    (hclose : |tupleDensity R A - tupleDensity R A'| ≤ γ) :
    IsHomogeneousCell R A (ε + γ)

name: RegularityLemmata.IsHomogeneousCell.of_grow
statement:
theorem IsHomogeneousCell.of_grow [DecidableEq ι] [DecidablePred R] {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (h : IsHomogeneousCell R A' ε) (hA : ∀ i, A' i ⊆ A i)
    (hgrow : ∀ i, ((A i).card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + γ) * ((A' i).card : ℝ)) :
    IsHomogeneousCell R A (ε + (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * γ)

name: RegularityLemmata.IsHomogeneousCell.restrict
statement:
theorem IsHomogeneousCell.restrict {ρ : ι → ℝ} (h : IsHomogeneousCell R A ε) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hρ : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i) (hA : ∀ i, A' i ⊆ A i)
    (hcard : ∀ i, ρ i * ((A i).card : ℝ) ≤ ((A' i).card : ℝ)) :
    IsHomogeneousCell R A' (ε / ∏ i, ρ i)

name: RegularityLemmata.IsHomogeneousCell.subset_zero
statement:
theorem IsHomogeneousCell.subset_zero (h : IsHomogeneousCell R A 0) (hA : ∀ i, A' i ⊆ A i) :
    IsHomogeneousCell R A' 0

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_tupleDensity_sub_le_of_grow
statement:
theorem abs_tupleDensity_sub_le_of_grow [DecidableEq ι] [DecidablePred R] {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hA : ∀ i, A' i ⊆ A i) (hgrow : ∀ i, ((A i).card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + γ) * ((A' i).card : ℝ)) :
    |tupleDensity R A - tupleDensity R A'| ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * γ

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousCell_def
statement:
theorem isHomogeneousCell_def [instι : DecidableEq ι] [instR : DecidablePred R] :
    IsHomogeneousCell R A ε ↔ tupleDensity R A ≤ ε ∨ 1 - ε ≤ tupleDensity R A

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousCell_of_half_le
statement: theorem isHomogeneousCell_of_half_le (hε : 1 / 2 ≤ ε) : IsHomogeneousCell R A ε

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousCell_of_isEmpty_index
statement: theorem isHomogeneousCell_of_isEmpty_index [IsEmpty ι] : IsHomogeneousCell R A 0

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousCell_of_side_empty
statement:
theorem isHomogeneousCell_of_side_empty [DecidableEq ι] {i : ι} (hi : A i = ∅) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    IsHomogeneousCell R A ε

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousCell_one_iff
statement:
theorem isHomogeneousCell_one_iff {R₁ : (Fin 1 → α) → Prop} [DecidablePred R₁]
    {A₁ : Fin 1 → Finset α} :
    IsHomogeneousCell R₁ A₁ ε ↔ densityOn (A₁ 0) (fun a ↦ R₁ ![a]) ≤ ε
      ∨ 1 - ε ≤ densityOn (A₁ 0) fun a ↦ R₁ ![a]

name: RegularityLemmata.isHomogeneousCell_two_iff
RegularityLemmata.prod_card_sub_le_of_grow
statement:
theorem prod_card_sub_le_of_grow [DecidableEq ι] {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hA : ∀ i, A' i ⊆ A i)
    (hgrow : ∀ i, ((A i).card : ℝ) ≤ (1 + γ) * ((A' i).card : ℝ)) :
    (∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ)) - ∏ i, ((A' i).card : ℝ)
      ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * γ * ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.prod_sub_prod_le_card_mul_of_le
statement:
theorem prod_sub_prod_le_card_mul_of_le {s : Finset ι} {b p : ι → ℝ} {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hb : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ b i) (hbp : ∀ i ∈ s, b i ≤ p i)
    (hgrow : ∀ i ∈ s, p i ≤ (1 + γ) * b i) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, p i) - ∏ i ∈ s, b i ≤ (s.card : ℝ) * γ * ∏ i ∈ s, p i

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_eq_pairDensity
statement:
theorem tupleDensity_eq_pairDensity [DecidableEq α] (R₂ : (Fin 2 → α) → Prop)
    [DecidablePred R₂] (A₂ : Fin 2 → Finset α) :
    tupleDensity R₂ A₂ = pairDensity (fun a b ↦ R₂ ![a, b]) (A₂ 0) (A₂ 1)

name: RegularityLemmata.tupleDensity_restrict_le
statement:
theorem tupleDensity_restrict_le [DecidableEq ι] {S : (ι → α) → Prop} [DecidablePred S]
    {c : ℝ} {ρ : ι → ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hρ : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i) (hA : ∀ i, A' i ⊆ A i)
    (hcard : ∀ i, ρ i * ((A i).card : ℝ) ≤ ((A' i).card : ℝ))
    (hS : (tupleCount S A : ℝ) ≤ c * ∏ i, ((A i).card : ℝ)) :
    tupleDensity S A' ≤ c / ∏ i, ρ i

name: RegularityLemmata.badNbhd_mono
statement:
theorem badNbhd_mono {B : V → V → Prop} [DecidableRel B] {S S' : Finset V}
    (h : S' ⊆ S) (v : V) : badNbhd B S' v ⊆ badNbhd B S v

name: RegularityLemmata.badNbhd_subset
statement:
theorem badNbhd_subset {B : V → V → Prop} [DecidableRel B] {S : Finset V} {v : V} :
    badNbhd B S v ⊆ S

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_degree_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_degree_le (B : V → V → Prop) [DecidableRel B] (S : Finset V)
    {E D : ℕ} (hE : ∑ v ∈ S, (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ E)
    (hD : 2 * E ≤ S.card * (D + 1)) :
    S.card ≤ 2 * (S.filter (fun v => (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ D)).card

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_clean_subset
statement:
theorem exists_clean_subset (B : V → V → Prop) [DecidableRel B] (S : Finset V)
    {E D : ℕ} (hE : ∑ v ∈ S, (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ E)
    (hD : 2 * E ≤ S.card * (D + 1)) :
    ∃ T ⊆ S, S.card ≤ 2 * (D + 1) * T.card ∧
      ∀ x ∈ T, ∀ y ∈ T, x ≠ y → ¬ B x y

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_clean_subset_of_degree_le
statement:
theorem exists_clean_subset_of_degree_le (B : V → V → Prop) [DecidableRel B]
    (D : ℕ) (S : Finset V) (hdeg : ∀ v ∈ S, (badNbhd B S v).card ≤ D) :
    ∃ T ⊆ S, S.card ≤ (D + 1) * T.card ∧
      ∀ x ∈ T, ∀ y ∈ T, x ≠ y → ¬ B x y

name: RegularityLemmata.not_bad_of_mem_of_notMem_badNbhd
statement:
theorem not_bad_of_mem_of_notMem_badNbhd {B : V → V → Prop} [DecidableRel B]
    {S : Finset V} {v u : V} (hu : u ∈ S) (h : u ∉ badNbhd B S v) :
    ¬ B v u ∧ ¬ B u v

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_comp_mem_le_compatible
statement:
theorem card_filter_comp_mem_le_compatible (s : Finset α) (E : Finset (Fin n → α))
    (x : Fin n → Fin k) :
    ((Fintype.piFinset fun _ : Fin k ↦ s).filter fun f ↦ f ∘ x ∈ E).card ≤
      (E.filter fun y ↦ ∀ i j, x i = x j → y i = y j).card *
        s.card ^ (k - (Finset.univ.image x).card)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_comp_mem_le_image
statement:
theorem card_filter_comp_mem_le_image (s : Finset α) (E : Finset (Fin n → α))
    (x : Fin n → Fin k) :
    ((Fintype.piFinset fun _ : Fin k ↦ s).filter fun f ↦ f ∘ x ∈ E).card ≤
      E.card * s.card ^ (k - (Finset.univ.image x).card)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_comp_mem_le_of_injective
statement:
theorem card_filter_comp_mem_le_of_injective (s : Finset α) (E : Finset (Fin n → α))
    (x : Fin n → Fin k) (hx : Function.Injective x) :
    ((Fintype.piFinset fun _ : Fin k ↦ s).filter fun f ↦ f ∘ x ∈ E).card ≤
      E.card * s.card ^ (k - n)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_exists_comp_mem_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_exists_comp_mem_le (s : Finset α)
    (E : (Fin n → Fin k) → Finset (Fin n → α)) :
    ((Fintype.piFinset fun _ : Fin k ↦ s).filter fun f ↦ ∃ x, f ∘ x ∈ E x).card ≤
      ∑ x : Fin n → Fin k,
        ((E x).filter fun y ↦ ∀ i j, x i = x j → y i = y j).card *
          s.card ^ (k - (Finset.univ.image x).card)

name: RegularityLemmata.sectionDisagreement_div_sq
statement:
theorem sectionDisagreement_div_sq :
    (sectionDisagreement A p : ℝ) / (A.card : ℝ) ^ 2
      = 2 * densityOn A p * (1 - densityOn A p)

name: RegularityLemmata.sectionDisagreement_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem sectionDisagreement_empty : sectionDisagreement (∅ : Finset α) p = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.sectionDisagreement_eq
statement:
theorem sectionDisagreement_eq :
    sectionDisagreement A p = 2 * (A.filter p).card * (A.filter fun a => ¬ p a).card

name: RegularityLemmata.sectionDisagreement_eq_sum
statement:
theorem sectionDisagreement_eq_sum :
    sectionDisagreement A p = ∑ b ∈ A, (A.filter fun a => ¬ (p b ↔ p a)).card

name: RegularityLemmata.sectionDisagreement_le_sq
statement: theorem sectionDisagreement_le_sq : sectionDisagreement A p ≤ A.card ^ 2

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_normalizedDisagreement_le
statement:
theorem sum_normalizedDisagreement_le {ι : Type*} (Y : Finset ι) (A : Finset α)
    (p : ι → α → Prop) [∀ y, DecidablePred (p y)] {θ γ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hmixed : ((Y.filter fun y => InclusiveMixed θ (densityOn A (p y))).card : ℝ)
      ≤ γ * Y.card) :
    ∑ y ∈ Y, (sectionDisagreement A (p y) : ℝ) / (A.card : ℝ) ^ 2
      ≤ (2 * θ + γ / 2) * Y.card

name: RegularityLemmata.two_mul_mul_one_sub_le_half
statement: theorem two_mul_mul_one_sub_le_half {d : ℝ} : 2 * d * (1 - d) ≤ 1 / 2

name: RegularityLemmata.two_mul_mul_one_sub_le_of_not_inclusiveMixed
statement:
theorem two_mul_mul_one_sub_le_of_not_inclusiveMixed {θ d : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hd0 : 0 ≤ d)
    (hd1 : d ≤ 1) (h : ¬ InclusiveMixed θ d) : 2 * d * (1 - d) ≤ 2 * θ

name: RegularityLemmata.coordDisagreement_of_eq_empty
statement:
theorem coordDisagreement_of_eq_empty {i : Fin k} (hi : A i = ∅) (j : Fin k) :
    coordDisagreement R A j = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.hybridEdgeDisagreement_eq
statement:
theorem hybridEdgeDisagreement_eq (j : Fin k) :
    hybridEdgeDisagreement R A j
      = coordDisagreement R A j * ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (A i).card

name: RegularityLemmata.min_mul_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem min_mul_le_two_mul {c n : ℕ} (hc : c ≤ n) :
    min c (n - c) * n ≤ 2 * c * (n - c)

name: RegularityLemmata.minorityCount_eq_min_tupleCount
statement:
theorem minorityCount_eq_min_tupleCount {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (R : (Fin k → α) → Prop)
    [DecidablePred R] (A : Fin k → Finset α) :
    minorityCount R A = min (tupleCount R A) ((Fintype.piFinset A).card - tupleCount R A)

name: RegularityLemmata.minorityCount_le
statement: theorem minorityCount_le : minorityCount R A ≤ ((Fintype.piFinset A).filter R).card

name: RegularityLemmata.minorityCount_le_sub
statement:
theorem minorityCount_le_sub :
    minorityCount R A ≤ (Fintype.piFinset A).card - ((Fintype.piFinset A).filter R).card

name: RegularityLemmata.minorityCount_le_sum_coordDisagreement_div
statement:
theorem minorityCount_le_sum_coordDisagreement_div :
    (minorityCount R A : ℝ) ≤ ∑ j : Fin k, (coordDisagreement R A j : ℝ) / (A j).card

name: RegularityLemmata.minorityCount_mul_card_le
statement:
theorem minorityCount_mul_card_le :
    minorityCount R A * (Fintype.piFinset A).card
      ≤ ∑ j : Fin k, coordDisagreement R A j * ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (A i).card

name: RegularityLemmata.minorityCount_of_eq_empty
statement: theorem minorityCount_of_eq_empty {i : Fin k} (hi : A i = ∅) : minorityCount R A = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.minorityCount_zero
statement:
theorem minorityCount_zero {V : Fin 0 → Type*} [∀ i, DecidableEq (V i)] (R : (∀ i, V i) → Prop)
    [DecidablePred R] (A : ∀ i, Finset (V i)) :
    minorityCount R A = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.prefixHybrid_mem
RegularityLemmata.prefixHybrid_of_le
statement: theorem prefixHybrid_of_le (x y : ∀ i, V i) {j : ℕ} (h : k ≤ j) : prefixHybrid x y j = y

name: RegularityLemmata.prefixHybrid_succ
statement:
theorem prefixHybrid_succ (x y : ∀ i, V i) (j : Fin k) :
    prefixHybrid x y (j + 1) = Function.update (prefixHybrid x y j) j (y j)

name: RegularityLemmata.prefixHybrid_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem prefixHybrid_zero (x y : ∀ i, V i) : prefixHybrid x y 0 = x

name: RegularityLemmata.sectionDisagreement_piFinset_le_sum_hybridEdge
statement:
theorem sectionDisagreement_piFinset_le_sum_hybridEdge :
    sectionDisagreement (Fintype.piFinset A) R ≤ ∑ j : Fin k, hybridEdgeDisagreement R A j

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_rectSum_le_rectCutNorm
statement:
theorem abs_rectSum_le_rectCutNorm {S : Finset X} {T : Finset Y} (hS : S ⊆ A) (hT : T ⊆ B) :
    |rectSum f wX wY S T| ≤ rectCutNorm f wX wY A B

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutNorm_eq_zero_of_finsetMass_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem rectCutNorm_eq_zero_of_finsetMass_mul_eq_zero (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x)
    (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) (h : finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B = 0) :
    rectCutNorm f wX wY A B = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutNorm_le_iff
statement:
theorem rectCutNorm_le_iff {c : ℝ} :
    rectCutNorm f wX wY A B ≤ c ↔ ∀ S ⊆ A, ∀ T ⊆ B, |rectSum f wX wY S T| ≤ c

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutNorm_le_mul_mass
statement:
theorem rectCutNorm_le_mul_mass {C : ℝ} (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hf : IsAbsBoundedOnRectangle f C A B) :
    rectCutNorm f wX wY A B ≤ C * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B)

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutNorm_nonneg
statement: theorem rectCutNorm_nonneg : 0 ≤ rectCutNorm f wX wY A B

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutNorm_op
statement:
theorem rectCutNorm_op (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (A : Finset X)
    (B : Finset Y) : rectCutNorm f.op wY wX B A = rectCutNorm f wX wY A B

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutNorm_smul_weight_left
statement:
theorem rectCutNorm_smul_weight_left {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ)
    (wY : Y → ℝ) (A : Finset X) (B : Finset Y) :
    rectCutNorm f (fun x => c * wX x) wY A B = c * rectCutNorm f wX wY A B

name: RegularityLemmata.isAbsUnitBoundedOnRectangle_relationKernel
statement:
theorem isAbsUnitBoundedOnRectangle_relationKernel (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R]
    (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) : IsAbsUnitBoundedOnRectangle (relationKernel R) A B

name: RegularityLemmata.isUnitIntervalOnRectangle_rectIndicator
statement:
theorem isUnitIntervalOnRectangle_rectIndicator (S : Finset α) (T : Finset β) (A : Finset α)
    (B : Finset β) : IsUnitIntervalOnRectangle (rectIndicator S T) A B

name: RegularityLemmata.isUnitIntervalOnRectangle_relationKernel
statement:
theorem isUnitIntervalOnRectangle_relationKernel (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R]
    (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) : IsUnitIntervalOnRectangle (relationKernel R) A B

name: RegularityLemmata.rectAverageCount_relationKernel
statement:
theorem rectAverageCount_relationKernel (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R]
    (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) :
    rectAverageCount (relationKernel R) A B = pairDensity R A B

name: RegularityLemmata.rectAverage_relationKernel
statement:
theorem rectAverage_relationKernel (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R]
    (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) :
    rectAverage (relationKernel R) (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) A B = pairDensity R A B

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCombination_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rectCombination_apply (c : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Fin n → Finset α)
    (T : Fin n → Finset β) (a : α) (b : β) :
    rectCombination c S T a b = ∑ k, c k * rectIndicator (S k) (T k) a b

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCombination_op
statement:
theorem rectCombination_op (c : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Fin n → Finset α) (T : Fin n → Finset β) :
    (rectCombination c S T).op = rectCombination c T S

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCombination_snoc
statement:
theorem rectCombination_snoc (c : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Fin n → Finset α) (T : Fin n → Finset β)
    (a : ℝ) (S₀ : Finset α) (T₀ : Finset β) :
    rectCombination (Fin.snoc c a) (Fin.snoc S S₀) (Fin.snoc T T₀)
      = fun x y => rectCombination c S T x y + a * rectIndicator S₀ T₀ x y

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCombination_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem rectCombination_zero (c : Fin 0 → ℝ) (S : Fin 0 → Finset α)
    (T : Fin 0 → Finset β) : rectCombination c S T = fun _ _ => 0

name: RegularityLemmata.rectIndicator_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rectIndicator_apply (S : Finset α) (T : Finset β) (a : α) (b : β) :
    rectIndicator S T a b = if a ∈ S ∧ b ∈ T then 1 else 0

name: RegularityLemmata.rectIndicator_op
statement:
theorem rectIndicator_op (S : Finset α) (T : Finset β) :
    (rectIndicator S T).op = rectIndicator T S

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSqMass_sub_rectAverage_smul_rectIndicator
statement:
theorem rectSqMass_sub_rectAverage_smul_rectIndicator (f : RectKernel α β) (hS : S ⊆ A)
    (hT : T ⊆ B) :
    rectSqMass (fun x y => f x y - rectAverage f wX wY S T * rectIndicator S T x y) wX wY A B
      = rectSqMass f wX wY A B - rectBlockEnergy f wX wY S T

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSqMass_sub_smul_rectIndicator
statement:
theorem rectSqMass_sub_smul_rectIndicator (f : RectKernel α β) (hS : S ⊆ A) (hT : T ⊆ B)
    (a : ℝ) :
    rectSqMass (fun x y => f x y - a * rectIndicator S T x y) wX wY A B
      = rectSqMass f wX wY A B - 2 * a * rectSum f wX wY S T
        + a ^ 2 * (finsetMass wX S * finsetMass wY T)

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSumCount_relationKernel
statement:
theorem rectSumCount_relationKernel (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R]
    (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) :
    rectSumCount (relationKernel R) A B = (pairCount R A B : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_mul_rectIndicator
statement:
theorem rectSum_mul_rectIndicator (f : RectKernel α β) (hS : S ⊆ A) (hT : T ⊆ B) :
    rectSum (fun x y => f x y * rectIndicator S T x y) wX wY A B = rectSum f wX wY S T

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_rectCombination
statement:
theorem rectSum_rectCombination (c : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Fin n → Finset α) (T : Fin n → Finset β)
    (wX : α → ℝ) (wY : β → ℝ) (S' : Finset α) (T' : Finset β) :
    rectSum (rectCombination c S T) wX wY S' T'
      = ∑ k, c k * (finsetMass wX (S' ∩ S k) * finsetMass wY (T' ∩ T k))

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_rectIndicator
statement:
theorem rectSum_rectIndicator (S : Finset α) (T : Finset β) (wX : α → ℝ) (wY : β → ℝ)
    (S' : Finset α) (T' : Finset β) :
    rectSum (rectIndicator S T) wX wY S' T' = finsetMass wX (S' ∩ S) * finsetMass wY (T' ∩ T)

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_relationKernel
statement:
theorem rectSum_relationKernel (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R]
    (A : Finset α) (B : Finset β) :
    rectSum (relationKernel R) (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) A B = (pairCount R A B : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.relationKernel_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem relationKernel_apply (a : α) (b : β) :
    relationKernel R a b = if R a b then 1 else 0

name: RegularityLemmata.relationKernel_not
statement:
theorem relationKernel_not (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (a : α) (b : β) :
    relationKernel (fun a b => ¬ R a b) a b = 1 - relationKernel R a b

name: RegularityLemmata.relationKernel_op
statement:
@[simp] theorem relationKernel_op (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R] :
    (relationKernel R).op = relationKernel (swapRel R)

name: RegularityLemmata.kernel_frieze_kannan_cutDecomposition
statement:
theorem kernel_frieze_kannan_cutDecomposition (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ)
    (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)
    (hf : IsAbsUnitBoundedOnRectangle f A B) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Fin n → Finset X) (T : Fin n → Finset Y),
      n ≤ ⌈1 / ε ^ 2⌉₊ ∧
      (∀ k, |c k| ≤ 1 / ε) ∧
      (∀ k, S k ⊆ A ∧ T k ⊆ B) ∧
      rectCutNorm (fun x y => f x y - rectCombination c S T x y) wX wY A B
        ≤ ε * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B)

name: RegularityLemmata.kernel_frieze_kannan_cutDecomposition_normalized
statement:
theorem kernel_frieze_kannan_cutDecomposition_normalized (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ)
    (wY : Y → ℝ) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)
    (hf : IsAbsUnitBoundedOnRectangle f A B) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (S : Fin n → Finset X) (T : Fin n → Finset Y),
      n ≤ ⌈1 / ε ^ 2⌉₊ ∧
      (∀ k, |c k| ≤ 1 / ε) ∧
      (∀ k, S k ⊆ A ∧ T k ⊆ B) ∧
      rectCutNorm (fun x y => f x y - rectCombination c S T x y) wX wY A B
        / (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B) ≤ ε

name: RegularityLemmata.kernel_frieze_kannan_cutDecomposition_op
statement:
theorem kernel_frieze_kannan_cutDecomposition_op (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ)
    (wY : Y → ℝ) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)
    (hf : IsAbsUnitBoundedOnRectangle f A B) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (T : Fin n → Finset Y) (S : Fin n → Finset X),
      n ≤ ⌈1 / ε ^ 2⌉₊ ∧
      (∀ k, |c k| ≤ 1 / ε) ∧
      (∀ k, T k ⊆ B ∧ S k ⊆ A) ∧
      rectCutNorm (fun y x => f.op y x - rectCombination c T S y x) wY wX B A
        ≤ ε * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B)

name: RegularityLemmata.averageOn_averageOn_comm
statement:
theorem averageOn_averageOn_comm (g : X → Y → ℝ) (U : Finset X) (V : Finset Y) :
    averageOn U (fun x ↦ averageOn V (g x)) = averageOn V (fun y ↦ averageOn U (g · y))

name: RegularityLemmata.averageOn_averageOn_indicator_lt
statement:
theorem averageOn_averageOn_indicator_lt {E : Finset (X × Y)} {A : Finset X} {B : Finset Y}
    {ε : ℝ} (hE : E ⊆ A ×ˢ B) (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (hmass : (E.card : ℝ) < ε * A.card * B.card) :
    averageOn A (fun x ↦ averageOn B fun y ↦ if (x, y) ∈ E then (1 : ℝ) else 0) < ε

name: RegularityLemmata.averageOn_averageOn_indicator_mul
statement:
theorem averageOn_averageOn_indicator_mul (E : Finset (X × Y)) (U : Finset X)
    (V : Finset Y) :
    averageOn U (fun x ↦ averageOn V fun y ↦ if (x, y) ∈ E then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
      * ((U.card : ℝ) * (V.card : ℝ)) = (((U ×ˢ V) ∩ E).card : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_product_inter_eq_sum_left
statement:
theorem card_product_inter_eq_sum_left (E : Finset (X × Y)) (U : Finset X) (V : Finset Y) :
    ((U ×ˢ V) ∩ E).card = ∑ x ∈ U, (V.filter fun y ↦ (x, y) ∈ E).card

name: RegularityLemmata.card_product_inter_eq_sum_right
statement:
theorem card_product_inter_eq_sum_right (E : Finset (X × Y)) (U : Finset X) (V : Finset Y) :
    ((U ×ˢ V) ∩ E).card = ∑ y ∈ V, (U.filter fun x ↦ (x, y) ∈ E).card

statement:

statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_fiber (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (a : α) (B : Finset β)

statement:

name: RegularityLemmata.mem_fiberFamily_subset

name: RegularityLemmata.card_fiberFamily_le_pow
statement:
theorem card_fiberFamily_le_pow (R : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel R]

name: RegularityLemmata.card_fiberFamily_le_sum_choose

statement:
theorem traceFamily_traceFamily (𝒜 : Finset (Finset α)) (s t : Finset α) :

statement:

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_piFinset_cost_le
statement:
theorem exists_piFinset_cost_le (t : ι → Finset β) (wt : β → ℝ) (hwt : ∀ x, 0 ≤ wt x)
    (cost : (ι → β) → ℝ) (hcost : ∀ g, 0 ≤ cost g) {μ : ℝ}
    (hWpos : 0 < ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x)
    (hexp : ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, (∏ j, wt (g j)) * cost g
        ≤ μ * ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x) :
    ∃ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, cost g ≤ μ

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_piFinset_forall_not_mem_bad
statement:
theorem exists_piFinset_forall_not_mem_bad {E : Type*} [Fintype E]
    (t : ι → Finset β) (wt : β → ℝ) (hwt : ∀ x, 0 ≤ wt x)
    (i₁ i₂ : E → ι) (hne : ∀ e, i₁ e ≠ i₂ e) (Bad : E → Finset (β × β))
    (hlt : ∑ e : E, ∑ p ∈ Bad e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2
          * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x
        < ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x) :
    ∃ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, ∀ e : E, (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∉ Bad e

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_piFinset_forall_not_mem_bad_cost_le
statement:
theorem exists_piFinset_forall_not_mem_bad_cost_le {E : Type*} [Fintype E]
    (t : ι → Finset β) (wt : β → ℝ) (hwt : ∀ x, 0 ≤ wt x)
    (i₁ i₂ : E → ι) (hne : ∀ e, i₁ e ≠ i₂ e) (Bad : E → Finset (β × β))
    (cost : (ι → β) → ℝ) (hcost : ∀ g, 0 ≤ cost g) {σ μ : ℝ} (hσ : σ < 1)
    (hWpos : 0 < ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x)
    (hbad : ∑ e : E, ∑ p ∈ Bad e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2
          * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x
        ≤ σ * ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x)
    (hexp : ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, (∏ j, wt (g j)) * cost g
        ≤ μ * ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x) :
    ∃ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t,
      (∀ e : E, (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∉ Bad e) ∧ cost g ≤ μ / (1 - σ)

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_filter_pair_mem_eq_badCount
statement:
theorem sum_filter_pair_mem_eq_badCount {E : Type*} [Fintype E]
    (t : ι → Finset β) (wt : β → ℝ) (i₁ i₂ : E → ι) (Bad : E → Finset (β × β)) :
    ∑ e : E, ∑ g ∈ (Fintype.piFinset t).filter
        (fun g => (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∈ Bad e), ∏ j, wt (g j)
      = ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t,
          ((Finset.univ.filter
            (fun e : E => (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∈ Bad e)).card : ℝ)
            * ∏ j, wt (g j)

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_piFinset_filter_pair_mem
statement:
theorem sum_piFinset_filter_pair_mem (t : ι → Finset β) (wt : β → ℝ) {i₁ i₂ : ι}
    (hne : i₁ ≠ i₂) (B : Finset (β × β)) :
    ∑ g ∈ (Fintype.piFinset t).filter (fun g => (g i₁, g i₂) ∈ B), ∏ j, wt (g j)
      = ∑ p ∈ B ∩ (t i₁ ×ˢ t i₂), wt p.1 * wt p.2
          * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i₁).erase i₂, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_piFinset_pinned_two
statement:
theorem sum_piFinset_pinned_two (t : ι → Finset β) (wt : β → ℝ) {i₁ i₂ : ι}
    (hne : i₁ ≠ i₂) {a b : β} (ha : a ∈ t i₁) (hb : b ∈ t i₂) :
    ∑ g ∈ (Fintype.piFinset t).filter (fun g => g i₁ = a ∧ g i₂ = b), ∏ j, wt (g j)
      = wt a * wt b
        * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i₁).erase i₂, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_piFinset_weight_mul_eventCost
statement:
theorem sum_piFinset_weight_mul_eventCost {E : Type*} [Fintype E]
    (t : ι → Finset β) (wt : β → ℝ) (i₁ i₂ : E → ι) (hne : ∀ e, i₁ e ≠ i₂ e)
    (Dev : E → Finset (β × β)) (w : E → ℝ) :
    ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, (∏ j, wt (g j))
        * (∑ e : E, if (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∈ Dev e then w e else 0)
      = ∑ e : E, w e * ∑ p ∈ Dev e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2
          * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_piFinset_weight_mul_eventCost_le
statement:
theorem sum_piFinset_weight_mul_eventCost_le {E : Type*} [Fintype E]
    (t : ι → Finset β) (wt : β → ℝ) (hwt : ∀ x, 0 ≤ wt x)
    (i₁ i₂ : E → ι) (hne : ∀ e, i₁ e ≠ i₂ e)
    (Dev : E → Finset (β × β)) (w μe : E → ℝ)
    (hμe : ∀ e : E, w e * ∑ p ∈ Dev e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2
        ≤ μe e * ((∑ x ∈ t (i₁ e), wt x) * ∑ x ∈ t (i₂ e), wt x)) :
    ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, (∏ j, wt (g j))
        * (∑ e : E, if (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∈ Dev e then w e else 0)
      ≤ (∑ e : E, μe e) * ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_event_mass_le_of_weight_floor
statement:
theorem sum_event_mass_le_of_weight_floor {E : Type*} [Fintype E]
    (t : ι → Finset β) (wt : β → ℝ) (hwt : ∀ x, 0 ≤ wt x)
    (i₁ i₂ : E → ι) (hne : ∀ e, i₁ e ≠ i₂ e) (Bad : E → Finset (β × β))
    {w₀ : ℝ} (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) (hW : ∀ j, w₀ ≤ ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x) :
    ∑ e : E, ∑ p ∈ Bad e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2
          * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (i₁ e)).erase (i₂ e), ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x
      ≤ (∑ e : E, ∑ p ∈ Bad e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2) / w₀ ^ 2
        * ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_le_sum_of_exists_mem
statement:
theorem sum_le_sum_of_exists_mem {γ κ : Type*} [DecidableEq γ] [Fintype κ]
    (S : Finset γ) (T : κ → Finset γ) (f : γ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hcov : ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ k, x ∈ T k) :
    ∑ x ∈ S, f x ≤ ∑ k, ∑ x ∈ T k, f x

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_piFinset_weight_mul_eventCost_le_of_weight_floor
statement:
theorem sum_piFinset_weight_mul_eventCost_le_of_weight_floor {E : Type*} [Fintype E]
    (t : ι → Finset β) (wt : β → ℝ) (hwt : ∀ x, 0 ≤ wt x)
    (i₁ i₂ : E → ι) (hne : ∀ e, i₁ e ≠ i₂ e) (Dev : E → Finset (β × β))
    {w₀ A : ℝ} (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) (hW : ∀ j, w₀ ≤ ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x)
    (hagg : ∑ e : E, ∑ p ∈ Dev e ∩ (t (i₁ e) ×ˢ t (i₂ e)), wt p.1 * wt p.2 ≤ A) :
    ∑ g ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, (∏ j, wt (g j))
        * (∑ e : E, if (g (i₁ e), g (i₂ e)) ∈ Dev e then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
      ≤ A / w₀ ^ 2 * ∏ j, ∑ x ∈ t j, wt x

theorem variance_eq_sum_blockEnergy_sub [DecidableEq α] (R : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel R]
    {C D : Finset α} (sC sD : Finset (Finset α))
    (hCdisj : (sC : Set (Finset α)).PairwiseDisjoint id) (hCcover : sC.biUnion id = C)
    (hDdisj : (sD : Set (Finset α)).PairwiseDisjoint id) (hDcover : sD.biUnion id = D) :
    ∑ p ∈ sC ×ˢ sD, ((p.1.card : ℝ) * p.2.card)
        * (pairDensity R p.1 p.2 - pairDensity R C D) ^ 2
      = (∑ p ∈ sC ×ˢ sD, blockEnergy R p.1 p.2) - blockEnergy R C D

name: RegularityLemmata.NonuniformWitness.card_mul_pos
statement:
theorem NonuniformWitness.card_mul_pos {A B : Finset α} (w : NonuniformWitness R A B ε)
    (hε : 0 < ε) : 0 < (w.left.card : ℝ) * (w.right.card : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.NonuniformWitness.pow_four_mul_le
statement:
theorem NonuniformWitness.pow_four_mul_le {A B : Finset α} (w : NonuniformWitness R A B ε)
    (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ε ^ 4 * (A.card : ℝ) * (B.card : ℝ)
      ≤ (w.left.card : ℝ) * (w.right.card : ℝ)
        * (pairDensity R w.left w.right - pairDensity R A B) ^ 2

name: RegularityLemmata.blockEnergy_increment
statement:
theorem blockEnergy_increment [DecidableEq α] {A B : Finset α}
    (w : NonuniformWitness R A B ε) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    blockEnergy R A B + ε ^ 4 * (A.card : ℝ) * (B.card : ℝ)
      ≤ blockEnergy R w.left w.right + blockEnergy R w.left (B \ w.right)
        + blockEnergy R (A \ w.left) w.right + blockEnergy R (A \ w.left) (B \ w.right)

name: RegularityLemmata.blockEnergy_increment_general
statement:
theorem blockEnergy_increment_general [DecidableEq α] {A B A' B' : Finset α}
    (hA' : A' ⊆ A) (hB' : B' ⊆ B) (hpos : 0 < (A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ)) :
    blockEnergy R A B
        + (A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ) * (pairDensity R A' B' - pairDensity R A B) ^ 2
      ≤ blockEnergy R A' B' + blockEnergy R A' (B \ B')
        + blockEnergy R (A \ A') B' + blockEnergy R (A \ A') (B \ B')

name: RegularityLemmata.blockEnergy_increment_refined
statement:
theorem blockEnergy_increment_refined [DecidableEq α] {s : Finset α}
    {P' : Finpartition s} (R : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel R] {C D : Finset α} {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (w : NonuniformWitness R C D ε)
    (hCU : IsPartUnion P' C) (hDU : IsPartUnion P' D)
    (hlU : IsPartUnion P' w.left) (hrU : IsPartUnion P' w.right) :
    blockEnergy R C D + ε ^ 4 * (C.card : ℝ) * (D.card : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ C' ∈ P'.parts.filter (· ⊆ C), ∑ D' ∈ P'.parts.filter (· ⊆ D),
        blockEnergy R C' D'

name: RegularityLemmata.blockEnergy_increment_refined_general
statement:
theorem blockEnergy_increment_refined_general [DecidableEq α] {s : Finset α}
    {P' : Finpartition s} (R : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel R] {C D A' B' : Finset α}
    (hA' : A' ⊆ C) (hB' : B' ⊆ D) (hpos : 0 < (A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ))
    (hCU : IsPartUnion P' C) (hDU : IsPartUnion P' D)
    (hlU : IsPartUnion P' A') (hrU : IsPartUnion P' B') :
    blockEnergy R C D
        + (A'.card : ℝ) * (B'.card : ℝ) * (pairDensity R A' B' - pairDensity R C D) ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ C' ∈ P'.parts.filter (· ⊆ C), ∑ D' ∈ P'.parts.filter (· ⊆ D),
        blockEnergy R C' D'

name: RegularityLemmata.energyNum_increment_of_pairwise_gain
statement:
theorem energyNum_increment_of_pairwise_gain {P P' : Finpartition s} (hP' : P' ≤ P) {g : ℝ}
    (hpair : ∀ C ∈ P.parts, ∀ D ∈ P.parts, IsBadPair R ε C D →
      blockEnergy R C D + g * ((C.card : ℝ) * (D.card : ℝ))
        ≤ ∑ C' ∈ P'.parts.filter (· ⊆ C), ∑ D' ∈ P'.parts.filter (· ⊆ D),
            blockEnergy R C' D') :
    energyNum R P + g * badMassNum R ε P ≤ energyNum R P'

name: RegularityLemmata.energy_increment_of_badMass
statement:
theorem energy_increment_of_badMass {P P' : Finpartition s} (hP' : P' ≤ P) (hε : 0 < ε)

      ∃ w : NonuniformWitness R C D ε, IsPartUnion P' w.left ∧ IsPartUnion P' w.right)
    (hbm : ε < badMass R ε P) :
    energy R P + ε ^ 5 ≤ energy R P'

name: RegularityLemmata.energy_increment_of_pairwise_gain
statement:
theorem energy_increment_of_pairwise_gain {P P' : Finpartition s} (hP' : P' ≤ P)
    (hε : 0 < ε) {g : ℝ} (hg : 0 ≤ g)
    (hpair : ∀ C ∈ P.parts, ∀ D ∈ P.parts, IsBadPair R ε C D →
      blockEnergy R C D + g * ((C.card : ℝ) * (D.card : ℝ))
        ≤ ∑ C' ∈ P'.parts.filter (· ⊆ C), ∑ D' ∈ P'.parts.filter (· ⊆ D),
            blockEnergy R C' D')
    (hbm : ε < badMass R ε P) :
    energy R P + g * ε ≤ energy R P'

statement:
theorem exists_regular_refinement_and_almostRefining_equipartition [DecidableEq α]
    (R : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (P₀ : Finpartition s) (hε : 0 < ε)
    {t : ℕ} (ht : 0 < t) (hts : t ≤ s.card)
    (hbound : ((s.card / t : ℕ) : ℝ) * regularityBound ⌈1 / ε ^ 5⌉₊ P₀.parts.card
      ≤ ε * s.card) :
    ∃ Q E : Finpartition s, Q ≤ P₀ ∧ IsRegularPartition R ε Q ∧
      Q.parts.card ≤ regularityBound ⌈1 / ε ^ 5⌉₊ P₀.parts.card ∧
      E.IsEquipartition ∧ E.parts.card = t ∧
      AlmostRefines E Q ε ∧ AlmostRefines E P₀ ε

    ∃ Q E : Finpartition s, Q ≤ P₀ ∧ IsRegularPartition R ε Q ∧
      Q.parts.card ≤ regularityBound ⌈1 / ε ^ 5⌉₊ P₀.parts.card ∧
      E.IsEquipartition ∧
      E.parts.card = ⌈(regularityBound ⌈1 / ε ^ 5⌉₊ P₀.parts.card : ℝ) / ε⌉₊ ∧
      AlmostRefines E Q ε ∧ AlmostRefines E P₀ ε

      + (chunkRem P + 1) * (chunkSize P + 1) = C.card

RegularityLemmata.blockEnergy_equitableIncrement_gain
statement:
theorem blockEnergy_equitableIncrement_gain (hP : P.IsEquipartition)
    {C D : Finset α} (hC : C ∈ P.parts) (hD : D ∈ P.parts) (hbad : IsBadPair R ε C D)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδε : δ ≤ ε)
    (hrC : (chunkWitnessRemainder P : ℝ) < ε * (C.card : ℝ))
    (hrD : (chunkWitnessRemainder P : ℝ) < ε * (D.card : ℝ))
    (hδbound : (chunkWitnessRemainder P : ℝ) * (D.card : ℝ)
        + (C.card : ℝ) * (chunkWitnessRemainder P : ℝ)
      ≤ δ * ((ε * (C.card : ℝ) - (chunkWitnessRemainder P : ℝ))
          * (ε * (D.card : ℝ) - (chunkWitnessRemainder P : ℝ)))) :
    blockEnergy R C D
        + (ε * (C.card : ℝ) - (chunkWitnessRemainder P : ℝ))
          * (ε * (D.card : ℝ) - (chunkWitnessRemainder P : ℝ)) * (ε - δ) ^ 2
      ≤ ∑ C' ∈ (equitableIncrement R ε hP).parts.filter (· ⊆ C),
          ∑ D' ∈ (equitableIncrement R ε hP).parts.filter (· ⊆ D), blockEnergy R C' D'

name: RegularityLemmata.blockEnergy_equitableIncrement_gain_of_retained
statement:
theorem blockEnergy_equitableIncrement_gain_of_retained (hP : P.IsEquipartition)
    {C D : Finset α} (hC : C ∈ P.parts) (hD : D ∈ P.parts) (hbad : IsBadPair R ε C D)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδε : δ ≤ ε)
    (hrC : (chunkWitnessRemainder P : ℝ) < ε * (C.card : ℝ))
    (hrD : (chunkWitnessRemainder P : ℝ) < ε * (D.card : ℝ))
    (hδbound : (chunkWitnessRemainder P : ℝ) * (D.card : ℝ)
        + (C.card : ℝ) * (chunkWitnessRemainder P : ℝ)
      ≤ δ * ((ε * (C.card : ℝ) - (chunkWitnessRemainder P : ℝ))
          * (ε * (D.card : ℝ) - (chunkWitnessRemainder P : ℝ))))
    {c : ℝ}
    (hretain : c * (ε ^ 4 * (C.card : ℝ) * (D.card : ℝ))
      ≤ (ε * (C.card : ℝ) - (chunkWitnessRemainder P : ℝ))
        * (ε * (D.card : ℝ) - (chunkWitnessRemainder P : ℝ)) * (ε - δ) ^ 2) :
    blockEnergy R C D + c * (ε ^ 4 * (C.card : ℝ) * (D.card : ℝ))
      ≤ ∑ C' ∈ (equitableIncrement R ε hP).parts.filter (· ⊆ C),
          ∑ D' ∈ (equitableIncrement R ε hP).parts.filter (· ⊆ D), blockEnergy R C' D'

name: RegularityLemmata.blockEnergy_equitableIncrement_retained
statement:
theorem blockEnergy_equitableIncrement_retained (hP : P.IsEquipartition) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) {l : ℕ}
    (hfloor : familyInitialBound familyChunkThreshold ε l ≤ P.parts.card)
    {C D : Finset α} (hC : C ∈ P.parts) (hD : D ∈ P.parts) (hbad : IsBadPair R ε C D) :
    blockEnergy R C D
        + familyRetainedFraction * ε ^ 4 * ((C.card : ℝ) * (D.card : ℝ))
      ≤ ∑ C' ∈ (equitableIncrement R ε hP).parts.filter (· ⊆ C),
          ∑ D' ∈ (equitableIncrement R ε hP).parts.filter (· ⊆ D), blockEnergy R C' D'

    {C : Finset α} (hC : C ∈ P.parts) :

statement:

    (hfloor : familyInitialBound familyChunkThreshold ε l ≤ P.parts.card)

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_familyEnergy_increment_equitable
statement:
theorem exists_familyEnergy_increment_equitable (Rk : Fin K → α → α → Prop)
    [∀ k, DecidableRel (Rk k)] (hP : P.IsEquipartition) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) {l : ℕ}
    (hfloor : familyInitialBound familyChunkThreshold ε l ≤ P.parts.card)
    (hs : familyStepBound P.parts.card ≤ s.card)
    (hreg : ¬ IsFamilyRegular Rk ε P) :
    ∃ Q : Finpartition s, Q ≤ P ∧ Q.IsEquipartition
      ∧ Q.parts.card = familyStepBound P.parts.card
      ∧ familyEnergy Rk P + familyRetainedFraction * ε ^ 5 ≤ familyEnergy Rk Q

name: RegularityLemmata.familyEnergy_equitableIncrement_increment
statement:

    (hfloor : familyInitialBound familyChunkThreshold ε l ≤ P.parts.card) (k : Fin K)
    (hbm : ε < badMass (Rk k) ε P) :

name: RegularityLemmata.familyRegularity_iterate
statement:
theorem familyRegularity_iterate (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) {l : ℕ} :
    ∀ (t : ℕ) (P : Finpartition s), P.IsEquipartition →
      familyInitialBound familyChunkThreshold ε l ≤ P.parts.card →
      familyRegularityBoundAux t P.parts.card ≤ s.card →
      (K : ℝ) - (t : ℝ) * (familyRetainedFraction * ε ^ 5) ≤ familyEnergy Rk P →
      ∃ Q : Finpartition s, Q ≤ P ∧ Q.IsEquipartition ∧ IsFamilyRegular Rk ε Q ∧
        familyInitialBound familyChunkThreshold ε l ≤ Q.parts.card ∧
        Q.parts.card ≤ familyRegularityBoundAux t P.parts.card

          (fun p => η < |pairDensity R p.1 p.2 - pairDensity R pd.1 pd.2|),

      ∀ A ⊆ s, ∀ B ⊆ s,
        |(pairCount R A B : ℝ) - steppedCount R P A B| ≤ ε * (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2

name: RegularityLemmata.one_sub_rounds_mul_sq_le_energy
statement:
theorem one_sub_rounds_mul_sq_le_energy (P : Finpartition s) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    1 - ((⌈1 / ε ^ 2⌉₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 ≤ energy R P

name: RegularityLemmata.refineByCuts_le
statement:
theorem refineByCuts_le (P : Finpartition s) (A B : Finset α) :
    refineByCuts P A B ≤ P

name: RegularityLemmata.refineByCuts_parts_card_le
statement:
theorem refineByCuts_parts_card_le (P : Finpartition s) (A B : Finset α) :
    (refineByCuts P A B).parts.card ≤ 4 * P.parts.card

name: RegularityLemmata.refineByCuts_subset_or_disjoint
RegularityLemmata.abs_directedPathCount_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_directedPathCount_sub_le (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (h01 : IsUniformPair R₀₁ A B ε) (h12 : IsUniformPair R₁₂ B C ε) :
    |(directedPathCount R₀₁ R₁₂ A B C : ℝ)
        - pairDensity R₀₁ A B * pairDensity R₁₂ B C * A.card * B.card * C.card|
      ≤ 6 * ε * A.card * B.card * C.card

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_directedPathDensity_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_directedPathDensity_sub_le (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (h01 : IsUniformPair R₀₁ A B ε) (h12 : IsUniformPair R₁₂ B C ε) :
    |directedPathDensity R₀₁ R₁₂ A B C
        - pairDensity R₀₁ A B * pairDensity R₁₂ B C| ≤ 6 * ε

name: RegularityLemmata.directedPathCount_eq_sum
statement:
theorem directedPathCount_eq_sum (A B C : Finset α) :
    directedPathCount R₀₁ R₁₂ A B C
      = ∑ b ∈ B, (A.filter fun a => R₀₁ a b).card * (C.filter fun c => R₁₂ b c).card

name: RegularityLemmata.directedPathDensity_eq
statement:
theorem directedPathDensity_eq (A B C : Finset α) :
    directedPathDensity R₀₁ R₁₂ A B C
      = (∑ b ∈ B, degreeDensity (swapRel R₀₁) b A * degreeDensity R₁₂ b C) / B.card

name: RegularityLemmata.IsUniformPair.slice
statement:
theorem IsUniformPair.slice (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (h : IsUniformPair R A B ε)
    (hWA : WA ⊆ A) (hWB : WB ⊆ B) (hκA : ε ≤ κA) (hκB : ε ≤ κB)
    (hA : κA * (A.card : ℝ) ≤ (WA.card : ℝ))
    (hB : κB * (B.card : ℝ) ≤ (WB.card : ℝ))
    (hε'A : ε ≤ ε' * κA) (hε'B : ε ≤ ε' * κB) (hε2 : 2 * ε ≤ ε') :
    IsUniformPair R WA WB ε'

name: RegularityLemmata.IsUniformPair.slice_density_close
statement:
theorem IsUniformPair.slice_density_close (h : IsUniformPair R A B ε)
    (hWA : WA ⊆ A) (hWB : WB ⊆ B) (hκA : ε ≤ κA) (hκB : ε ≤ κB)
    (hA : κA * (A.card : ℝ) ≤ (WA.card : ℝ))
    (hB : κB * (B.card : ℝ) ≤ (WB.card : ℝ)) :
    |pairDensity R WA WB - pairDensity R A B| ≤ ε

name: RegularityLemmata.card_le_of_forall_isBadPair
statement:
theorem card_le_of_forall_isBadPair (hP : P.IsEquipartition)
    (hm : 0 < A.card / P.parts.card) (k : Fin K) (hreg : IsRegularPartition (Rk k) ρ P)
    (F : Finset (Finset V × Finset V)) (hFsub : F ⊆ P.parts ×ˢ P.parts)
    (hFbad : ∀ p ∈ F, IsBadPair (Rk k) ρ p.1 p.2) :
    (F.card : ℝ) ≤ 4 * ρ * (P.parts.card : ℝ) ^ 2

name: RegularityLemmata.card_le_two_mul_card_parts_mul
statement:
theorem card_le_two_mul_card_parts_mul (hP : P.IsEquipartition)
    (hm : 0 < A.card / P.parts.card) :
    (A.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (P.parts.card : ℝ) * ((A.card / P.parts.card : ℕ) : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_part_bounds
statement:
theorem card_part_bounds (hP : P.IsEquipartition) {C : Finset V} (hC : C ∈ P.parts) :
    A.card / P.parts.card ≤ C.card ∧ C.card ≤ A.card / P.parts.card + 1

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_clean_cells
statement:
theorem exists_clean_cells (hP : P.IsEquipartition) (hm : 0 < A.card / P.parts.card)
    (hreg : IsFamilyRegular Rk ρ P) {t : ℕ} (ht : 0 < t)
    (hρK : ρ ≤ 1 / (64 * ((K : ℝ) + 1) * (t : ℝ))) (hl : 4 * t ≤ P.parts.card) :
    ∃ T ⊆ P.parts, t ≤ T.card ∧
      ∀ C ∈ T, ∀ D ∈ T, C ≠ D → ¬ IsFamilyBadPair Rk ρ C D

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_pieceFamily_of_familyRegular
statement:
theorem exists_pieceFamily_of_familyRegular (hP : P.IsEquipartition)
    (hm : 0 < A.card / P.parts.card) (hreg : IsFamilyRegular Rk ρ P)
    {t : ℕ} (ht : 0 < t) (hρ0 : 0 < ρ) (hρhalf : ρ ≤ 1 / 2) (hρτ : 2 * ρ ≤ τ)
    (hρK : ρ ≤ 1 / (64 * ((K : ℝ) + 1) * (t : ℝ))) (hl : 4 * t ≤ P.parts.card) :
    ∃ Pc : Fin t → Finset V, IsPieceFamily Rk A τ (A.card / P.parts.card) Pc

name: RegularityLemmata.isUniformPair_of_not_isFamilyBadPair
statement:
theorem isUniformPair_of_not_isFamilyBadPair {C D : Finset V} (hCD : C ≠ D)
    (h : ¬ IsFamilyBadPair Rk ρ C D) (k : Fin K) : IsUniformPair (Rk k) C D ρ

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_card_badNbhd_le
statement:
theorem sum_card_badNbhd_le (hP : P.IsEquipartition) (hm : 0 < A.card / P.parts.card)
    (hreg : IsFamilyRegular Rk ρ P) :
    ((∑ C ∈ P.parts, (badNbhd (IsFamilyBadPair Rk ρ) P.parts C).card : ℕ) : ℝ)
      ≤ 8 * (K : ℝ) * ρ * (P.parts.card : ℝ) ^ 2

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_pieceFamily
statement:
theorem exists_pieceFamily {K t : ℕ} (ht : 0 < t) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (Rk : Fin K → V → V → Prop) [∀ k, DecidableRel (Rk k)] (A : Finset V)
    (hA : supplierThreshold K t τ ≤ A.card) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧ ∃ Pc : Fin t → Finset V,
      IsPieceFamily Rk A τ m Pc
        ∧ supplierRetention K t τ * (A.card : ℝ) ≤ (t : ℝ) * (m : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.pieceSupplier
statement:
theorem pieceSupplier (K t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t) (τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    ∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ,
      ∀ (Rk : Fin K → V → V → Prop) [∀ k, DecidableRel (Rk k)] (A : Finset V),
        N₀ ≤ A.card →
          ∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧ ∃ Pc : Fin t → Finset V,
            IsPieceFamily Rk A τ m Pc ∧ κ * (A.card : ℝ) ≤ (t : ℝ) * (m : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.supplierBound_pos
statement: theorem supplierBound_pos : 0 < supplierBound K t τ

name: RegularityLemmata.supplierParts_pos
statement: theorem supplierParts_pos (ht : 0 < t) : 0 < supplierParts t

name: RegularityLemmata.supplierRetention_pos
statement: theorem supplierRetention_pos (ht : 0 < t) : 0 < supplierRetention K t τ

name: RegularityLemmata.supplierTolerance_le_bound
statement:
theorem supplierTolerance_le_bound :
    supplierTolerance K t τ ≤ 1 / (64 * ((K : ℝ) + 1) * (t : ℝ))

name: RegularityLemmata.supplierTolerance_le_half
statement: theorem supplierTolerance_le_half (ht : 0 < t) : supplierTolerance K t τ ≤ 1 / 2

name: RegularityLemmata.supplierTolerance_le_half_target
statement: theorem supplierTolerance_le_half_target : supplierTolerance K t τ ≤ τ / 2

name: RegularityLemmata.supplierTolerance_pos
statement: theorem supplierTolerance_pos (ht : 0 < t) (hτ : 0 < τ) : 0 < supplierTolerance K t τ

name: RegularityLemmata.two_mul_supplierTolerance_le
statement: theorem two_mul_supplierTolerance_le : 2 * supplierTolerance K t τ ≤ τ

name: RegularityLemmata.diagWitnessCuts_card_le
statement:
theorem diagWitnessCuts_card_le (P : Finpartition s) (C : Finset α) :
    (diagWitnessCuts R ε P C).card ≤ 2 * P.parts.card

name: RegularityLemmata.diagWitnessCuts_subset
statement:
theorem diagWitnessCuts_subset (P : Finpartition s) {C : Finset α}
    {b : Finset α} (hb : b ∈ diagWitnessCuts R ε P C) : b ⊆ C

name: RegularityLemmata.diagWitnessRefinement_le
statement:
theorem diagWitnessRefinement_le (P : Finpartition s) :
    diagWitnessRefinement R ε P ≤ P

name: RegularityLemmata.diagWitnessRefinement_parts_card_le
statement:
theorem diagWitnessRefinement_parts_card_le (P : Finpartition s) :
    (diagWitnessRefinement R ε P).parts.card
      ≤ P.parts.card * 2 ^ (2 * P.parts.card)

name: RegularityLemmata.diagWitnessRefinement_resolves
statement:
theorem diagWitnessRefinement_resolves (P : Finpartition s) :
    ∀ C ∈ P.parts, ∀ D ∈ P.parts, IsBadPairDiag R ε C D →
      ∃ w : NonuniformWitness R C D ε,
        IsPartUnion (diagWitnessRefinement R ε P) w.left ∧
        IsPartUnion (diagWitnessRefinement R ε P) w.right

name: RegularityLemmata.energyNum_increment_of_badMassDiagNum
statement:
theorem energyNum_increment_of_badMassDiagNum {P P' : Finpartition s} (hP' : P' ≤ P)
    (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hwit : ∀ C ∈ P.parts, ∀ D ∈ P.parts, IsBadPairDiag R ε C D →
      ∃ w : NonuniformWitness R C D ε, IsPartUnion P' w.left ∧ IsPartUnion P' w.right) :
    energyNum R P + ε ^ 4 * badMassDiagNum R ε P ≤ energyNum R P'

name: RegularityLemmata.energy_increment_of_badMassDiag
statement:
theorem energy_increment_of_badMassDiag {P P' : Finpartition s} (hP' : P' ≤ P)
    (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hwit : ∀ C ∈ P.parts, ∀ D ∈ P.parts, IsBadPairDiag R ε C D →
      ∃ w : NonuniformWitness R C D ε, IsPartUnion P' w.left ∧ IsPartUnion P' w.right)
    (hbm : ε < badMassDiag R ε P) :
    energy R P + ε ^ 5 ≤ energy R P'

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_refinement_energy_increment_diag
statement:
theorem exists_refinement_energy_increment_diag (P : Finpartition s) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hbm : ε < badMassDiag R ε P) :
    ∃ Q : Finpartition s, Q ≤ P ∧ energy R P + ε ^ 5 ≤ energy R Q ∧
      Q.parts.card ≤ P.parts.card * 2 ^ (2 * P.parts.card)

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_regularDiag_refinement
statement:
theorem exists_regularDiag_refinement (P : Finpartition s) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ Q : Finpartition s, Q ≤ P ∧ IsRegularPartitionDiag R ε Q ∧
      Q.parts.card ≤ regularityBound ⌈1 / ε ^ 5⌉₊ P.parts.card

name: RegularityLemmata.regularityDiag_iterate
statement:
theorem regularityDiag_iterate (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ (t : ℕ) (P : Finpartition s), 1 - (t : ℝ) * ε ^ 5 ≤ energy R P →
      ∃ Q : Finpartition s, Q ≤ P ∧ IsRegularPartitionDiag R ε Q ∧
        Q.parts.card ≤ regularityBound t P.parts.card

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_adj_of_le
statement:
theorem editDistance_adj_of_le {G G' : SimpleGraph α} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    [DecidableRel G'.Adj] (h : G' ≤ G) :
    editDistance (fun x : Fin 2 → α => G.Adj (x 0) (x 1))
        (fun x => G'.Adj (x 0) (x 1)) (fun _ => Finset.univ)
      = 2 * G.edgeFinset.card - 2 * G'.edgeFinset.card

name: RegularityLemmata.farFromTriangleFree_le_card_cliqueFinset
statement:
theorem farFromTriangleFree_le_card_cliqueFinset {G : SimpleGraph α} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hG : G.FarFromTriangleFree ε) :
    SimpleGraph.triangleRemovalBound ε * Fintype.card α ^ 3 ≤ (G.cliqueFinset 3).card

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_adj_eq_two_mul_card_edgeFinset
statement:
theorem pairCount_adj_eq_two_mul_card_edgeFinset (G : SimpleGraph α)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] :
    pairCount G.Adj Finset.univ Finset.univ = 2 * G.edgeFinset.card

name: RegularityLemmata.relativeEditDistance_adj_of_le
statement:
theorem relativeEditDistance_adj_of_le {G G' : SimpleGraph α} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    [DecidableRel G'.Adj] (h : G' ≤ G) :
    relativeEditDistance (fun x : Fin 2 → α => G.Adj (x 0) (x 1))
        (fun x => G'.Adj (x 0) (x 1)) (fun _ => Finset.univ)
      = ((2 * G.edgeFinset.card - 2 * G'.edgeFinset.card : ℕ) : ℝ)
          / (Fintype.card α : ℝ) ^ 2

name: RegularityLemmata.triangle_removal_of_card_cliqueFinset_lt
statement:
theorem triangle_removal_of_card_cliqueFinset_lt {G : SimpleGraph α} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hG : ((G.cliqueFinset 3).card : ℝ)
      < SimpleGraph.triangleRemovalBound ε * Fintype.card α ^ 3) :
    ∃ G' ≤ G, ∃ _ : DecidableRel G'.Adj,
      ((G.edgeFinset.card : ℝ) - G'.edgeFinset.card) < ε * (Fintype.card α ^ 2 : ℕ)
        ∧ G'.CliqueFree 3

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_directedTriangleCount_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_directedTriangleCount_sub_le (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (h01 : IsUniformPair R₀₁ A B ε) (h02 : IsUniformPair R₀₂ A C ε)
    (h12 : IsUniformPair R₁₂ B C ε) :
    |(directedTriangleCount R₀₁ R₀₂ R₁₂ A B C : ℝ)
        - pairDensity R₀₁ A B * pairDensity R₀₂ A C * pairDensity R₁₂ B C
            * A.card * B.card * C.card|
      ≤ 7 * ε * A.card * B.card * C.card

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_directedTriangleDensity_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_directedTriangleDensity_sub_le (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (h01 : IsUniformPair R₀₁ A B ε) (h02 : IsUniformPair R₀₂ A C ε)
    (h12 : IsUniformPair R₁₂ B C ε) :
    |directedTriangleDensity R₀₁ R₀₂ R₁₂ A B C
        - pairDensity R₀₁ A B * pairDensity R₀₂ A C * pairDensity R₁₂ B C| ≤ 7 * ε

name: RegularityLemmata.directedTriangleCount_eq_sum
statement:
theorem directedTriangleCount_eq_sum (A B C : Finset α) :
    directedTriangleCount R₀₁ R₀₂ R₁₂ A B C
      = ∑ a ∈ A, pairCount R₁₂ (B.filter (R₀₁ a ·)) (C.filter (R₀₂ a ·))

name: RegularityLemmata.directedTriangleCount_ge
statement:
theorem directedTriangleCount_ge (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (h01 : IsUniformPair R₀₁ A B ε) (h02 : IsUniformPair R₀₂ A C ε)
    (h12 : IsUniformPair R₁₂ B C ε) :
    pairDensity R₀₁ A B * pairDensity R₀₂ A C * pairDensity R₁₂ B C * A.card * B.card * C.card
        - 7 * ε * A.card * B.card * C.card
      ≤ directedTriangleCount R₀₁ R₀₂ R₁₂ A B C

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_noninjective_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_noninjective_le (A B C : Finset α) :
    ((Fintype.piFinset ![A, B, C]).filter fun x =>
        directedTriangleObs R₀₁ R₀₂ R₁₂ x ∧ ¬ Function.Injective x).card
      ≤ (A ∩ B).card * C.card + (A ∩ C).card * B.card + A.card * (B ∩ C).card

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_piFinset_one_eq_two_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_piFinset_one_eq_two_le (A B C : Finset α) :
    ((Fintype.piFinset ![A, B, C]).filter fun x => x 1 = x 2).card
      ≤ A.card * (B ∩ C).card

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_piFinset_zero_eq_one_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_piFinset_zero_eq_one_le (A B C : Finset α) :
    ((Fintype.piFinset ![A, B, C]).filter fun x => x 0 = x 1).card
      ≤ (A ∩ B).card * C.card

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_piFinset_zero_eq_two_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_piFinset_zero_eq_two_le (A B C : Finset α) :
    ((Fintype.piFinset ![A, B, C]).filter fun x => x 0 = x 2).card
      ≤ (A ∩ C).card * B.card

name: RegularityLemmata.directedTriangleCount_eq_injective_add_noninjective
statement:
theorem directedTriangleCount_eq_injective_add_noninjective (A B C : Finset α) :
    directedTriangleCount R₀₁ R₀₂ R₁₂ A B C
      = injectiveTriangleCount R₀₁ R₀₂ R₁₂ A B C
        + ((Fintype.piFinset ![A, B, C]).filter fun x =>
            directedTriangleObs R₀₁ R₀₂ R₁₂ x ∧ ¬ Function.Injective x).card

name: RegularityLemmata.injectiveTriangleCount_ge
statement:
theorem injectiveTriangleCount_ge {A B C : Finset α} (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (h01 : IsUniformPair R₀₁ A B ε) (h02 : IsUniformPair R₀₂ A C ε)
    (h12 : IsUniformPair R₁₂ B C ε) :
    pairDensity R₀₁ A B * pairDensity R₀₂ A C * pairDensity R₁₂ B C
        * A.card * B.card * C.card
      - 7 * ε * A.card * B.card * C.card
      - ((A ∩ B).card * C.card + (A ∩ C).card * B.card + A.card * (B ∩ C).card)
      ≤ (injectiveTriangleCount R₀₁ R₀₂ R₁₂ A B C : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.injectiveTriangleCount_ge_allEqual
statement:
theorem injectiveTriangleCount_ge_allEqual {A : Finset α}
    (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (h01 : IsUniformPair R₀₁ A A ε) (h02 : IsUniformPair R₀₂ A A ε)
    (h12 : IsUniformPair R₁₂ A A ε) :
    pairDensity R₀₁ A A * pairDensity R₀₂ A A * pairDensity R₁₂ A A
        * A.card * A.card * A.card
      - 7 * ε * A.card * A.card * A.card
      - 3 * (A.card * A.card)
      ≤ (injectiveTriangleCount R₀₁ R₀₂ R₁₂ A A A : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.injectiveTriangleCount_ge_eq01
statement:
theorem injectiveTriangleCount_ge_eq01 {A B : Finset α} (hAB : Disjoint A B)
    (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (h01 : IsUniformPair R₀₁ A A ε) (h02 : IsUniformPair R₀₂ A B ε)
    (h12 : IsUniformPair R₁₂ A B ε) :
    pairDensity R₀₁ A A * pairDensity R₀₂ A B * pairDensity R₁₂ A B
        * A.card * A.card * B.card
      - 7 * ε * A.card * A.card * B.card
      - A.card * B.card
      ≤ (injectiveTriangleCount R₀₁ R₀₂ R₁₂ A A B : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.injectiveTriangleCount_ge_eq02
statement:
theorem injectiveTriangleCount_ge_eq02 {A B : Finset α} (hAB : Disjoint A B)
    (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (h01 : IsUniformPair R₀₁ A B ε) (h02 : IsUniformPair R₀₂ A A ε)
    (h12 : IsUniformPair R₁₂ B A ε) :
    pairDensity R₀₁ A B * pairDensity R₀₂ A A * pairDensity R₁₂ B A
        * A.card * B.card * A.card
      - 7 * ε * A.card * B.card * A.card
      - A.card * B.card
      ≤ (injectiveTriangleCount R₀₁ R₀₂ R₁₂ A B A : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.injectiveTriangleCount_ge_eq12
statement:
theorem injectiveTriangleCount_ge_eq12 {A B : Finset α} (hAB : Disjoint A B)
    (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (h01 : IsUniformPair R₀₁ A B ε) (h02 : IsUniformPair R₀₂ A B ε)
    (h12 : IsUniformPair R₁₂ B B ε) :
    pairDensity R₀₁ A B * pairDensity R₀₂ A B * pairDensity R₁₂ B B
        * A.card * B.card * B.card
      - 7 * ε * A.card * B.card * B.card
      - A.card * B.card
      ≤ (injectiveTriangleCount R₀₁ R₀₂ R₁₂ A B B : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.injectiveTriangleCount_ge_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem injectiveTriangleCount_ge_of_disjoint {A B C : Finset α}
    (hAB : Disjoint A B) (hAC : Disjoint A C) (hBC : Disjoint B C)
    (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (h01 : IsUniformPair R₀₁ A B ε) (h02 : IsUniformPair R₀₂ A C ε)
    (h12 : IsUniformPair R₁₂ B C ε) :
    pairDensity R₀₁ A B * pairDensity R₀₂ A C * pairDensity R₁₂ B C
        * A.card * B.card * C.card
      - 7 * ε * A.card * B.card * C.card
      ≤ (injectiveTriangleCount R₀₁ R₀₂ R₁₂ A B C : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.injectiveTriangleCount_le_directedTriangleCount
statement:
theorem injectiveTriangleCount_le_directedTriangleCount (A B C : Finset α) :
    injectiveTriangleCount R₀₁ R₀₂ R₁₂ A B C ≤ directedTriangleCount R₀₁ R₀₂ R₁₂ A B C

name: RegularityLemmata.injective_fin_three_iff
statement:
theorem injective_fin_three_iff {T : Fin 3 → β} :
    Function.Injective T ↔ T 0 ≠ T 1 ∧ T 0 ≠ T 2 ∧ T 1 ≠ T 2

name: RegularityLemmata.ne_of_placementClass_eq_eq01
statement:
theorem ne_of_placementClass_eq_eq01 {T : Fin 3 → β}
    (h : placementClass T = .eq01) : T 0 ≠ T 2

name: RegularityLemmata.ne_of_placementClass_eq_eq02
statement:
theorem ne_of_placementClass_eq_eq02 {T : Fin 3 → β}
    (h : placementClass T = .eq02) : T 1 ≠ T 2

name: RegularityLemmata.ne_of_placementClass_eq_eq12
statement:
theorem ne_of_placementClass_eq_eq12 {T : Fin 3 → β}
    (h : placementClass T = .eq12) : T 0 ≠ T 2

name: RegularityLemmata.placementClass_eq_allDistinct_iff
statement:
theorem placementClass_eq_allDistinct_iff {T : Fin 3 → β} :
    placementClass T = .allDistinct ↔ T 0 ≠ T 1 ∧ T 0 ≠ T 2 ∧ T 1 ≠ T 2

name: RegularityLemmata.placementClass_eq_allDistinct_iff_injective
statement:
theorem placementClass_eq_allDistinct_iff_injective {T : Fin 3 → β} :
    placementClass T = .allDistinct ↔ Function.Injective T

name: RegularityLemmata.placementClass_eq_allEqual_iff
statement:
theorem placementClass_eq_allEqual_iff {T : Fin 3 → β} :
    placementClass T = .allEqual ↔ T 0 = T 1 ∧ T 1 = T 2

name: RegularityLemmata.placementClass_eq_eq01_iff
statement:
theorem placementClass_eq_eq01_iff {T : Fin 3 → β} :
    placementClass T = .eq01 ↔ T 0 = T 1 ∧ T 1 ≠ T 2

name: RegularityLemmata.placementClass_eq_eq02_iff
statement:
theorem placementClass_eq_eq02_iff {T : Fin 3 → β} :
    placementClass T = .eq02 ↔ T 0 = T 2 ∧ T 0 ≠ T 1

name: RegularityLemmata.placementClass_eq_eq12_iff
statement:
theorem placementClass_eq_eq12_iff {T : Fin 3 → β} :
    placementClass T = .eq12 ↔ T 1 = T 2 ∧ T 0 ≠ T 1

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_placementClass_fiberwise
statement:
theorem sum_placementClass_fiberwise {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (S : Finset (Fin 3 → β)) (f : (Fin 3 → β) → M) :
    ∑ c : PlacementClass, ∑ T ∈ S.filter (fun T => placementClass T = c), f T
      = ∑ T ∈ S, f T

name: RegularityLemmata.FamilyStrongWitness.atypicalMass_le
RegularityLemmata.FamilyStrongWitness.sum_deviantMass_le
RegularityLemmata.FamilyStrongWitness.sum_refinementVarianceNum_le
statement:
theorem FamilyStrongWitness.sum_refinementVarianceNum_le
    {Rk : Fin K → α → α → Prop} [∀ k, DecidableRel (Rk k)] {E : ErrorSchedule} {δ : ℝ}
    {P₀ : Finpartition s} (w : FamilyStrongWitness Rk E δ P₀) :
    ∑ k, refinementVarianceNum (Rk k) w.fine w.coarse ≤ δ * (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2

name: RegularityLemmata.FamilyStrongWitness.threshold_lt_sum_of_not_typical
statement:
theorem FamilyStrongWitness.threshold_lt_sum_of_not_typical
    (w : FamilyStrongWitness Rk E δ P₀) {η θ : ℝ} {pd : Finset α × Finset α}
    (h : ¬ w.IsTypicalCoarsePair η θ pd) :
    θ * ((pd.1.card : ℝ) * pd.2.card)
      < ∑ k, deviantChildMass (Rk k) w.fine η pd

name: RegularityLemmata.StrongWitness.atypicalMass_le
RegularityLemmata.StrongWitness.deviantMass_le
statement:
theorem StrongWitness.deviantMass_le (w : StrongWitness R E δ P₀) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    deviantMass R w.fine w.coarse η ≤ δ / η ^ 2 * (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2

name: RegularityLemmata.deviantChildMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem deviantChildMass_nonneg {Q : Finpartition s} {η : ℝ}
    {pd : Finset α × Finset α} : 0 ≤ deviantChildMass R Q η pd

name: RegularityLemmata.deviantMass_mul_sq_le_refinementVarianceNum
statement:
theorem deviantMass_mul_sq_le_refinementVarianceNum (Q P : Finpartition s) {η : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) : deviantMass R Q P η * η ^ 2 ≤ refinementVarianceNum R Q P

name: RegularityLemmata.deviantMass_nonneg
statement: theorem deviantMass_nonneg {Q P : Finpartition s} {η : ℝ} : 0 ≤ deviantMass R Q P η

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_refinementVarianceNum_eq
statement:
theorem sum_refinementVarianceNum_eq {Q P : Finpartition s} (hQP : Q ≤ P) :
    ∑ k, refinementVarianceNum (Rk k) Q P
      = (familyEnergy Rk Q - familyEnergy Rk P) * (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_familyRegular_equipartition_triple
statement:
theorem exists_familyRegular_equipartition_triple (Rk : Fin K → α → α → Prop)
    [∀ k, DecidableRel (Rk k)] (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) (l : ℕ)
    (hs : familyRegularityBoundTriple K ε l ≤ s.card) :
    ∃ Q : Finpartition s, Q.IsEquipartition ∧ IsFamilyRegular Rk ε Q ∧
      l ≤ Q.parts.card ∧ 3 ∣ Q.parts.card ∧
      Q.parts.card ≤ familyRegularityBoundTriple K ε l

name: RegularityLemmata.familyRegularity_iterate_dvd
statement:
theorem familyRegularity_iterate_dvd (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) {l : ℕ} :
    ∀ (t : ℕ) (P : Finpartition s), P.IsEquipartition →
      familyInitialBound familyChunkThreshold ε l ≤ P.parts.card →
      3 ∣ P.parts.card →
      familyRegularityBoundAux t P.parts.card ≤ s.card →
      (K : ℝ) - (t : ℝ) * (familyRetainedFraction * ε ^ 5) ≤ familyEnergy Rk P →
      ∃ Q : Finpartition s, Q ≤ P ∧ Q.IsEquipartition ∧ IsFamilyRegular Rk ε Q ∧
        familyInitialBound familyChunkThreshold ε l ≤ Q.parts.card ∧
        3 ∣ Q.parts.card ∧
        Q.parts.card ≤ familyRegularityBoundAux t P.parts.card

name: RegularityLemmata.familyTripleSeed_le
statement:
theorem familyTripleSeed_le (C ε : ℝ) (l : ℕ) :
    familyTripleSeed C ε l ≤ familyInitialBound C ε l + 2

name: RegularityLemmata.le_familyRegularityBoundTriple
statement:
theorem le_familyRegularityBoundTriple (K : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (l : ℕ) :
    familyTripleSeed familyChunkThreshold ε l ≤ familyRegularityBoundTriple K ε l

name: RegularityLemmata.le_familyTripleSeed
statement:
theorem le_familyTripleSeed (C ε : ℝ) (l : ℕ) :
    familyInitialBound C ε l ≤ familyTripleSeed C ε l

name: RegularityLemmata.le_familyTripleSeed_of_le
statement: theorem le_familyTripleSeed_of_le (C ε : ℝ) (l : ℕ) : l ≤ familyTripleSeed C ε l

name: RegularityLemmata.three_dvd_familyRegularityBoundAux
statement:
theorem three_dvd_familyRegularityBoundAux {m : ℕ} (h : 3 ∣ m) (t : ℕ) :
    3 ∣ familyRegularityBoundAux t m

name: RegularityLemmata.three_dvd_familyRegularityBoundTriple
statement:
theorem three_dvd_familyRegularityBoundTriple (K : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (l : ℕ) :
    3 ∣ familyRegularityBoundTriple K ε l

name: RegularityLemmata.three_dvd_familyTripleSeed

name: RegularityLemmata.two_le_familyTripleSeed

name: RegularityLemmata.card_biUnion_const
statement:
theorem card_biUnion_const
    (hdisj : ∀ i j : Fin s, i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j))
    (hcard : ∀ i, (A i).card = m) :
    (Finset.univ.biUnion A).card = s * m

name: RegularityLemmata.card_eq_sum_card_inter
statement:
theorem card_eq_sum_card_inter {s : ℕ} (A : Fin s → Finset V)
    (hdisj : ∀ i j : Fin s, i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j))
    {X : Finset V} (hX : X ⊆ Finset.univ.biUnion A) :
    X.card = ∑ i : Fin s, (X ∩ A i).card

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_eq_sum_inter_fin
statement:
theorem pairCount_eq_sum_inter_fin {s : ℕ} (R : V → V → Prop) [DecidableRel R]
    (A : Fin s → Finset V) (hdisj : ∀ i j : Fin s, i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j))
    {X Y : Finset V} (hX : X ⊆ Finset.univ.biUnion A)
    (hY : Y ⊆ Finset.univ.biUnion A) :
    pairCount R X Y
      = ∑ i : Fin s, ∑ j : Fin s, pairCount R (X ∩ A i) (Y ∩ A j)

name: RegularityLemmata.pairCount_le_mul
statement:
theorem pairCount_le_mul (R : V → V → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (A B : Finset V) :
    pairCount R A B ≤ A.card * B.card

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_union_close_center
statement:
theorem pairDensity_union_close_center (hm : 0 < m) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hdisj : ∀ i j : Fin s, i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j))
    (hcard : ∀ i, (A i).card = m)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1)
    (hunif : ∀ i j : Fin s, i ≠ j → IsUniformPair R (A i) (A j) α)
    (hclose : ∀ i j : Fin s, i ≠ j → |pairDensity R (A i) (A j) - d| ≤ α)
    (hU : U = Finset.univ.biUnion A) (hX : X ⊆ U) (hY : Y ⊆ U)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hXl : ε * (U.card : ℝ) ≤ (X.card : ℝ))
    (hYl : ε * (U.card : ℝ) ≤ (Y.card : ℝ)) :
    |pairDensity R X Y - d| ≤ 2 * α + 2 * α / ε + 1 / ((s : ℝ) * ε)

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_union_self_close_center
statement:
theorem pairDensity_union_self_close_center (hm : 0 < m) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hdisj : ∀ i j : Fin s, i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j))
    (hcard : ∀ i, (A i).card = m)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1)
    (hclose : ∀ i j : Fin s, i ≠ j → |pairDensity R (A i) (A j) - d| ≤ α)
    (hU : U = Finset.univ.biUnion A) :
    |pairDensity R U U - d| ≤ α + 1 / (s : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.isUniformPair_self_union
statement:
theorem isUniformPair_self_union (hm : 0 < m) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hdisj : ∀ i j : Fin s, i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j))
    (hcard : ∀ i, (A i).card = m)
    (hunif : ∀ i j : Fin s, i ≠ j → IsUniformPair R (A i) (A j) ((ε / 3) ^ 2))
    (hclose : ∀ i j : Fin s, i ≠ j →
      |pairDensity R (A i) (A j) - d| ≤ (ε / 3) ^ 2)
    (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1) (hU : U = Finset.univ.biUnion A)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) (hsα : 2 ≤ (ε / 3) ^ 2 * (s : ℝ)) :
    IsUniformPair R U U ε

name: RegularityLemmata.pairDensity_union_sub_self_le
statement:
theorem pairDensity_union_sub_self_le (hm : 0 < m) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hdisj : ∀ i j : Fin s, i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j))
    (hcard : ∀ i, (A i).card = m)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1)
    (hunif : ∀ i j : Fin s, i ≠ j → IsUniformPair R (A i) (A j) α)
    (hclose : ∀ i j : Fin s, i ≠ j → |pairDensity R (A i) (A j) - d| ≤ α)
    (hU : U = Finset.univ.biUnion A) (hX : X ⊆ U) (hY : Y ⊆ U)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hXl : ε * (U.card : ℝ) ≤ (X.card : ℝ))
    (hYl : ε * (U.card : ℝ) ≤ (Y.card : ℝ)) :
    |pairDensity R X Y - pairDensity R U U|
      ≤ 3 * α + 2 * α / ε + 1 / ((s : ℝ) * ε) + 1 / (s : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.UniformHypergraph.card_edges_le

statement: @[simp] theorem density_empty [Fintype V] : (empty r V).density = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.UniformHypergraph.restrictedDensity_nonneg

name: RegularityLemmata.UniformHypergraph.copyCount_complete

name: RegularityLemmata.biUnion_polyadBlock
statement:

theorem card_filter_discAtom_comp_perm (κ : RSet j α → Fin K)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_lowerFaceSet
statement:

RegularityLemmata.comp_perm_mem_polyadBlock
RegularityLemmata.densityOn_discAtom_comp_perm

    (obs : (Fin (j + 1) → α) → Prop) [DecidablePred obs]

name: RegularityLemmata.discAtom_empty_family

name: RegularityLemmata.discAtom_mono
RegularityLemmata.discAtom_subset_polyadBlock

theorem discAtom_subset_polyadBlock (κ : RSet j α → Fin K)

statement:
theorem discAtom_univ (κ : RSet j α → Fin K) (key : Fin (j + 1) → Fin K) :

name: RegularityLemmata.injective_of_mem_polyadBlock
RegularityLemmata.lowerFaceSet_comp_perm

name: RegularityLemmata.lowerFaceSet_eq_image_erase
statement:
theorem lowerFaceSet_eq_image_erase (v : Fin (j + 1) → α) (i : Fin (j + 1)) :

name: RegularityLemmata.mem_discAtom
statement:
theorem mem_discAtom {κ : RSet j α → Fin K} {key : Fin (j + 1) → Fin K}
    {P : Fin (j + 1) → Finset (RSet j α)} {v : Fin (j + 1) → α} :
    v ∈ discAtom κ key P ↔ v ∈ polyadBlock κ key ∧
      ∀ (i : Fin (j + 1)) (h : (lowerFaceSet v i).card = j),
        (⟨lowerFaceSet v i, h⟩ : RSet j α) ∈ P i

name: RegularityLemmata.mem_discAtom_iff_of_injective
RegularityLemmata.mem_polyadBlock
statement:
theorem mem_polyadBlock {κ : RSet j α → Fin K} {P : Fin (j + 1) → Fin K}
    {v : Fin (j + 1) → α} :
    v ∈ polyadBlock κ P ↔ Function.Injective v ∧
      ∀ (i : Fin (j + 1)) (h : (lowerFaceSet v i).card = j),
        κ ⟨lowerFaceSet v i, h⟩ = P i

name: RegularityLemmata.mem_polyadBlock_iff_of_injective

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_polyadBlock_comp
statement:
theorem card_filter_polyadBlock_comp (f : Fin K' → Fin K) (κ' : RSet j α → Fin K')
    (P : Fin (j + 1) → Fin K) (obs : (Fin (j + 1) → α) → Prop) [DecidablePred obs] :
    ((polyadBlock (fun e => f (κ' e)) P).filter obs).card
      = ∑ P' ∈ Finset.univ.filter fun P' : Fin (j + 1) → Fin K' =>
          (fun i => f (P' i)) = P, ((polyadBlock κ' P').filter obs).card

name: RegularityLemmata.card_polyadBlock_comp
statement:
theorem card_polyadBlock_comp (f : Fin K' → Fin K) (κ' : RSet j α → Fin K')
    (P : Fin (j + 1) → Fin K) :
    (polyadBlock (fun e => f (κ' e)) P).card
      = ∑ P' ∈ Finset.univ.filter fun P' : Fin (j + 1) → Fin K' =>

name: RegularityLemmata.polyadBlock_comp
statement:
theorem polyadBlock_comp (f : Fin K' → Fin K) (κ' : RSet j α → Fin K')
    (P : Fin (j + 1) → Fin K) :
    polyadBlock (fun e => f (κ' e)) P
      = (Finset.univ.filter fun P' : Fin (j + 1) → Fin K' =>
          (fun i => f (P' i)) = P).biUnion (polyadBlock κ')

name: RegularityLemmata.polyadEnergyNum_comp_le
statement:
theorem polyadEnergyNum_comp_le (f : Fin K' → Fin K) (κ' : RSet j α → Fin K')

name: RegularityLemmata.polyadEnergyNum_comp_variance
statement:
theorem polyadEnergyNum_comp_variance (f : Fin K' → Fin K) (κ' : RSet j α → Fin K')
    (obs : (Fin (j + 1) → α) → Prop) [DecidablePred obs] :
    polyadEnergyNum κ' obs - polyadEnergyNum (fun e => f (κ' e)) obs
      = ∑ P : Fin (j + 1) → Fin K,
          ∑ P' ∈ Finset.univ.filter fun P' : Fin (j + 1) → Fin K' =>
            (fun i => f (P' i)) = P,
            ((polyadBlock κ' P').card : ℝ)
              * (densityOn (polyadBlock κ' P') obs
                  - densityOn (polyadBlock (fun e => f (κ' e)) P) obs) ^ 2

name: RegularityLemmata.polyadEnergyNum_le_count

RegularityLemmata.card_discAtom_eq_sum_cutRefine
statement:
theorem card_discAtom_eq_sum_cutRefine (κ : RSet j α → Fin K)
    (W : (Fin (j + 1) → Fin K) → Fin (j + 1) → Finset (RSet j α))
    (key : Fin (j + 1) → Fin K) :
    (discAtom κ key (W key)).card
      = ∑ Q ∈ resolvingKeys κ W key, (polyadBlock (cutRefine κ W) Q).card

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_discAtom_eq_sum_cutRefine
statement:
theorem card_filter_discAtom_eq_sum_cutRefine (κ : RSet j α → Fin K)

    ((discAtom κ key (W key)).filter obs).card

          ((polyadBlock (cutRefine κ W) Q).filter obs).card

statement:
theorem cutRefineBit_cutRefine (κ : RSet j α → Fin K)

    (key : Fin (j + 1) → Fin K) (i : Fin (j + 1)) :
    cutRefineBit (cutRefine κ W e) key i = if e ∈ W key i then 1 else 0

name: RegularityLemmata.discAtom_eq_biUnion_cutRefine
statement:
theorem discAtom_eq_biUnion_cutRefine (κ : RSet j α → Fin K)

    (key : Fin (j + 1) → Fin K) :
    discAtom κ key (W key)

statement:
theorem exists_discWitness {κ : RSet j α → Fin K}

name: RegularityLemmata.local_variance_gain
statement:
theorem local_variance_gain {κ : RSet j α → Fin K}
    {obs : (Fin (j + 1) → α) → Prop} [DecidablePred obs]
    {key : Fin (j + 1) → Fin K} {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (W : (Fin (j + 1) → Fin K) → Fin (j + 1) → Finset (RSet j α))
    (w : DiscWitness κ obs key δ) (hW : W key = w.faces) :
    δ ^ 3 * ((polyadBlock κ key).card : ℝ)
      < ∑ Q ∈ Finset.univ.filter fun Q : Fin (j + 1) → Fin (cutBound j K) =>
          (fun i => cutRefineProj (Q i)) = key,
          ((polyadBlock (cutRefine κ W) Q).card : ℝ)
            * (densityOn (polyadBlock (cutRefine κ W) Q) obs
                - densityOn (polyadBlock κ key) obs) ^ 2

name: RegularityLemmata.polyadBlock_cutRefine_subset
statement:
theorem polyadBlock_cutRefine_subset (κ : RSet j α → Fin K)

    (Q : Fin (j + 1) → Fin (cutBound j K)) :
    polyadBlock (cutRefine κ W) Q
      ⊆ polyadBlock κ fun i => cutRefineProj (Q i)

name: RegularityLemmata.polyadEnergyNum_le_cutRefine
statement:
theorem polyadEnergyNum_le_cutRefine (κ : RSet j α → Fin K)

name: RegularityLemmata.resolvingKeys_subset_fiber
statement:

    (key : Fin (j + 1) → Fin K) :
    resolvingKeys κ W key
      ⊆ Finset.univ.filter fun Q : Fin (j + 1) → Fin (cutBound j K) =>

      K' ≤ triadRegularityBound (triadFuel δ) K₀ ∧ ColoringRefines κ' κ₀ ∧
        badTriadMass H κ' δ ≤ δ

statement: theorem le_triadRegularityBound (t K : ℕ) : K ≤ triadRegularityBound t K

RegularityLemmata.polyadEnergy_cutRefine_gain
statement:
theorem polyadEnergy_cutRefine_gain {H : UniformHypergraph 3 α}
    {κ : RSet 2 α → Fin K} {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hbad : δ < badTriadMass H κ δ) :
    δ ^ 4 < polyadEnergy (cutRefine κ (badWitnessFamily H κ δ)) (triadObs H)
        - polyadEnergy κ (triadObs H)

name: RegularityLemmata.triadRegularityBound_succ
statement:
theorem triadRegularityBound_succ (t K : ℕ) :

name: RegularityLemmata.triadRegularityBound_zero
statement: theorem triadRegularityBound_zero (K : ℕ) : triadRegularityBound 0 K = K

theorem editCount_triadCleaned_le (H : UniformHypergraph 3 α) (κ : RSet 2 α → Fin K)

theorem editTriples_subset_badTriadTuples (H : UniformHypergraph 3 α)

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_triadic_regular_approximation
statement:
theorem exists_triadic_regular_approximation (H : UniformHypergraph 3 α) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ (K : ℕ) (κ : RSet 2 α → Fin K) (G : UniformHypergraph 3 α),
      K ≤ triadBound δ
        ∧ G.edges ⊆ H.edges

name: RegularityLemmata.triadObs_triadCleaned_iff_of_good
RegularityLemmata.exists_equipartition_absorb_chunks
statement:
theorem exists_equipartition_absorb_chunks [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    {S : Finset α} {blocks : Finset (Finset α)} {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hbne : blocks.Nonempty)
    (hdisj : (blocks : Set (Finset α)).PairwiseDisjoint id)
    (hcover : blocks.biUnion id = S)
    (hsize : ∀ b ∈ blocks, b.card = s) :
    ∃ P : Finpartition (Finset.univ : Finset α),
      P.IsEquipartition ∧
      P.parts.card = blocks.card ∧
      ∀ p ∈ P.parts, ∃ b ∈ blocks, b ⊆ p ∧
        p.card ≤ s + (Finset.univ \ S).card / blocks.card + 1

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_equipartition_absorb_leftover
statement:
theorem exists_equipartition_absorb_leftover [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    {S : Finset α} {blocks : Finset (Finset α)} {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hdisj : (blocks : Set (Finset α)).PairwiseDisjoint id)
    (hcover : blocks.biUnion id = S)
    (hsize : ∀ b ∈ blocks, b.card = s)
    (hE : (Finset.univ \ S).card ≤ blocks.card) :
    ∃ P : Finpartition (Finset.univ : Finset α),
      P.IsEquipartition ∧
      P.parts.card = blocks.card ∧
      ∀ p ∈ P.parts, ∃ b ∈ blocks, b ⊆ p ∧ p.card ≤ s + 1

name: RegularityLemmata.card_biUnion_le_sum_card
statement:
theorem card_biUnion_le_sum_card (bad : I → Finset Omega) :
    (univ.biUnion bad).card ≤ ∑ i : I, (bad i).card

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_avoids_all_of_sum_card_lt
statement:
theorem exists_avoids_all_of_sum_card_lt (bad : I → Finset Omega)
    (hbad : ∑ i : I, (bad i).card < Fintype.card Omega) :

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_avoids_all_of_uniform_bound

theorem exists_avoids_all_of_uniform_bound (bad : I → Finset Omega) (B : ℕ)
    (hcard : ∀ i : I, (bad i).card ≤ B)
    (hsmall : Fintype.card I * B < Fintype.card Omega) :
