name: RegularityLemmata.biUnion_blockWindow
statement:
theorem biUnion_blockWindow {n s m : ℕ} (h : n = m * s) :
    (Finset.range m).biUnion (blockWindow n s) = Finset.univ

name: RegularityLemmata.biUnion_sampleBlock
statement:
theorem biUnion_sampleBlock {n s m : ℕ} (e : Fin n ≃ α) (h : n = m * s) :
    (Finset.range m).biUnion (fun j ↦ sampleBlock e s j) = Finset.univ

name: RegularityLemmata.blockWindow_disjoint
statement:
theorem blockWindow_disjoint {n s j k : ℕ} (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    Disjoint (blockWindow n s j) (blockWindow n s k)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_blockWindow
statement:
theorem card_blockWindow {n s j : ℕ} (hj : (j + 1) * s ≤ n) :
    (blockWindow n s j).card = s

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_sampleBlock_eq
statement:
theorem card_filter_sampleBlock_eq {n s j : ℕ} (hn : Fintype.card α = n)
    (hj : (j + 1) * s ≤ n) (S : Finset α) (hS : S.card = s) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun e : Fin n ≃ α ↦ sampleBlock e s j = S).card
      = s.factorial * (n - s).factorial

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_sampleBlock_mem
statement:
theorem card_filter_sampleBlock_mem {n s j : ℕ} (hn : Fintype.card α = n)
    (hj : (j + 1) * s ≤ n) (𝒮 : Finset (Finset α)) (h𝒮 : ∀ S ∈ 𝒮, S.card = s) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun e : Fin n ≃ α ↦ sampleBlock e s j ∈ 𝒮).card
      = 𝒮.card * (s.factorial * (n - s).factorial)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_sampleBlock
statement:
theorem card_sampleBlock {n s j : ℕ} (e : Fin n ≃ α) (hj : (j + 1) * s ≤ n) :
    (sampleBlock e s j).card = s

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_equiv_avoids_all
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_avoids_all {n s : ℕ} {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (hn : Fintype.card α = n) (hs : s ≤ n) (blk : I → ℕ) (fam : I → Finset (Finset α))
    (hblk : ∀ i, (blk i + 1) * s ≤ n) (hfam : ∀ i, ∀ S ∈ fam i, S.card = s)
    (hsum : ∑ i, (fam i).card < n.choose s) :
    ∃ e : Fin n ≃ α, ∀ i, sampleBlock e s (blk i) ∉ fam i

name: RegularityLemmata.image_eq_iff_forall_mem
statement:
theorem image_eq_iff_forall_mem {β γ : Type*} [DecidableEq γ] (e : β ≃ γ) (W : Finset β)
    (S : Finset γ) : W.image e = S ↔ ∀ x, x ∈ W ↔ e x ∈ S

name: RegularityLemmata.mem_blockWindow
statement:
theorem mem_blockWindow {n s j : ℕ} {x : Fin n} :
    x ∈ blockWindow n s j ↔ j * s ≤ x.val ∧ x.val < (j + 1) * s

name: RegularityLemmata.sampleBlock_disjoint
statement:
theorem sampleBlock_disjoint {n s j k : ℕ} (e : Fin n ≃ α) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    Disjoint (sampleBlock e s j) (sampleBlock e s k)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_inter_card_le_mul_choose_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_inter_card_le_mul_choose_le (U A : Finset α) (hA : A ⊆ U) {s r L : ℕ}
    (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    ((U.powersetCard s).filter fun S ↦ (A ∩ S).card ≤ L).card * (s - L).choose r
      ≤ (U.card - A.card).choose r * (U.card - r).choose (s - r)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_filter_le_inter_card_mul_choose_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_le_inter_card_mul_choose_le (U A : Finset α) (hA : A ⊆ U) {s r K : ℕ}
    (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    ((U.powersetCard s).filter fun S ↦ K ≤ (A ∩ S).card).card * K.choose r
      ≤ A.card.choose r * (U.card - r).choose (s - r)

name: RegularityLemmata.card_powersetCard_filter_superset
RegularityLemmata.inter_card_add_compl_inter_card
statement:
theorem inter_card_add_compl_inter_card (U A S : Finset α) (hA : A ⊆ U) (hS : S ⊆ U) :
    (A ∩ S).card + ((U \ A) ∩ S).card = S.card

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_choose_inter_card
statement:
theorem sum_choose_inter_card (U A : Finset α) (hA : A ⊆ U) {s r : ℕ} (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    ∑ S ∈ U.powersetCard s, ((A ∩ S).card).choose r
      = A.card.choose r * (U.card - r).choose (s - r)

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_inter_card
statement:
theorem sum_inter_card (U A : Finset α) (hA : A ⊆ U) {s : ℕ} (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    ∑ S ∈ U.powersetCard s, (A ∩ S).card = A.card * (U.card - 1).choose (s - 1)

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_equiv_forall_blocks_window
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_forall_blocks_window {n s m : ℕ}
    (hn : Fintype.card α = n) (hnm : n = m * s)
    (F : Finset (Finset α)) (lo hi : Finset α → ℕ)
    (hsum : m * ∑ A ∈ F,
        ((upperViolations A s (hi A)).card + (lowerViolations A s (lo A)).card)
      < n.choose s) :
    ∃ e : Fin n ≃ α, ∀ A ∈ F, ∀ j, j < m →
      lo A ≤ (A ∩ sampleBlock e s j).card ∧ (A ∩ sampleBlock e s j).card ≤ hi A

name: RegularityLemmata.card_biUnion_traceClosure_le
statement:
theorem card_biUnion_traceClosure_le {I : Type*} [DecidableEq I]
    (labels : Finset I) (A : Finset α) (F : I → Finset (Finset α)) :
    (labels.biUnion fun i ↦ traceComplementClosure A (F i)).card
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ labels, 2 * (F i).card

name: RegularityLemmata.card_traceComplementClosure_le
statement:
theorem card_traceComplementClosure_le (A : Finset α) (F : Finset (Finset α)) :
    (traceComplementClosure A F).card ≤ 2 * F.card

name: RegularityLemmata.mem_traceComplementClosure
statement:
theorem mem_traceComplementClosure (A : Finset α) (F : Finset (Finset α))
    {T : Finset α} (hT : T ∈ F) :
    T ∈ traceComplementClosure A F ∧ A \ T ∈ traceComplementClosure A F

name: RegularityLemmata.cross_mul_le_of_upper_window
RegularityLemmata.exists_equiv_forall_blocks_upper
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_forall_blocks_upper {n s m : ℕ}
    (hn : Fintype.card α = n) (hnm : n = m * s)
    (F : Finset (Finset α)) (hi : Finset α → ℕ)
    (hsum : m * ∑ C ∈ F, (upperViolations C s (hi C)).card < n.choose s) :
    ∃ e : Fin n ≃ α, ∀ C ∈ F, ∀ j, j < m → (C ∩ sampleBlock e s j).card ≤ hi C

name: RegularityLemmata.lowerViolations_zero
statement: theorem lowerViolations_zero (A : Finset α) (s : ℕ) : lowerViolations A s 0 = ∅

name: RegularityLemmata.binomial_moment_geometric
statement:
theorem binomial_moment_geometric
    {bad n s a K r : ℕ} (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (hmoment : bad * K.choose r ≤ a.choose r * (n - r).choose (s - r)) :
    bad * (K + 1 - r) ^ r * (n + 1 - r) ^ r ≤
      n.choose s * a ^ r * s ^ r

name: RegularityLemmata.card_mul_lt_mul_proportional_window_succ
RegularityLemmata.card_upperViolations_geometric
statement:
theorem card_upperViolations_geometric (A : Finset α) {s hi r : ℕ} (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    (upperViolations A s hi).card * (hi + 2 - r) ^ r *
        (Fintype.card α + 1 - r) ^ r ≤
      (Fintype.card α).choose s * A.card ^ r * s ^ r

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_equiv_forall_blocks_proportional_of_ratio
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_forall_blocks_proportional_of_ratio
    {n s m t r : ℕ} (hn : Fintype.card α = n) (hnm : n = m * s)
    (F : Finset (Finset α)) (hrs : r ≤ s) (hrt : r ≤ t) (hrn : r ≤ n)
    (hchoose : 0 < n.choose s)
    (hratio : m * F.card * (n ^ r * s ^ r) <
      (t + 2 - r) ^ r * (n + 1 - r) ^ r) :
    ∃ e : Fin n ≃ α, ∀ A ∈ F, ∀ j, j < m →
      (A ∩ sampleBlock e s j).card ≤ A.card * s / n + t

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_equiv_forall_blocks_upper_of_active_geometric
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_forall_blocks_upper_of_active_geometric
    {n s m r D Q : ℕ} (hn : Fintype.card α = n) (hnm : n = m * s)
    (F : Finset (Finset α)) (hi : Finset α → ℕ) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (hchoose : 0 < n.choose s) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hden : ∀ A ∈ F, hi A < s →
      D ≤ (hi A + 2 - r) ^ r * (n + 1 - r) ^ r)
    (hnum : ∀ A ∈ F, hi A < s → A.card ^ r * s ^ r ≤ Q)
    (hratio : m * (F.filter fun A ↦ hi A < s).card * Q < D) :
    ∃ e : Fin n ≃ α, ∀ A ∈ F, ∀ j, j < m →
      (A ∩ sampleBlock e s j).card ≤ hi A

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_equiv_forall_blocks_upper_of_geometric
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_forall_blocks_upper_of_geometric
    {n s m r D Q : ℕ} (hn : Fintype.card α = n) (hnm : n = m * s)
    (F : Finset (Finset α)) (hi : Finset α → ℕ) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (hchoose : 0 < n.choose s) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hden : ∀ A ∈ F,
      D ≤ (hi A + 2 - r) ^ r * (n + 1 - r) ^ r)
    (hnum : ∀ A ∈ F, A.card ^ r * s ^ r ≤ Q)
    (hratio : m * F.card * Q < D) :
    ∃ e : Fin n ≃ α, ∀ A ∈ F, ∀ j, j < m →
      (A ∩ sampleBlock e s j).card ≤ hi A

name: RegularityLemmata.normalize_binomial_moment
statement:
theorem normalize_binomial_moment
    {bad n s a K r : ℕ} (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (hmoment : bad * K.choose r ≤ a.choose r * (n - r).choose (s - r)) :
    bad * K.choose r * n.choose r ≤ n.choose s * a.choose r * s.choose r

name: RegularityLemmata.proportional_ratio_of_four_mul
statement:
theorem proportional_ratio_of_four_mul
    {m F n s t r : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hrt : 2 * r ≤ t + 4) (hrn : 2 * r ≤ n + 2)
    (hgeom : m * F * (4 * s) ^ r < t ^ r) :
    m * F * (n ^ r * s ^ r) <
      (t + 2 - r) ^ r * (n + 1 - r) ^ r

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_bad_lt_of_mul_le_and_event_ratio
statement:
theorem sum_bad_lt_of_mul_le_and_event_ratio
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (F : Finset ι) (bad : ι → ℕ)
    {m N Q D : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hD : 0 < D)
    (htail : ∀ i ∈ F, bad i * D ≤ N * Q)
    (hratio : m * F.card * Q < D) :
    m * ∑ i ∈ F, bad i < N

name: RegularityLemmata.upperViolations_eq_empty_of_s_le_hi
statement:
theorem upperViolations_eq_empty_of_s_le_hi (A : Finset α) {s hi : ℕ} (h : s ≤ hi) :

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_forall_const_mul_pow_mul_geometric_lt_one
statement:
theorem exists_forall_const_mul_pow_mul_geometric_lt_one
    (C r : ℝ) (d : ℕ) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, C * (n : ℝ) ^ d * r ^ n < 1

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_forall_nat_mul_pow_mul_geometric_lt_one
statement:
theorem exists_forall_nat_mul_pow_mul_geometric_lt_one
    (K d : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) :

name: RegularityLemmata.card_upperViolations_mul_pow_le
statement:
theorem card_upperViolations_mul_pow_le (A : Finset α) {n s t r : ℕ}
    (hn : Fintype.card α = n) (hs : 0 < s) (hsn : s ≤ n) (ht : t < s)
    (hr : 8 * r ≤ t) (hactive : A.card * s / n + t < s) :
    (upperViolations A s (A.card * s / n + t)).card * (2 * s) ^ r ≤
      n.choose s * (2 * s - t) ^ r

name: RegularityLemmata.coupled_proportional_base
statement:
theorem coupled_proportional_base {a n s t r : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hsn : s ≤ n)
    (ht : t < s) (hr : 8 * r ≤ t) (hactive : a * s / n + t < s) :
    2 * s * (a * s) ≤
      (2 * s - t) * (a * s / n + t + 2 - r) * (n + 1 - r)

name: RegularityLemmata.coupled_proportional_pow
statement:
theorem coupled_proportional_pow {a n s t r : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hsn : s ≤ n)
    (ht : t < s) (hr : 8 * r ≤ t) (hactive : a * s / n + t < s) :
    (2 * s) ^ r * (a ^ r * s ^ r) ≤
      (2 * s - t) ^ r *
        ((a * s / n + t + 2 - r) ^ r * (n + 1 - r) ^ r)

name: RegularityLemmata.eighth_moment_le_slack
statement: theorem eighth_moment_le_slack (t : ℕ) : 8 * (t / 8) ≤ t

name: RegularityLemmata.eighth_moment_ratio_lt
statement:
theorem eighth_moment_ratio_lt {s t : ℕ} (ht8 : 8 ≤ t) (hts : t < s) :

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_equiv_forall_blocks_proportional_eighth_moment
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_forall_blocks_proportional_eighth_moment
    {n s m t : ℕ} (hn : Fintype.card α = n) (hnm : n = m * s)
    (F : Finset (Finset α)) (hs : 0 < s) (ht : t < s)
    (hchoose : 0 < n.choose s)
    (hratio : m * (F.filter fun A ↦ A.card * s / n + t < s).card *
        (2 * s - t) ^ (t / 8) < (2 * s) ^ (t / 8)) :
    ∃ e : Fin n ≃ α, ∀ A ∈ F, ∀ j, j < m →
      (A ∩ sampleBlock e s j).card ≤ A.card * s / n + t

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_equiv_forall_blocks_proportional_of_active_ratio
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_forall_blocks_proportional_of_active_ratio
    {n s m t r : ℕ} (hn : Fintype.card α = n) (hnm : n = m * s)

    (hchoose : 0 < n.choose s)
    (hratio : m * (F.filter fun A ↦ A.card * s / n + t < s).card *
        (2 * s - t) ^ r < (2 * s) ^ r) :
    ∃ e : Fin n ≃ α, ∀ A ∈ F, ∀ j, j < m →
      (A ∩ sampleBlock e s j).card ≤ A.card * s / n + t

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_forall_event_mul_pow_lt_of_fixed_ratio
statement:
theorem exists_forall_event_mul_pow_lt_of_fixed_ratio

name: RegularityLemmata.card_inter_traceOnParent
statement:
theorem card_inter_traceOnParent (A T : Finset α) (B : Finset A) :

name: RegularityLemmata.card_traceFamilyOnParent_le
statement:
theorem card_traceFamilyOnParent_le (A : Finset α) (F : Finset (Finset α)) :

name: RegularityLemmata.card_traceOnParent
statement:
theorem card_traceOnParent (A T : Finset α) :

name: RegularityLemmata.map_inter_traceOnParent

name: RegularityLemmata.traceOnParent_compl

name: RegularityLemmata.traceOnParent_mem_traceFamilyOnParent

name: RegularityLemmata.tiledSliceCert_exists
statement:
theorem tiledSliceCert_exists (A : Finset α) (F : Finset (Finset α)) {m s t : ℕ}
    (hA : A.card = m * s) (hs : 0 < s) (ht : t < s)
    (hchoose : 0 < (m * s).choose s)
    (hratio : m * ((traceFamilyOnParent A F).filter
        fun T ↦ T.card * s / (m * s) + t < s).card * (2 * s - t) ^ (t / 8)
      < (2 * s) ^ (t / 8)) :
    Nonempty (TiledSliceCert A F m s t)

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_equiv_forall_prefix_blocks_proportional_eighth_moment
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_forall_prefix_blocks_proportional_eighth_moment
    {n s m t : ℕ} (hn : Fintype.card α = n) (hms : m * s ≤ n)
    (F : Finset (Finset α)) (hs : 0 < s) (ht : t < s)
    (hchoose : 0 < n.choose s)
    (hratio : m * (F.filter fun A ↦ A.card * s / n + t < s).card *
        (2 * s - t) ^ (t / 8) < (2 * s) ^ (t / 8)) :
    ∃ e : Fin n ≃ α, ∀ A ∈ F, ∀ j, j < m →
      (A ∩ sampleBlock e s j).card ≤ A.card * s / n + t

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_equiv_forall_prefix_blocks_proportional_of_active_ratio

theorem exists_equiv_forall_prefix_blocks_proportional_of_active_ratio

    (hchoose : 0 < n.choose s)

        (2 * s - t) ^ r < (2 * s) ^ r) :

      (A ∩ sampleBlock e s j).card ≤ A.card * s / n + t

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_equiv_forall_prefix_blocks_upper
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_forall_prefix_blocks_upper {n s m : ℕ}

    (F : Finset (Finset α)) (hi : Finset α → ℕ)
    (hsum : m * ∑ C ∈ F, (upperViolations C s (hi C)).card < n.choose s) :

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_equiv_forall_prefix_blocks_window
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_forall_prefix_blocks_window {n s m : ℕ}

    (hsum : m * ∑ A ∈ F,

      < n.choose s) :

statement:

    ∃ cert : SliceCert A (traceComplementClosure A F) (A.card / s) s t,

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_average_slicing
statement:
theorem exists_average_slicing [DecidableEq α] (A : Finset α) {q : ℕ} (φ : Fin q → α → ℝ)
    {s t : ℕ} {β ν : ℝ}
    (hA : A.Nonempty) (hs : 0 < s) (ht : t < s) (htβ : (t : ℝ) ≤ β * s) (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hrange : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ A, φ i x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hratio : (A.card / s) * (2 * (q * ⌈1 / ν⌉₊)) * (2 * s - t) ^ (t / 8)
      < (2 * s) ^ (t / 8)) :
    ∃ block : Fin (A.card / s) → Finset α,
      (∀ j, (block j).card = s) ∧
      (∀ j, block j ⊆ A) ∧
      (∀ {j j'}, j ≠ j' → Disjoint (block j) (block j')) ∧
      ∀ i j, |averageOn (block j) (φ i) - averageOn A (φ i)| ≤ 2 * ν + (1 + ν) * β

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_common_blocks
statement:
theorem exists_common_blocks [DecidableEq α]
    {X A₀ : Finset α} {s : ℕ} {A : Fin s → Finset α}
    {q m t : ℕ} (φ : Fin s → Fin q → α → ℝ) {β ν νs : ℝ}
    (hcover : A₀ ∪ Finset.univ.biUnion A = X)
    (hdisj0 : ∀ i, Disjoint (A i) A₀)
    (hdisj : ∀ i i', i ≠ i' → Disjoint (A i) (A i'))
    (hm0 : 0 < m) (ht : t < m) (htβ : (t : ℝ) ≤ β * m) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hνs : 0 < νs)
    (hν : 0 ≤ ν) (hνm : ∀ i, (m : ℝ) ≤ ν * (A i).card)
    (hrange : ∀ i k, ∀ x ∈ A i, φ i k x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hratio : ∀ i, ((A i).card / m) * (2 * (q * ⌈1 / νs⌉₊)) * (2 * m - t) ^ (t / 8)
      < (2 * m) ^ (t / 8)) :
    ∃ (B : Finset (Finset α)) (X₀ : Finset α),
      A₀ ⊆ X₀ ∧
      (∀ b ∈ B, Disjoint b X₀) ∧
      (↑B : Set (Finset α)).PairwiseDisjoint id ∧
      X₀ ∪ B.biUnion id = X ∧
      ((X₀.card : ℝ) ≤ (A₀.card : ℝ) + ν * (X.card : ℝ)) ∧
      B.card * m ≤ X.card ∧
      ∀ b ∈ B, b.card = m ∧ ∃ i, b ⊆ A i ∧
        ∀ k, |averageOn b (φ i k) - averageOn (A i) (φ i k)|
          ≤ 2 * νs + (1 + νs) * β

name: RegularityLemmata.areHomogeneousPartitions_not_iff
statement:
theorem areHomogeneousPartitions_not_iff {P : Finpartition A} {Q : Finpartition B} :
    AreHomogeneousPartitions (fun a b => ¬ R a b) P Q ε ↔ AreHomogeneousPartitions R P Q ε

name: RegularityLemmata.areHomogeneousPartitions_of_half_le
statement:
theorem areHomogeneousPartitions_of_half_le (R : α → β → Prop) (P : Finpartition A)
    (Q : Finpartition B) (hε : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ ε) : AreHomogeneousPartitions R P Q ε

name: RegularityLemmata.areHomogeneousPartitions_swapRel_iff
statement:
theorem areHomogeneousPartitions_swapRel_iff {P : Finpartition A} {Q : Finpartition B} :
    AreHomogeneousPartitions (swapRel R) Q P ε ↔ AreHomogeneousPartitions R P Q ε

name: RegularityLemmata.familyDefect_eq_add_refinementVariance
statement:
theorem familyDefect_eq_add_refinementVariance (hQ : Q ≤ P) {ι : Type*} (Y : Finset ι)
    (q : ι → α → Prop) [∀ y, DecidablePred (q y)] :
    familyDefect P Y q = familyDefect Q Y q + 2 * ∑ y ∈ Y, sectionRefinementVariance Q P (q y)

name: RegularityLemmata.familyDefect_mono
statement:
theorem familyDefect_mono (hQ : Q ≤ P) {ι : Type*} (Y : Finset ι) (q : ι → α → Prop)
    [∀ y, DecidablePred (q y)] : familyDefect Q Y q ≤ familyDefect P Y q

name: RegularityLemmata.familyDefect_nonneg
statement:
theorem familyDefect_nonneg {ι : Type*} (Y : Finset ι) (q : ι → α → Prop)
    [∀ y, DecidablePred (q y)] : 0 ≤ familyDefect P Y q

name: RegularityLemmata.partitionDefect_bot
statement: theorem partitionDefect_bot : partitionDefect (⊥ : Finpartition s) p = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.partitionDefect_eq_add_refinementVariance
statement:
theorem partitionDefect_eq_add_refinementVariance (hQ : Q ≤ P) :
    partitionDefect P p = partitionDefect Q p + 2 * sectionRefinementVariance Q P p

name: RegularityLemmata.partitionDefect_eq_sum_density
statement:
theorem partitionDefect_eq_sum_density :
    partitionDefect P p
      = ∑ l ∈ P.parts, (l.card : ℝ) * (2 * densityOn l p * (1 - densityOn l p))

name: RegularityLemmata.partitionDefect_le_half
statement: theorem partitionDefect_le_half : partitionDefect P p ≤ (s.card : ℝ) / 2

name: RegularityLemmata.partitionDefect_mono
statement: theorem partitionDefect_mono (hQ : Q ≤ P) : partitionDefect Q p ≤ partitionDefect P p

name: RegularityLemmata.partitionDefect_nonneg
statement: theorem partitionDefect_nonneg : 0 ≤ partitionDefect P p

name: RegularityLemmata.sectionRefinementVariance_nonneg
statement:
theorem sectionRefinementVariance_nonneg (Q : Finpartition s) :
    0 ≤ sectionRefinementVariance Q P p

name: RegularityLemmata.finsetMass_finpartition
statement:
theorem finsetMass_finpartition [DecidableEq X] (w : X → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) :
    finsetMass w A = ∑ C ∈ P.parts, finsetMass w C

name: RegularityLemmata.rectAverage_mul_mass
statement:
theorem rectAverage_mul_mass (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectAverage f wX wY A B * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B) = rectSum f wX wY A B

name: RegularityLemmata.rectAverage_mul_mass_decomposition
statement:
theorem rectAverage_mul_mass_decomposition [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B)
    (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectAverage f wX wY A B * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B)
      = ∑ p ∈ P.parts ×ˢ Q.parts,
          rectAverage f wX wY p.1 p.2 * (finsetMass wX p.1 * finsetMass wY p.2)

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_biUnion
statement:
theorem rectSum_biUnion [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (f : RectKernel X Y)
    (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) {sA : Finset (Finset X)} {sB : Finset (Finset Y)}
    (hA : (sA : Set (Finset X)).PairwiseDisjoint id)
    (hB : (sB : Set (Finset Y)).PairwiseDisjoint id) :
    rectSum f wX wY (sA.biUnion id) (sB.biUnion id)
      = ∑ p ∈ sA ×ˢ sB, rectSum f wX wY p.1 p.2

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_finpartition
statement:
theorem rectSum_finpartition [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (f : RectKernel X Y)
    (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B) :
    rectSum f wX wY A B
      = ∑ p ∈ P.parts ×ˢ Q.parts, rectSum f wX wY p.1 p.2

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_finpartition_op
statement:
theorem rectSum_finpartition_op [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (f : RectKernel X Y)
    (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B) :
    rectSum f.op wY wX B A = ∑ p ∈ P.parts ×ˢ Q.parts, rectSum f wX wY p.1 p.2

name: RegularityLemmata.steppedRectSum_comm
statement:
theorem steppedRectSum_comm [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (f : RectKernel X Y)
    (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B)
    (S : Finset X) (T : Finset Y) :
    steppedRectSum f wX wY P Q S T
      = ∑ D ∈ Q.parts, ∑ C ∈ P.parts,
          rectAverage f wX wY C D * (finsetMass wX (S ∩ C) * finsetMass wY (T ∩ D))

name: RegularityLemmata.steppedRectSum_congr_left
statement:
theorem steppedRectSum_congr_left [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (f : RectKernel X Y)
    (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) {P P' : Finpartition A} (_Q : Finpartition B)
    (S : Finset X) (T : Finset Y) (h : P.parts = P'.parts) :
    steppedRectSum f wX wY P _Q S T = steppedRectSum f wX wY P' _Q S T

name: RegularityLemmata.steppedRectSum_op
statement:
theorem steppedRectSum_op [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (f : RectKernel X Y)
    (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B)
    (S : Finset X) (T : Finset Y) :
    steppedRectSum f.op wY wX Q P T S = steppedRectSum f wX wY P Q S T

name: RegularityLemmata.steppedRectSum_self
statement:
theorem steppedRectSum_self [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (f : RectKernel X Y)
    (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B)
    (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    steppedRectSum f wX wY P Q A B = rectSum f wX wY A B

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_rectError_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem abs_rectError_le_two_mul [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (P : Finpartition A)
    (Q : Finpartition B) {S : Finset X} {T : Finset Y} (hS : S ⊆ A) (hT : T ⊆ B)
    (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) {ε : ℝ}
    (hrect : ∀ S' ⊆ A, ∀ T' ⊆ B, |rectSum f wX wY S' T'| ≤ ε) :
    |rectError f wX wY P Q S T| ≤ 2 * ε

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_steppedRectSum_le
statement:
theorem abs_steppedRectSum_le [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (P : Finpartition A)
    (Q : Finpartition B) (S : Finset X) (T : Finset Y)
    (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) {ε : ℝ}
    (hrect : ∀ S' ⊆ A, ∀ T' ⊆ B, |rectSum f wX wY S' T'| ≤ ε) :
    |steppedRectSum f wX wY P Q S T| ≤ ε

name: RegularityLemmata.biUnion_parts_subset
statement:
theorem biUnion_parts_subset [DecidableEq X] {P : Finpartition A} {I : Finset (Finset X)}
    (hI : I ⊆ P.parts) : I.biUnion id ⊆ A

name: RegularityLemmata.rectAverage_rectResidual_mul_trace_mass
statement:
theorem rectAverage_rectResidual_mul_trace_mass [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) {P : Finpartition A} {Q : Finpartition B}
    {C C' : Finset X} {D D' : Finset Y} (hC : C ∈ P.parts) (hD : D ∈ Q.parts)
    (hC' : C' ⊆ C) (hD' : D' ⊆ D) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)
    (S : Finset X) (T : Finset Y) :
    rectAverage (rectResidual f wX wY P Q) wX wY C' D'
        * (finsetMass wX (S ∩ C') * finsetMass wY (T ∩ D'))
      = (rectAverage f wX wY C' D' - rectAverage f wX wY C D)
        * (finsetMass wX (S ∩ C') * finsetMass wY (T ∩ D'))

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutDiscrepancy_eq_rectCutNorm_rectResidual
statement:
theorem rectCutDiscrepancy_eq_rectCutNorm_rectResidual [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B) :
    rectCutDiscrepancy f wX wY P Q = rectCutNorm (rectResidual f wX wY P Q) wX wY A B

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutDiscrepancy_inf_le_of_le_half
statement:
theorem rectCutDiscrepancy_inf_le_of_le_half [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P₁ P₂ : Finpartition A)
    (Q₁ Q₂ : Finpartition B) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : rectCutDiscrepancy f wX wY P₁ Q₁ ≤ ε / 2) :
    rectCutDiscrepancy f wX wY (P₁ ⊓ P₂) (Q₁ ⊓ Q₂) ≤ ε
      ∧ (P₁ ⊓ P₂).parts.card ≤ P₁.parts.card * P₂.parts.card
      ∧ (Q₁ ⊓ Q₂).parts.card ≤ Q₁.parts.card * Q₂.parts.card

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutDiscrepancy_inf_le_two_mul_left
statement:
theorem rectCutDiscrepancy_inf_le_two_mul_left [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P₁ P₂ : Finpartition A)
    (Q₁ Q₂ : Finpartition B) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectCutDiscrepancy f wX wY (P₁ ⊓ P₂) (Q₁ ⊓ Q₂)
      ≤ 2 * rectCutDiscrepancy f wX wY P₁ Q₁

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutDiscrepancy_inf_le_two_mul_right
statement:
theorem rectCutDiscrepancy_inf_le_two_mul_right [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P₁ P₂ : Finpartition A)
    (Q₁ Q₂ : Finpartition B) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectCutDiscrepancy f wX wY (P₁ ⊓ P₂) (Q₁ ⊓ Q₂)
      ≤ 2 * rectCutDiscrepancy f wX wY P₂ Q₂

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutDiscrepancy_inf_self_le_of_le_half
statement:
theorem rectCutDiscrepancy_inf_self_le_of_le_half [DecidableEq X] (f : RectKernel X X)
    (w₁ w₂ : X → ℝ) (P Q : Finpartition A) (hw₁ : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ w₁ x)
    (hw₂ : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ w₂ x) {ε : ℝ} (hε : rectCutDiscrepancy f w₁ w₂ P Q ≤ ε / 2) :
    rectCutDiscrepancy f w₁ w₂ (P ⊓ Q) (P ⊓ Q) ≤ ε
      ∧ (P ⊓ Q).parts.card ≤ P.parts.card * Q.parts.card

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutDiscrepancy_le_iff
statement:
theorem rectCutDiscrepancy_le_iff [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] {P : Finpartition A}
    {Q : Finpartition B} {c : ℝ} :
    rectCutDiscrepancy f wX wY P Q ≤ c
      ↔ ∀ S ⊆ A, ∀ T ⊆ B, |rectError f wX wY P Q S T| ≤ c

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutDiscrepancy_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem rectCutDiscrepancy_le_two_mul [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (f : RectKernel X Y)
    (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) {P P' : Finpartition A} {Q Q' : Finpartition B}
    (hP : P' ≤ P) (hQ : Q' ≤ Q) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectCutDiscrepancy f wX wY P' Q' ≤ 2 * rectCutDiscrepancy f wX wY P Q

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutDiscrepancy_nonneg
statement:
theorem rectCutDiscrepancy_nonneg [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (P : Finpartition A)
    (Q : Finpartition B) : 0 ≤ rectCutDiscrepancy f wX wY P Q

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutDiscrepancy_op
statement:
theorem rectCutDiscrepancy_op [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (f : RectKernel X Y)
    (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B) :
    rectCutDiscrepancy f.op wY wX Q P = rectCutDiscrepancy f wX wY P Q

name: RegularityLemmata.rectCutDiscrepancy_smul_weight_left
statement:
theorem rectCutDiscrepancy_smul_weight_left [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] {c : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A)
    (Q : Finpartition B) :
    rectCutDiscrepancy f (fun x => c * wX x) wY P Q
      = c * rectCutDiscrepancy f wX wY P Q

name: RegularityLemmata.rectError_op
statement:
theorem rectError_op [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ)
    (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B) (S : Finset X) (T : Finset Y) :
    rectError f.op wY wX Q P T S = rectError f wX wY P Q S T

name: RegularityLemmata.rectError_rectResidual
statement:
theorem rectError_rectResidual [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (f : RectKernel X Y)
    (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) {P P' : Finpartition A} {Q Q' : Finpartition B}
    (hP : P' ≤ P) (hQ : Q' ≤ Q) {S : Finset X} {T : Finset Y} (hS : S ⊆ A) (hT : T ⊆ B)
    (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectError (rectResidual f wX wY P Q) wX wY P' Q' S T = rectError f wX wY P' Q' S T

name: RegularityLemmata.rectError_self
statement:
theorem rectError_self [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (P : Finpartition A)
    (Q : Finpartition B) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectError f wX wY P Q A B = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.rectError_smul_weight_left
statement:
theorem rectError_smul_weight_left [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A)
    (Q : Finpartition B) (S : Finset X) (T : Finset Y) :
    rectError f (fun x => c * wX x) wY P Q S T = c * rectError f wX wY P Q S T

name: RegularityLemmata.rectResidual_apply
statement:
theorem rectResidual_apply [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (f : RectKernel X Y)
    (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B) (x : X) (y : Y) :
    rectResidual f wX wY P Q x y
      = f x y - rectAverage f wX wY (P.part x) (Q.part y)

name: RegularityLemmata.rectResidual_of_notMem_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem rectResidual_of_notMem_left [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B)
    {x : X} (hx : x ∉ A) (y : Y) : rectResidual f wX wY P Q x y = f x y

name: RegularityLemmata.rectResidual_of_notMem_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem rectResidual_of_notMem_right [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B)
    (x : X) {y : Y} (hy : y ∉ B) : rectResidual f wX wY P Q x y = f x y

name: RegularityLemmata.rectSum_rectResidual_eq_rectError
statement:
theorem rectSum_rectResidual_eq_rectError [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B)
    {S : Finset X} {T : Finset Y} (hS : S ⊆ A) (hT : T ⊆ B) :
    rectSum (rectResidual f wX wY P Q) wX wY S T = rectError f wX wY P Q S T

name: RegularityLemmata.sq_rectAverage_rectResidual_mul_mass
statement:
theorem sq_rectAverage_rectResidual_mul_mass [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) {P : Finpartition A} {Q : Finpartition B}
    {C C' : Finset X} {D D' : Finset Y} (hC : C ∈ P.parts) (hD : D ∈ Q.parts)
    (hC' : C' ⊆ C) (hD' : D' ⊆ D) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectAverage (rectResidual f wX wY P Q) wX wY C' D' ^ 2
        * (finsetMass wX C' * finsetMass wY D')
      = (rectAverage f wX wY C' D' - rectAverage f wX wY C D) ^ 2
        * (finsetMass wX C' * finsetMass wY D')

name: RegularityLemmata.steppedRectSum_eq_relMass_bilinear
statement:
theorem steppedRectSum_eq_relMass_bilinear [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B) (S : Finset X) (T : Finset Y)
    (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    steppedRectSum f wX wY P Q S T
      = ∑ C ∈ P.parts, relMass wX S C
          * ∑ D ∈ Q.parts, relMass wY T D * rectSum f wX wY C D

name: RegularityLemmata.steppedRectSum_rectResidual
statement:
theorem steppedRectSum_rectResidual [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (f : RectKernel X Y)
    (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) {P P' : Finpartition A} {Q Q' : Finpartition B}
    (hP : P' ≤ P) (hQ : Q' ≤ Q) (S : Finset X) (T : Finset Y)
    (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    steppedRectSum (rectResidual f wX wY P Q) wX wY P' Q' S T
      = steppedRectSum f wX wY P' Q' S T - steppedRectSum f wX wY P Q S T

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_part_mul_weight
statement:
theorem sum_part_mul_weight [DecidableEq X] (P : Finpartition A) (S : Finset X) (hS : S ⊆ A)
    (w : X → ℝ) (c : Finset X → ℝ) :
    ∑ x ∈ S, c (P.part x) * w x = ∑ C ∈ P.parts, c C * finsetMass w (S ∩ C)

name: RegularityLemmata.rectBlockEnergy_le_rectEnergyNum
statement:
theorem rectBlockEnergy_le_rectEnergyNum [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x)
    (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectBlockEnergy f wX wY A B ≤ rectEnergyNum f wX wY P Q

name: RegularityLemmata.rectEnergyNum_eq_add_rectRefinementVarianceNum
statement:
theorem rectEnergyNum_eq_add_rectRefinementVarianceNum [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    {P P' : Finpartition A} {Q Q' : Finpartition B} (hP : P' ≤ P) (hQ : Q' ≤ Q)
    (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectEnergyNum f wX wY P' Q'
      = rectEnergyNum f wX wY P Q + rectRefinementVarianceNum f wX wY P Q P' Q'

name: RegularityLemmata.rectEnergyNum_eq_add_rectRefinementVarianceNum_left
statement:
theorem rectEnergyNum_eq_add_rectRefinementVarianceNum_left [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    {P P' : Finpartition A} {Q : Finpartition B} (hP : P' ≤ P)
    (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectEnergyNum f wX wY P' Q
      = rectEnergyNum f wX wY P Q + rectRefinementVarianceNum f wX wY P Q P' Q

name: RegularityLemmata.rectEnergyNum_eq_add_rectRefinementVarianceNum_right
statement:
theorem rectEnergyNum_eq_add_rectRefinementVarianceNum_right [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    {P : Finpartition A} {Q Q' : Finpartition B} (hQ : Q' ≤ Q)
    (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectEnergyNum f wX wY P Q'
      = rectEnergyNum f wX wY P Q + rectRefinementVarianceNum f wX wY P Q P Q'

name: RegularityLemmata.rectEnergyNum_le_mass
statement:
theorem rectEnergyNum_le_mass [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (P : Finpartition A)
    (Q : Finpartition B) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)
    (hf : IsAbsUnitBoundedOnRectangle f A B) :
    rectEnergyNum f wX wY P Q ≤ finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B

name: RegularityLemmata.rectEnergyNum_le_rectEnergyNum
statement:
theorem rectEnergyNum_le_rectEnergyNum [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    {P P' : Finpartition A} {Q Q' : Finpartition B} (hP : P' ≤ P) (hQ : Q' ≤ Q)
    (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectEnergyNum f wX wY P Q ≤ rectEnergyNum f wX wY P' Q'

name: RegularityLemmata.rectEnergyNum_le_rectEnergyNum_left
statement:
theorem rectEnergyNum_le_rectEnergyNum_left [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    {P P' : Finpartition A} {Q : Finpartition B} (hP : P' ≤ P)
    (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectEnergyNum f wX wY P Q ≤ rectEnergyNum f wX wY P' Q

name: RegularityLemmata.rectEnergyNum_le_rectEnergyNum_right
statement:
theorem rectEnergyNum_le_rectEnergyNum_right [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    {P : Finpartition A} {Q Q' : Finpartition B} (hQ : Q' ≤ Q)
    (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectEnergyNum f wX wY P Q ≤ rectEnergyNum f wX wY P Q'

name: RegularityLemmata.rectEnergyNum_nonneg
statement:
theorem rectEnergyNum_nonneg [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (P : Finpartition A)
    (Q : Finpartition B) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    0 ≤ rectEnergyNum f wX wY P Q

name: RegularityLemmata.rectEnergyNum_op
statement:
theorem rectEnergyNum_op [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (f : RectKernel X Y)
    (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B) :
    rectEnergyNum f.op wY wX Q P = rectEnergyNum f wX wY P Q

name: RegularityLemmata.rectEnergyNum_sub_rectBlockEnergy
statement:
theorem rectEnergyNum_sub_rectBlockEnergy [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x)
    (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectEnergyNum f wX wY P Q - rectBlockEnergy f wX wY A B
      = rectVarianceNum f wX wY P Q

name: RegularityLemmata.rectEnergy_eq_add_rectRefinementVarianceNum
statement:
theorem rectEnergy_eq_add_rectRefinementVarianceNum [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    {P P' : Finpartition A} {Q Q' : Finpartition B} (hP : P' ≤ P) (hQ : Q' ≤ Q)
    (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectEnergy f wX wY P' Q'
      = rectEnergy f wX wY P Q
        + rectRefinementVarianceNum f wX wY P Q P' Q'
            / (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B)

name: RegularityLemmata.rectEnergy_le_one
statement:
theorem rectEnergy_le_one [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (P : Finpartition A)
    (Q : Finpartition B) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)
    (hf : IsAbsUnitBoundedOnRectangle f A B) : rectEnergy f wX wY P Q ≤ 1

name: RegularityLemmata.rectEnergy_le_rectEnergy
statement:
theorem rectEnergy_le_rectEnergy [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    {P P' : Finpartition A} {Q Q' : Finpartition B} (hP : P' ≤ P) (hQ : Q' ≤ Q)
    (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectEnergy f wX wY P Q ≤ rectEnergy f wX wY P' Q'

name: RegularityLemmata.rectEnergy_nonneg
statement:
theorem rectEnergy_nonneg [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (P : Finpartition A)
    (Q : Finpartition B) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    0 ≤ rectEnergy f wX wY P Q

name: RegularityLemmata.rectRefinementVarianceNum_left_self
statement:
theorem rectRefinementVarianceNum_left_self [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B)
    (Q' : Finpartition B) :
    rectRefinementVarianceNum f wX wY P Q P Q'
      = ∑ pd ∈ P.parts ×ˢ Q.parts, ∑ D' ∈ Q'.parts.filter (· ⊆ pd.2),
          (rectAverage f wX wY pd.1 D' - rectAverage f wX wY pd.1 pd.2) ^ 2
            * (finsetMass wX pd.1 * finsetMass wY D')

name: RegularityLemmata.rectRefinementVarianceNum_nonneg
statement:
theorem rectRefinementVarianceNum_nonneg [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B) (P' : Finpartition A) (Q' : Finpartition B)
    (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    0 ≤ rectRefinementVarianceNum f wX wY P Q P' Q'

name: RegularityLemmata.rectRefinementVarianceNum_op
statement:
theorem rectRefinementVarianceNum_op [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (f : RectKernel X Y)
    (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B)
    (P' : Finpartition A) (Q' : Finpartition B) :
    rectRefinementVarianceNum f.op wY wX Q P Q' P'
      = rectRefinementVarianceNum f wX wY P Q P' Q'

name: RegularityLemmata.rectRefinementVarianceNum_right_self
statement:
theorem rectRefinementVarianceNum_right_self [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B) (P' : Finpartition A) :
    rectRefinementVarianceNum f wX wY P Q P' Q
      = ∑ pd ∈ P.parts ×ˢ Q.parts, ∑ C' ∈ P'.parts.filter (· ⊆ pd.1),
          (rectAverage f wX wY C' pd.2 - rectAverage f wX wY pd.1 pd.2) ^ 2
            * (finsetMass wX C' * finsetMass wY pd.2)

name: RegularityLemmata.rectVarianceNum_nonneg
statement:
theorem rectVarianceNum_nonneg [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (P : Finpartition A)
    (Q : Finpartition B) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    0 ≤ rectVarianceNum f wX wY P Q

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_mass_product
statement:
theorem sum_mass_product [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ)
    (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B) :
    ∑ p ∈ P.parts ×ˢ Q.parts, (finsetMass wX p.1 * finsetMass wY p.2)
      = finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_product_parts_eq_sum_over_parents
statement:
theorem sum_product_parts_eq_sum_over_parents [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    {P P' : Finpartition A} {Q Q' : Finpartition B} (hP : P' ≤ P) (hQ : Q' ≤ Q)
    (g : Finset X → Finset Y → ℝ) :
    ∑ pd ∈ P.parts ×ˢ Q.parts,
        ∑ p ∈ (P'.parts.filter (· ⊆ pd.1)) ×ˢ (Q'.parts.filter (· ⊆ pd.2)), g p.1 p.2
      = ∑ p ∈ P'.parts ×ˢ Q'.parts, g p.1 p.2

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_product_parts_eq_sum_over_parents_subset
statement:
theorem sum_product_parts_eq_sum_over_parents_subset [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    {P P' : Finpartition A} {Q Q' : Finpartition B} (hP : P' ≤ P) (hQ : Q' ≤ Q)
    {I : Finset (Finset X)} {J : Finset (Finset Y)} (hI : I ⊆ P'.parts) (hJ : J ⊆ Q'.parts)
    (g : Finset X → Finset Y → ℝ) :
    ∑ pd ∈ P.parts ×ˢ Q.parts,
        ∑ p ∈ (I.filter (· ⊆ pd.1)) ×ˢ (J.filter (· ⊆ pd.2)), g p.1 p.2
      = ∑ p ∈ I ×ˢ J, g p.1 p.2

name: RegularityLemmata.card_parts_cut_pair_le
statement:
theorem card_parts_cut_pair_le [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (P : Finpartition A)

      ∧ (cutRefinePartition Q T).parts.card ≤ 2 * Q.parts.card

name: RegularityLemmata.finsetMass_mul_pos_of_lt_abs_rectError
statement:
theorem finsetMass_mul_pos_of_lt_abs_rectError [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B)
    {S : Finset X} {T : Finset Y} (hS : S ⊆ A) (hT : T ⊆ B) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x)
    (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) {ε : ℝ}
    (hwit : ε * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B) < |rectError f wX wY P Q S T|) :
    0 < finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B

name: RegularityLemmata.one_sub_rounds_mul_sq_le_rectEnergy
statement:
theorem one_sub_rounds_mul_sq_le_rectEnergy [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B)
    (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    1 - ((⌈1 / ε ^ 2⌉₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 ≤ rectEnergy f wX wY P Q

name: RegularityLemmata.rectEnergyNum_add_le_of_lt_abs_rectError
statement:
theorem rectEnergyNum_add_le_of_lt_abs_rectError [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B)
    {S : Finset X} {T : Finset Y} (hS : S ⊆ A) (hT : T ⊆ B) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x)
    (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hwit : ε * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B) < |rectError f wX wY P Q S T|) :
    rectEnergyNum f wX wY P Q + ε ^ 2 * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B)
      ≤ rectEnergyNum f wX wY (cutRefinePartition P S) (cutRefinePartition Q T)

name: RegularityLemmata.rectEnergy_add_le_of_lt_abs_rectError
statement:
theorem rectEnergy_add_le_of_lt_abs_rectError [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B)
    {S : Finset X} {T : Finset Y} (hS : S ⊆ A) (hT : T ⊆ B) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x)
    (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hwit : ε * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B) < |rectError f wX wY P Q S T|) :
    rectEnergy f wX wY P Q + ε ^ 2
      ≤ rectEnergy f wX wY (cutRefinePartition P S) (cutRefinePartition Q T)

name: RegularityLemmata.rectError_eq_sum_selected
statement:
theorem rectError_eq_sum_selected [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (f : RectKernel X Y)
    (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B) {S : Finset X}
    {T : Finset Y} (hS : S ⊆ A) (hT : T ⊆ B) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x)
    (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectError f wX wY P Q S T
      = ∑ p ∈ selectedLeft P S ×ˢ selectedRight Q T,
          rectAverage (rectResidual f wX wY P Q) wX wY p.1 p.2
            * (finsetMass wX p.1 * finsetMass wY p.2)

name: RegularityLemmata.rectFkIterate
statement:
theorem rectFkIterate [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ)
    (wY : Y → ℝ) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)
    (hf : IsAbsUnitBoundedOnRectangle f A B) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ (t : ℕ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B),
      1 - (t : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 ≤ rectEnergy f wX wY P Q →
      ∃ P' : Finpartition A, ∃ Q' : Finpartition B, P' ≤ P ∧ Q' ≤ Q ∧
        P'.parts.card ≤ P.parts.card * 2 ^ t ∧ Q'.parts.card ≤ Q.parts.card * 2 ^ t ∧
        ∀ S ⊆ A, ∀ T ⊆ B,
          |rectError f wX wY P' Q' S T| ≤ ε * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B)

name: RegularityLemmata.rect_frieze_kannan_cutDiscrepancy
statement:
theorem rect_frieze_kannan_cutDiscrepancy [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (f : RectKernel X Y)
    (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P₀ : Finpartition A) (Q₀ : Finpartition B)
    (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)
    (hf : IsAbsUnitBoundedOnRectangle f A B) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ P : Finpartition A, ∃ Q : Finpartition B, P ≤ P₀ ∧ Q ≤ Q₀ ∧
      P.parts.card ≤ P₀.parts.card * 2 ^ (⌈1 / ε ^ 2⌉₊ + 1) ∧
      Q.parts.card ≤ Q₀.parts.card * 2 ^ (⌈1 / ε ^ 2⌉₊ + 1) ∧
      rectCutDiscrepancy f wX wY P Q ≤ ε * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B)

name: RegularityLemmata.rect_frieze_kannan_refining
statement:
theorem rect_frieze_kannan_refining [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (f : RectKernel X Y)
    (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P₀ : Finpartition A) (Q₀ : Finpartition B)
    (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y)
    (hf : IsAbsUnitBoundedOnRectangle f A B) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ P : Finpartition A, ∃ Q : Finpartition B, P ≤ P₀ ∧ Q ≤ Q₀ ∧
      P.parts.card ≤ P₀.parts.card * 2 ^ (⌈1 / ε ^ 2⌉₊ + 1) ∧
      Q.parts.card ≤ Q₀.parts.card * 2 ^ (⌈1 / ε ^ 2⌉₊ + 1) ∧
      ∀ S ⊆ A, ∀ T ⊆ B,
        |rectError f wX wY P Q S T| ≤ ε * (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B)

name: RegularityLemmata.rect_frieze_kannan_same_carrier
statement:
theorem rect_frieze_kannan_same_carrier [DecidableEq X] (f : RectKernel X X) (w₁ w₂ : X → ℝ)
    (P₀ Q₀ : Finpartition A) (hw₁ : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ w₁ x) (hw₂ : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ w₂ x)
    (hf : IsAbsUnitBoundedOnRectangle f A A) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ R : Finpartition A, R ≤ P₀ ∧ R ≤ Q₀ ∧
      R.parts.card
        ≤ (P₀.parts.card * 2 ^ (⌈1 / (ε / 2) ^ 2⌉₊ + 1))
          * (Q₀.parts.card * 2 ^ (⌈1 / (ε / 2) ^ 2⌉₊ + 1)) ∧
      rectCutDiscrepancy f w₁ w₂ R R ≤ ε * (finsetMass w₁ A * finsetMass w₂ A)

statement:
theorem selectedVariance_le_rectRefinementVarianceNum [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B)
    (S : Finset X) (T : Finset Y) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x) (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :

name: RegularityLemmata.sq_rectError_le_mul_selectedVariance
statement:
theorem sq_rectError_le_mul_selectedVariance [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    (f : RectKernel X Y) (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ) (P : Finpartition A) (Q : Finpartition B)
    {S : Finset X} {T : Finset Y} (hS : S ⊆ A) (hT : T ⊆ B) (hwX : ∀ x ∈ A, 0 ≤ wX x)
    (hwY : ∀ y ∈ B, 0 ≤ wY y) :
    rectError f wX wY P Q S T ^ 2
      ≤ (finsetMass wX A * finsetMass wY B) * selectedVariance f wX wY P Q S T

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_selected_mass
statement:
theorem sum_selected_mass [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (wX : X → ℝ) (wY : Y → ℝ)

    (hT : T ⊆ B) :

      = finsetMass wX S * finsetMass wY T

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_balanced_slicing_of_threshold
statement:
theorem exists_balanced_slicing_of_threshold [DecidableEq α] (A : Finset α)
    (F : Finset (Finset α)) {q n : ℕ} {μ ν : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (hν : 0 < ν) (hν2 : ν ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hn : sliceThreshold q μ ν ≤ n) (hAn : A.card ≤ n) (hA : A.Nonempty) (hF : F.card ≤ q) :
    ∃ cert : SliceCert A (traceComplementClosure A F) (A.card / sliceBlockSize μ n)
        (sliceBlockSize μ n) (sliceSlack μ ν n),
      ∀ T ∈ F, ∀ j, |((T ∩ cert.block j).card : ℝ) / sliceBlockSize μ n
          - ((A ∩ T).card : ℝ) / A.card| ≤ ν

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_balanced_slicing_of_threshold_self
statement:
theorem exists_balanced_slicing_of_threshold_self [DecidableEq α] (A : Finset α)
    (F : Finset (Finset α)) {q : ℕ} {μ ν : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ) (hμ1 : μ ≤ 1) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hν2 : ν ≤ 1 / 2) (hn : sliceThreshold q μ ν ≤ A.card) (hF : F.card ≤ q) :
    ∃ cert : SliceCert A (traceComplementClosure A F) (A.card / sliceBlockSize μ A.card)
        (sliceBlockSize μ A.card) (sliceSlack μ ν A.card),
      0 < A.card / sliceBlockSize μ A.card ∧
      ∀ T ∈ F, ∀ j, |((T ∩ cert.block j).card : ℝ) / sliceBlockSize μ A.card
          - ((A ∩ T).card : ℝ) / A.card| ≤ ν

name: RegularityLemmata.slice_sampling_race
statement:
theorem slice_sampling_race (hμ : 0 < μ) (hν : 0 < ν) (hν2 : ν ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hn : sliceThreshold q μ ν ≤ n) (hc : c ≤ n) :
    (c / sliceBlockSize μ n) * (2 * (q * ⌈1 / ν⌉₊))
        * (2 * sliceBlockSize μ n - sliceSlack μ ν n) ^ (sliceSlack μ ν n / 8)
      < (2 * sliceBlockSize μ n) ^ (sliceSlack μ ν n / 8)

    (c / sliceBlockSize μ n) * (2 * (q * ⌈1 / ν⌉₊))
        * (2 * sliceBlockSize μ n - sliceSlack μ ν n) ^ (sliceSlack μ ν n / 8)
      < (2 * sliceBlockSize μ n) ^ (sliceSlack μ ν n / 8)

statement:
theorem BinaryPaletteStrongWitness.deviant_mass_le {M : FiniteRelModel L V}
    {E : ErrorSchedule} {P₀ : Finpartition s}
    (w : BinaryPaletteStrongWitness M E δ P₀) (c : BinaryPairPalette L)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∑ pd ∈ w.coarse.parts ×ˢ w.coarse.parts,
      ∑ p ∈ ((w.fine.parts.filter (· ⊆ pd.1)) ×ˢ
          (w.fine.parts.filter (· ⊆ pd.2))).filter
          (fun p => η < |pairDensity (HasBinaryPairPalette M c) p.1 p.2
            - pairDensity (HasBinaryPairPalette M c) pd.1 pd.2|),
        ((p.1.card : ℝ) * p.2.card)
      ≤ δ / η ^ 2 * (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2

name: RegularityLemmata.BinaryPaletteStrongWitness.fine_profile
RegularityLemmata.binaryPalette_strong_iterate
statement:
theorem binaryPalette_strong_iterate (M : FiniteRelModel L V) (E : ErrorSchedule)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∀ (t : ℕ) (P : Finpartition s), 1 - (t : ℝ) * δ ≤ binaryPaletteEnergy M P →
      ∃ coarse fine : Finpartition s, coarse ≤ P ∧ fine ≤ coarse ∧
        IsBinaryPaletteRegular M (E coarse.parts.card) fine ∧
        binaryPaletteEnergy M fine ≤ binaryPaletteEnergy M coarse + δ ∧
        coarse.parts.card ≤ (monoStepBound E)^[t] P.parts.card ∧
        fine.parts.card ≤ (monoStepBound E)^[t + 1] P.parts.card

name: RegularityLemmata.energy_le_of_binaryPaletteEnergy_gap

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_binaryPalettePathDensity_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_binaryPalettePathDensity_sub_le (M : FiniteRelModel L V)
    (c₀₁ c₁₂ : BinaryPairPalette L) {A B C : Finset V} {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (h01 : IsUniformPair (HasBinaryPairPalette M c₀₁) A B ε)
    (h12 : IsUniformPair (HasBinaryPairPalette M c₁₂) B C ε) :
    |directedPathDensity (HasBinaryPairPalette M c₀₁) (HasBinaryPairPalette M c₁₂) A B C
        - pairDensity (HasBinaryPairPalette M c₀₁) A B
            * pairDensity (HasBinaryPairPalette M c₁₂) B C| ≤ 6 * ε

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_binaryPaletteTriangleCount_sub_le

theorem abs_binaryPaletteTriangleCount_sub_le (M : FiniteRelModel L V)
    (c₀₁ c₀₂ c₁₂ : BinaryPairPalette L) {A B C : Finset V} {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (h01 : IsUniformPair (HasBinaryPairPalette M c₀₁) A B ε)
    (h02 : IsUniformPair (HasBinaryPairPalette M c₀₂) A C ε)
    (h12 : IsUniformPair (HasBinaryPairPalette M c₁₂) B C ε) :
    |(directedTriangleCount (HasBinaryPairPalette M c₀₁) (HasBinaryPairPalette M c₀₂)
          (HasBinaryPairPalette M c₁₂) A B C : ℝ)
        - pairDensity (HasBinaryPairPalette M c₀₁) A B
            * pairDensity (HasBinaryPairPalette M c₀₂) A C
            * pairDensity (HasBinaryPairPalette M c₁₂) B C
            * A.card * B.card * C.card|
      ≤ 7 * ε * A.card * B.card * C.card

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_inducedEmbeddingCountOn_three_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_inducedEmbeddingCountOn_three_sub_le [AtMostBinary L]
    {P : FiniteRelModel L (Fin 3)} {M : FiniteRelModel L V} {A B C : Finset V} {ε : ℝ}
    (hnull : NullaryCompatible P M)
    (hA : ∀ v ∈ A, binaryVertexProfile M v = binaryVertexProfile P 0)
    (hB : ∀ v ∈ B, binaryVertexProfile M v = binaryVertexProfile P 1)
    (hC : ∀ v ∈ C, binaryVertexProfile M v = binaryVertexProfile P 2)
    (hAB : Disjoint A B) (hAC : Disjoint A C) (hBC : Disjoint B C)
    (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (h01 : IsUniformPair (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 0 1)) A B ε)
    (h02 : IsUniformPair (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 0 2)) A C ε)
    (h12 : IsUniformPair (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 1 2)) B C ε) :
    |(inducedEmbeddingCountOn P M ![A, B, C] : ℝ)
        - pairDensity (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 0 1)) A B
            * pairDensity (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 0 2)) A C
            * pairDensity (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 1 2)) B C
            * A.card * B.card * C.card|
      ≤ 7 * ε * A.card * B.card * C.card

name: RegularityLemmata.inducedEmbeddingCountOn_three
statement:
theorem inducedEmbeddingCountOn_three [AtMostBinary L]
    {P : FiniteRelModel L (Fin 3)} {M : FiniteRelModel L V} {A B C : Finset V}
    (hnull : NullaryCompatible P M)
    (hA : ∀ v ∈ A, binaryVertexProfile M v = binaryVertexProfile P 0)
    (hB : ∀ v ∈ B, binaryVertexProfile M v = binaryVertexProfile P 1)
    (hC : ∀ v ∈ C, binaryVertexProfile M v = binaryVertexProfile P 2)
    (hAB : Disjoint A B) (hAC : Disjoint A C) (hBC : Disjoint B C) :
    inducedEmbeddingCountOn P M ![A, B, C]
      = directedTriangleCount
          (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 0 1))
          (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 0 2))
          (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 1 2)) A B C

name: RegularityLemmata.inducedEmbeddingCountOn_three_eq_injectiveTriangleCount

name: RegularityLemmata.preservesAndReflects_three_iff
statement:
theorem preservesAndReflects_three_iff [AtMostBinary L]
    {P : FiniteRelModel L (Fin 3)} {M : FiniteRelModel L V}
    (hnull : NullaryCompatible P M) {f : Fin 3 → V}
    (h0 : binaryVertexProfile M (f 0) = binaryVertexProfile P 0)
    (h1 : binaryVertexProfile M (f 1) = binaryVertexProfile P 1)

      ≤ (10 * E w.coarse.parts.card + 3 * η + 3 * (δ / η ^ 2)) * (s.card : ℝ) ^ 3
        + 3 * ((s.card / P₀.parts.card + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_inducedEmbeddingCountOn_div_sub_quotientInducedCount_div_le
statement:

        - (quotientInducedCount P N Q : ℝ) / (s.card.descFactorial k : ℝ)|
      ≤ ((∑ R : RelSymbol L,
          (k : ℝ) ^ (R.1 : ℕ) * editDistance (M.Holds R.2) (N.Holds R.2) (fun _ => s))

statement:

    (M : FiniteRelModel L V) (est : (Fin k → Finset V) → ℝ) (D : Finset (Finset V × Finset V))
    {δ β : ℝ} {m : ℕ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hlocal : ∀ T ∈ transversalCellTuples Q, T ∉ badCellTuples Q D →
      |(inducedEmbeddingCountOn P M T : ℝ) - est T| ≤ δ * cellTupleVolume T)
    (hest : ∀ T ∈ transversalCellTuples Q, 0 ≤ est T ∧ est T ≤ cellTupleVolume T)
    (hmass : ∑ p ∈ D, ((p.1.card : ℝ) * p.2.card) ≤ β * (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (hm : ∀ C ∈ Q.parts, C.card ≤ m) :
    |(inducedEmbeddingCountOn P M (fun _ : Fin k => s) : ℝ) / (s.card.descFactorial k : ℝ)
        - (∑ T ∈ transversalCellTuples Q, est T) / (s.card.descFactorial k : ℝ)|
      ≤ ((δ + (k.choose 2) * β) * (s.card : ℝ) ^ k
          + (k.choose 2) * m * (s.card : ℝ) ^ (k - 1)) / (s.card.descFactorial k : ℝ)

    (hlocal : ∀ T ∈ transversalCellTuples Q, T ∉ badCellTuples Q D →
      |(inducedEmbeddingCountOn P N T : ℝ) - est T| ≤ δ * cellTupleVolume T)
    (hest : ∀ T ∈ transversalCellTuples Q, 0 ≤ est T ∧ est T ≤ cellTupleVolume T)
    (hmass : ∑ p ∈ D, ((p.1.card : ℝ) * p.2.card) ≤ β * (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (hm : ∀ C ∈ Q.parts, C.card ≤ m) :
    |(inducedEmbeddingCountOn P M (fun _ : Fin k => s) : ℝ) / (s.card.descFactorial k : ℝ)
        - (∑ T ∈ transversalCellTuples Q, est T) / (s.card.descFactorial k : ℝ)|
      ≤ ((∑ R : RelSymbol L,
          (k : ℝ) ^ (R.1 : ℕ) * editDistance (M.Holds R.2) (N.Holds R.2) (fun _ => s))
          * (s.card : ℝ) ^ (k - 1)
        + ((δ + (k.choose 2) * β) * (s.card : ℝ) ^ k
          + (k.choose 2) * m * (s.card : ℝ) ^ (k - 1))) / (s.card.descFactorial k : ℝ)

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_inducedEmbeddingCountOn_sub_coarseInducedEstimate_le
statement:
theorem abs_inducedEmbeddingCountOn_sub_coarseInducedEstimate_le [AtMostBinary L]
    {P : FiniteRelModel L (Fin 3)} {M : FiniteRelModel L V}
    (hQ : Q ≤ binaryProfilePartition M s) (hnull : NullaryCompatible P M)
    {D : Finset (Finset V × Finset V)} {ε β : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hmass : ∑ p ∈ D, ((p.1.card : ℝ) * p.2.card) ≤ β * (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (hD01 : ∀ A ∈ Q.parts, ∀ B ∈ Q.parts,
      ¬ IsUniformPair (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 0 1)) A B ε → (A, B) ∈ D)
    (hD02 : ∀ A ∈ Q.parts, ∀ B ∈ Q.parts,
      ¬ IsUniformPair (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 0 2)) A B ε → (A, B) ∈ D)
    (hD12 : ∀ A ∈ Q.parts, ∀ B ∈ Q.parts,
      ¬ IsUniformPair (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 1 2)) A B ε → (A, B) ∈ D)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : ∀ C ∈ Q.parts, C.card ≤ m) :
    |(inducedEmbeddingCountOn P M (fun _ : Fin 3 => s) : ℝ) - coarseInducedEstimate P M Q|

statement:

    {m : ℕ} (hm : ∀ C ∈ Q.parts, C.card ≤ m) :
    |(inducedEmbeddingCountOn P M (fun _ : Fin k => s) : ℝ) - quotientInducedCount P N Q|
      ≤ (∑ R ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (RelSymbol L)).filter (fun R => 0 < (R.1 : ℕ)),
          (k : ℝ) ^ (R.1 : ℕ) * (ε * (s.card : ℝ) ^ (R.1 : ℕ)))
          * (s.card : ℝ) ^ (k - 1)
        + (k.choose 2) * m * (s.card : ℝ) ^ (k - 1)

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_inducedEmbeddingCountOn_sub_quotientInducedCount_majorityRound_le
statement:
theorem abs_inducedEmbeddingCountOn_sub_quotientInducedCount_majorityRound_le
    (P : FiniteRelModel L (Fin k)) (M : FiniteRelModel L V) (Q : Finpartition s) {ε : ℝ}
    (hhom : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (S : L.Relations n) (C : Fin n → Q.parts),
      IsHomogeneousCell (M.Holds S) (fun i ↦ (C i : Finset V)) ε)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : ∀ C ∈ Q.parts, C.card ≤ m) :
    |(inducedEmbeddingCountOn P M (fun _ : Fin k => s) : ℝ)
        - quotientInducedCount P (M.majorityRound Q) Q|
      ≤ (∑ R ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (RelSymbol L)).filter (fun R => 0 < (R.1 : ℕ)),
          (k : ℝ) ^ (R.1 : ℕ) * (ε * (s.card : ℝ) ^ (R.1 : ℕ)))
          * (s.card : ℝ) ^ (k - 1)
        + (k.choose 2) * m * (s.card : ℝ) ^ (k - 1)

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_inducedEmbeddingCountOn_sub_sum_est_le
statement:
theorem abs_inducedEmbeddingCountOn_sub_sum_est_le (P : FiniteRelModel L (Fin k))
    (M : FiniteRelModel L V) (est : (Fin k → Finset V) → ℝ) (D : Finset (Finset V × Finset V))
    {δ β : ℝ} {m : ℕ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hlocal : ∀ T ∈ transversalCellTuples Q, T ∉ badCellTuples Q D →
      |(inducedEmbeddingCountOn P M T : ℝ) - est T| ≤ δ * cellTupleVolume T)
    (hest : ∀ T ∈ transversalCellTuples Q, 0 ≤ est T ∧ est T ≤ cellTupleVolume T)
    (hmass : ∑ p ∈ D, ((p.1.card : ℝ) * p.2.card) ≤ β * (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (hm : ∀ C ∈ Q.parts, C.card ≤ m) :
    |(inducedEmbeddingCountOn P M (fun _ : Fin k => s) : ℝ)
        - ∑ T ∈ transversalCellTuples Q, est T|
      ≤ (δ + (k.choose 2) * β) * (s.card : ℝ) ^ k
        + (k.choose 2) * m * (s.card : ℝ) ^ (k - 1)

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_inducedEmbeddingCountOn_sub_sum_est_le_of_editMass
statement:
theorem abs_inducedEmbeddingCountOn_sub_sum_est_le_of_editMass (P : FiniteRelModel L (Fin k))
    {M N : FiniteRelModel L V} (hnull : NullaryCompatible M N)
    (est : (Fin k → Finset V) → ℝ) (D : Finset (Finset V × Finset V))
    {δ β : ℝ} {m : ℕ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hlocal : ∀ T ∈ transversalCellTuples Q, T ∉ badCellTuples Q D →
      |(inducedEmbeddingCountOn P N T : ℝ) - est T| ≤ δ * cellTupleVolume T)
    (hest : ∀ T ∈ transversalCellTuples Q, 0 ≤ est T ∧ est T ≤ cellTupleVolume T)
    (hmass : ∑ p ∈ D, ((p.1.card : ℝ) * p.2.card) ≤ β * (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (hm : ∀ C ∈ Q.parts, C.card ≤ m) :
    |(inducedEmbeddingCountOn P M (fun _ : Fin k => s) : ℝ)
        - ∑ T ∈ transversalCellTuples Q, est T|
      ≤ (∑ R : RelSymbol L,
          (k : ℝ) ^ (R.1 : ℕ) * editDistance (M.Holds R.2) (N.Holds R.2) (fun _ => s))
          * (s.card : ℝ) ^ (k - 1)
        + ((δ + (k.choose 2) * β) * (s.card : ℝ) ^ k
          + (k.choose 2) * m * (s.card : ℝ) ^ (k - 1))

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_sum_transversalCellTuples_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_sum_transversalCellTuples_sub_le (count est : (Fin k → Finset V) → ℝ)
    (D : Finset (Finset V × Finset V)) {δ β : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hlocal : ∀ T ∈ transversalCellTuples Q, T ∉ badCellTuples Q D →
      |count T - est T| ≤ δ * cellTupleVolume T)
    (hcrude : ∀ T ∈ transversalCellTuples Q, |count T - est T| ≤ cellTupleVolume T)
    (hmass : ∑ p ∈ D, ((p.1.card : ℝ) * p.2.card) ≤ β * (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2) :
    |∑ T ∈ transversalCellTuples Q, count T - ∑ T ∈ transversalCellTuples Q, est T|
      ≤ (δ + (k.choose 2) * β) * (s.card : ℝ) ^ k

name: RegularityLemmata.IsBinaryPaletteDiagRegular.isBinaryPaletteRegular
RegularityLemmata.IsBinaryPaletteDiagRegular.mono
RegularityLemmata.binaryPaletteDiagRegularity_iterate
statement:
theorem binaryPaletteDiagRegularity_iterate (M : FiniteRelModel L V) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ (t : ℕ) (P : Finpartition s),
      1 - (t : ℝ) * ε ^ 5 ≤ binaryPaletteEnergy M P →
      ∃ Q : Finpartition s, Q ≤ P ∧ IsBinaryPaletteDiagRegular M ε Q ∧
        Q.parts.card ≤ regularityBound t P.parts.card

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_bad_of_not_isBinaryPaletteDiagRegular
RegularityLemmata.exists_binaryPaletteDiagRegular_refinement
statement:
theorem exists_binaryPaletteDiagRegular_refinement (M : FiniteRelModel L V)
    (P : Finpartition s) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ Q : Finpartition s, Q ≤ P ∧ Q ≤ binaryProfilePartition M s ∧
      IsBinaryPaletteDiagRegular M ε Q ∧
      Q.parts.card ≤ binaryRegularityBound L ε P.parts.card

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_binaryPaletteDiagRegular_refinement_of_profiled
statement:
theorem exists_binaryPaletteDiagRegular_refinement_of_profiled (M : FiniteRelModel L V)
    (P : Finpartition s) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ Q : Finpartition s, Q ≤ P ∧ IsBinaryPaletteDiagRegular M ε Q ∧
      Q.parts.card ≤ regularityBound ⌈1 / ε ^ 5⌉₊ P.parts.card

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_binaryPaletteDiag_refinement_energy_increment
statement:
theorem exists_binaryPaletteDiag_refinement_energy_increment (M : FiniteRelModel L V)
    {P : Finpartition s} (hε : 0 < ε) (hbad : ¬IsBinaryPaletteDiagRegular M ε P) :
    ∃ Q : Finpartition s, Q ≤ P
      ∧ binaryPaletteEnergy M P + ε ^ 5 ≤ binaryPaletteEnergy M Q
      ∧ Q.parts.card ≤ P.parts.card * 2 ^ (2 * P.parts.card)

name: RegularityLemmata.isBinaryPaletteDiagRegular_one
statement:
theorem isBinaryPaletteDiagRegular_one (M : FiniteRelModel L V) (P : Finpartition s) :
    IsBinaryPaletteDiagRegular M 1 P

name: RegularityLemmata.BinaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness.deviant_mass_le
statement:
theorem deviant_mass_le (w : BinaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness M E δ P₀)
    (c : BinaryPairPalette L) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∑ pd ∈ w.coarse.parts ×ˢ w.coarse.parts,
      ∑ p ∈ ((w.fine.parts.filter (· ⊆ pd.1)) ×ˢ
          (w.fine.parts.filter (· ⊆ pd.2))).filter
          (fun p => η < |pairDensity (HasBinaryPairPalette M c) p.1 p.2
            - pairDensity (HasBinaryPairPalette M c) pd.1 pd.2|),
        ((p.1.card : ℝ) * p.2.card)
      ≤ δ / η ^ 2 * (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2

name: RegularityLemmata.BinaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness.fine_profile
statement:
theorem fine_profile (w : BinaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness M E δ P₀) :
    w.fine ≤ binaryProfilePartition M s

name: RegularityLemmata.BinaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness.fine_regular
statement:
theorem fine_regular (w : BinaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness M E δ P₀) :
    IsBinaryPaletteRegular M (E w.coarse.parts.card) w.fine

name: RegularityLemmata.BinaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness.toBinaryPaletteStrongWitness_coarse
statement:
@[simp] theorem toBinaryPaletteStrongWitness_coarse
    (w : BinaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness M E δ P₀) :
    w.toBinaryPaletteStrongWitness.coarse = w.coarse

name: RegularityLemmata.BinaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness.toBinaryPaletteStrongWitness_fine
statement:
@[simp] theorem toBinaryPaletteStrongWitness_fine
    (w : BinaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness M E δ P₀) :
    w.toBinaryPaletteStrongWitness.fine = w.fine

name: RegularityLemmata.binaryPaletteDiag_strong_iterate
statement:
theorem binaryPaletteDiag_strong_iterate (M : FiniteRelModel L V) (E : ErrorSchedule)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∀ (t : ℕ) (P : Finpartition s), 1 - (t : ℝ) * δ ≤ binaryPaletteEnergy M P →
      ∃ coarse fine : Finpartition s, coarse ≤ P ∧ fine ≤ coarse ∧
        IsBinaryPaletteDiagRegular M (E coarse.parts.card) fine ∧
        binaryPaletteEnergy M fine ≤ binaryPaletteEnergy M coarse + δ ∧
        coarse.parts.card ≤ (monoStepBound E)^[t] P.parts.card ∧
        fine.parts.card ≤ (monoStepBound E)^[t + 1] P.parts.card

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_binaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness
statement:
theorem exists_binaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness (M : FiniteRelModel L V)
    (E : ErrorSchedule) (hδ : 0 < δ) (P₀ : Finpartition s) :
    ∃ w : BinaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness M E δ P₀,
      w.coarse.parts.card
        ≤ (monoStepBound E)^[⌈1 / δ⌉₊] (refineByBinaryProfile M P₀).parts.card ∧
      w.fine.parts.card
        ≤ (monoStepBound E)^[⌈1 / δ⌉₊ + 1] (refineByBinaryProfile M P₀).parts.card

name: RegularityLemmata.coordDisagreement_eq_sum_box
statement:
theorem coordDisagreement_eq_sum_box (A : Fin (n + 1) → Finset V) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordDisagreement R A j
      = ∑ w ∈ Fintype.piFinset A,
          ((A j).filter fun a ↦ ¬ (R w ↔ R (Function.update w j a))).card

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_majorityRound_eq_minorityCount
statement:
theorem editDistance_majorityRound_eq_minorityCount (M : FiniteRelModel L V) (P : Finpartition s)
    {m : ℕ} (S : L.Relations m) (C : Fin m → Finset V) (hC : ∀ i, C i ∈ P.parts) :
    editDistance (M.Holds S) ((M.majorityRound P).Holds S) C = minorityCount (M.Holds S) C

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_majorityRound_labelPartition_le
statement:
theorem editDistance_majorityRound_labelPartition_le [Fintype Λ] {L : FirstOrder.Language}
    [FiniteRelational L] (M : FiniteRelModel L V) {n : ℕ} (S : L.Relations (n + 1)) :
    (editDistance (M.Holds S) ((M.majorityRound (labelPartition lab s)).Holds S)
        (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ s) : ℝ)
      ≤ ∑ j : Fin (n + 1), ∑ c : Fin (n + 1) → Λ,
          ∑ w ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun i ↦ labelFiber lab s (c i)),
            (((labelFiber lab s (c j)).filter
                fun a ↦ ¬ (M.Holds S w ↔ M.Holds S (Function.update w j a))).card : ℝ)
              / (labelFiber lab s (c j)).card

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_majorityRound_le
statement:
theorem editDistance_majorityRound_le (M : FiniteRelModel L V) (P : Finpartition s) {n : ℕ}
    (S : L.Relations (n + 1)) {θ γ lam : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (E : Finset (Finset V)) (hE : E ⊆ P.parts) (hlam : (∑ l ∈ E, (l.card : ℝ)) ≤ lam * s.card)
    (hdec : ∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), ∀ l ∈ P.parts, l ∉ E →
      (((Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin n ↦ s)).filter fun rest ↦
          InclusiveMixed θ (densityOn l fun a ↦ M.Holds S (Fin.insertNth j a rest))).card : ℝ)
        ≤ γ * (Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin n ↦ s)).card) :
    (editDistance (M.Holds S) ((M.majorityRound P).Holds S) (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ s) : ℝ)
      ≤ (n + 1) * (s.card : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * (2 * θ + γ / 2 + lam / 2)

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_majorityRound_le_sum_partResampleDefect
statement:
theorem editDistance_majorityRound_le_sum_partResampleDefect (M : FiniteRelModel L V)
    (P : Finpartition s) {n : ℕ} (S : L.Relations (n + 1)) :
    (editDistance (M.Holds S) ((M.majorityRound P).Holds S) (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ s) : ℝ)
      ≤ ∑ j : Fin (n + 1), ∑ w ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ s),
          partResampleDefect (M.Holds S) P j w

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_majorityRound_nullary
statement:
theorem editDistance_majorityRound_nullary (M : FiniteRelModel L V) (P : Finpartition s)
    (S : L.Relations 0) :
    editDistance (M.Holds S) ((M.majorityRound P).Holds S) (fun _ : Fin 0 ↦ s) = 0

name: RegularityLemmata.labelFiber_eq_empty_iff
statement: theorem labelFiber_eq_empty_iff (a : Λ) : labelFiber lab s a = ∅ ↔ ∀ v ∈ s, lab v ≠ a

name: RegularityLemmata.labelPartition_part_eq
statement:
theorem labelPartition_part_eq {b : V} (hb : b ∈ s) :
    (labelPartition lab s).part b = labelFiber lab s (lab b)

name: RegularityLemmata.labelPartition_parts
statement:
theorem labelPartition_parts :
    (labelPartition lab s).parts = (s.image lab).image (labelFiber lab s)

name: RegularityLemmata.partResampleDefect_labelPartition
statement:
theorem partResampleDefect_labelPartition {n : ℕ} (R : (Fin (n + 1) → V) → Prop)
    [DecidablePred R] (j : Fin (n + 1)) {w : Fin (n + 1) → V} (hw : w j ∈ s) :
    partResampleDefect R (labelPartition lab s) j w
      = (((labelFiber lab s (lab (w j))).filter
            fun a ↦ ¬ (R w ↔ R (Function.update w j a))).card : ℝ)
          / (labelFiber lab s (lab (w j))).card

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_const_eq_sum_cellBoxes
statement:
theorem sum_const_eq_sum_cellBoxes {m : ℕ} (P : Finpartition s) (f : (Fin m → V) → ℝ) :
    ∑ w ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin m ↦ s), f w
      = ∑ C ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin m ↦ P.parts), ∑ w ∈ Fintype.piFinset C, f w

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_coordDisagreement_div_eq_sum_partResampleDefect
statement:
theorem sum_coordDisagreement_div_eq_sum_partResampleDefect :
    ∑ C ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ P.parts),
        ∑ j : Fin (n + 1), (coordDisagreement R C j : ℝ) / (C j).card
      = ∑ j : Fin (n + 1), ∑ w ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ s),
          partResampleDefect R P j w

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_partResampleDefect_le
statement:
theorem sum_partResampleDefect_le (j : Fin (n + 1)) {θ γ lam : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (E : Finset (Finset V)) (hE : E ⊆ P.parts) (hlam : (∑ l ∈ E, (l.card : ℝ)) ≤ lam * s.card)
    (hdec : ∀ l ∈ P.parts, l ∉ E →
      (((Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin n ↦ s)).filter fun rest ↦
          InclusiveMixed θ (densityOn l fun a ↦ R (Fin.insertNth j a rest))).card : ℝ)
        ≤ γ * (Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin n ↦ s)).card) :
    ∑ w ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ s), partResampleDefect R P j w
      ≤ (s.card : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * (2 * θ + γ / 2 + lam / 2)

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_partResampleDefect_row
statement:
theorem sum_partResampleDefect_row (j : Fin (n + 1)) (rest : Fin n → V) {l : Finset V}
    (hl : l ∈ P.parts) :
    ∑ b ∈ l, partResampleDefect R P j (Fin.insertNth j b rest)
      = (sectionDisagreement l fun a ↦ R (Fin.insertNth j a rest) : ℝ) / l.card

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_piFinset_const_eq_sum_labelBoxes
statement:
theorem sum_piFinset_const_eq_sum_labelBoxes [Fintype Λ] {m : ℕ} {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (f : (Fin m → V) → M) :
    ∑ w ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin m ↦ s), f w
      = ∑ c : Fin m → Λ, ∑ w ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun i ↦ labelFiber lab s (c i)), f w

name: RegularityLemmata.editDistance_majorityRound_coordinateJoin_le
statement:
theorem editDistance_majorityRound_coordinateJoin_le (M : FiniteRelModel L V) {n : ℕ}
    (P : Fin (n + 1) → Finpartition s) (S : L.Relations (n + 1)) :
    (editDistance (M.Holds S) ((M.majorityRound (coordinateJoin P)).Holds S)
        (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ s) : ℝ)
      ≤ ∑ j : Fin (n + 1), familyDefect (P j) (Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin n ↦ s))
          fun rest a ↦ M.Holds S (Fin.insertNth j a rest)

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_isIndivisibleFor_coordinateJoin
statement:
theorem exists_isIndivisibleFor_coordinateJoin (M : FiniteRelModel L V) {n : ℕ}
    (P : Fin (n + 1) → Finpartition s) (S : L.Relations (n + 1)) :
    ∃ N : FiniteRelModel L V, N.IsIndivisibleFor (coordinateJoin P) ∧ NullaryCompatible M N ∧
      (coordinateJoin P).parts.card ≤ ∏ j, (P j).parts.card ∧
      (editDistance (M.Holds S) (N.Holds S) (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ s) : ℝ)
        ≤ ∑ j : Fin (n + 1), familyDefect (P j) (Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin n ↦ s))
            fun rest a ↦ M.Holds S (Fin.insertNth j a rest)

name: RegularityLemmata.partitionDefect_labelPartition
statement:
theorem partitionDefect_labelPartition [Fintype Λ] (p : V → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    partitionDefect (labelPartition lab s) p
      = ∑ a : Λ, (sectionDisagreement (labelFiber lab s a) p : ℝ) / (labelFiber lab s a).card

name: RegularityLemmata.sum_partResampleDefect_eq_familyDefect
statement:
theorem sum_partResampleDefect_eq_familyDefect {n : ℕ} (R : (Fin (n + 1) → V) → Prop)
    [DecidablePred R] (P : Finpartition s) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ∑ w ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ s), partResampleDefect R P j w
      = familyDefect P (Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin n ↦ s))
          fun rest a ↦ R (Fin.insertNth j a rest)

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_filter_card_sub_le_of_atom_cover
statement:
theorem abs_filter_card_sub_le_of_atom_cover (s : Finset V)
    (A B : (Fin k → V) → Prop) [DecidablePred A] [DecidablePred B]
    (E : (S : RelSymbol L) → Finset (Fin (S.1 : ℕ) → V)) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hE : ∀ S, 0 < (S.1 : ℕ) → ((E S).card : ℝ) ≤ ε * (s.card : ℝ) ^ (S.1 : ℕ))
    (hcover : ∀ f ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin k ↦ s), ¬ (A f ↔ B f) →
      ∃ z : PatternAtom L k, 0 < (z.1.1 : ℕ) ∧ Function.Injective z.2 ∧
        f ∘ z.2 ∈ E z.1) :
    |(((Fintype.piFinset fun _ : Fin k ↦ s).filter A).card : ℝ) -
      ((Fintype.piFinset fun _ : Fin k ↦ s).filter B).card| ≤
        patternAtomCoefficient L k * ε * (s.card : ℝ) ^ k

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_homCountOn_sub_le_of_cellwise_simple
statement:
theorem abs_homCountOn_sub_le_of_cellwise_simple
    (P : FiniteRelModel L (Fin k)) (M N : FiniteRelModel L V) (s : Finset V)
    (Q : Finpartition s) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hnull : NullaryCompatible M N)
    (hP : SimplePattern P) (hcell : CellwiseEditBound M N Q ε) :
    |(homCountOn P M s : ℝ) - homCountOn P N s| ≤
      patternAtomCoefficient L k * ε * (s.card : ℝ) ^ k +
        (k.choose 2 : ℝ) * s.card ^ (k - 1)

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_homCountOn_sub_le_of_simple
statement:
theorem abs_homCountOn_sub_le_of_simple
    (P : FiniteRelModel L (Fin k)) (M N : FiniteRelModel L V) (s : Finset V)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hnull : NullaryCompatible M N) (hP : SimplePattern P)
    (hedit : ∀ S : RelSymbol L, 0 < (S.1 : ℕ) →
      (editDistance (M.Holds S.2) (N.Holds S.2) (fun _ ↦ s) : ℝ) ≤
        ε * (s.card : ℝ) ^ (S.1 : ℕ)) :
    |(homCountOn P M s : ℝ) - homCountOn P N s| ≤
      patternAtomCoefficient L k * ε * (s.card : ℝ) ^ k +
        (k.choose 2 : ℝ) * s.card ^ (k - 1)

name: RegularityLemmata.abs_inducedEmbeddingCountOn_sub_le_of_cellwise_diagonalAgreement
statement:
theorem abs_inducedEmbeddingCountOn_sub_le_of_cellwise_diagonalAgreement
    (P : FiniteRelModel L (Fin k)) (M N : FiniteRelModel L V) (s : Finset V)
    (Q : Finpartition s) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hnull : NullaryCompatible M N)
    (hdiag : DiagonalAgreementOn M N s) (hcell : CellwiseEditBound M N Q ε) :

statement:
theorem exists_equitable_isIndivisibleFor (M : FiniteRelModel L V) (P : Finpartition s)
    {t₀ : Finset V} (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ P.parts) {t : ℕ} (ht : 0 < t) (hts : t ≤ s.card) :
    ∃ (Q : Finpartition s) (N : FiniteRelModel L V), Q.IsEquipartition ∧ Q.parts.card = t ∧
      N.IsIndivisibleFor Q ∧ NullaryCompatible M N ∧
      ∀ {n : ℕ} (S : L.Relations (n + 1)) {θ γ lam : ℝ}, 0 ≤ θ → 0 ≤ γ →
        ∀ (E : Finset (Finset V)), E ⊆ P.parts → (∑ l ∈ E, (l.card : ℝ)) ≤ lam * s.card →
        (∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), ∀ l ∈ P.parts, l ∉ E →
          (((Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin n ↦ s)).filter fun rest ↦
              InclusiveMixed θ (densityOn l fun a ↦ M.Holds S (Fin.insertNth j a rest))).card : ℝ)
            ≤ γ * (Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin n ↦ s)).card) →
        (editDistance (M.Holds S) (N.Holds S) (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ s) : ℝ)
          ≤ (n + 1) * (s.card : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * (2 * θ + γ / 2 + lam / 2)
            + (n + 1) * (((P.parts.card - 1) * (s.card / t) : ℕ) : ℝ) * (s.card : ℝ) ^ n

statement:
theorem BinaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness.deviant_pair_mass_le
    {L : FirstOrder.Language} [FiniteRelational L] {M : FiniteRelModel L V}
    {E : ErrorSchedule} {δ : ℝ} {P₀ : Finpartition s}
    (w : BinaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness M E δ P₀) (c : BinaryPairPalette L)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) {pd : Finset V × Finset V}
    (hpd : pd ∈ w.coarse.parts ×ˢ w.coarse.parts) :
    ∑ p ∈ ((w.fine.parts.filter (· ⊆ pd.1)) ×ˢ (w.fine.parts.filter (· ⊆ pd.2))).filter
        (fun p => η < |pairDensity (HasBinaryPairPalette M c) p.1 p.2
          - pairDensity (HasBinaryPairPalette M c) pd.1 pd.2|),
      ((p.1.card : ℝ) * p.2.card)
      ≤ δ / η ^ 2 * (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2

name: RegularityLemmata.BinaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness.exists_representatives
statement:
theorem BinaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness.exists_representatives
    (w : BinaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness M E δ P₀) {q : ℕ}
    (hq : w.fine.parts.card ≤ q) {α η : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hη : 0 < η)
    (harith : 24 * (w.coarse.parts.card : ℝ) ^ 2
        * (Fintype.card (BinaryPairPalette L) : ℝ)
        * (E w.coarse.parts.card + δ / η ^ 2) < α ^ 2) :
    ∃ rep : Finset V → Fin 3 → Finset V,
      (∀ C ∈ largeParts w.coarse α, ∀ i : Fin 3,
        rep C i ∈ w.fine.parts ∧ rep C i ⊆ C ∧ C.card ≤ 2 * q * (rep C i).card) ∧
      ∀ C ∈ largeParts w.coarse α, ∀ D ∈ largeParts w.coarse α,
        ∀ i j : Fin 3, i ≠ j → ∀ c : BinaryPairPalette L,
          IsUniformPair (HasBinaryPairPalette M c) (rep C i) (rep D j)
            (E w.coarse.parts.card) ∧
          |pairDensity (HasBinaryPairPalette M c) (rep C i) (rep D j)
            - pairDensity (HasBinaryPairPalette M c) C D| ≤ η

          ((p.1.card : ℝ) * p.2.card)

    (hW : ∀ C : ProxyIndex Q, w₀ ≤ proxyCandidateWeight (Q := Q) F q C) :
    ∑ e : ProxyEvent Q,
        ∑ p ∈ nonuniformFinePairs R ε F ∩ (proxyCandidates (Q := Q) F q (proxyEventFst e) ×ˢ
            proxyCandidates (Q := Q) F q (proxyEventSnd e)),
          (p.1.card : ℝ) * p.2.card
          * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (proxyEventFst e)).erase (proxyEventSnd e),
              proxyCandidateWeight (Q := Q) F q j

        ∑ p ∈ paletteNonuniformFinePairs M ε F ∩
            (proxyCandidates (Q := Q) F q (proxyEventFst e) ×ˢ
              proxyCandidates (Q := Q) F q (proxyEventSnd e)),
          (p.1.card : ℝ) * p.2.card
          * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (proxyEventFst e)).erase (proxyEventSnd e),
              proxyCandidateWeight (Q := Q) F q j

    (hQ : Q ≤ binaryProfilePartition M s) (hnull : NullaryCompatible P M)
    {g : Finset V → Finset V} (hg : ∀ C ∈ Q.parts, g C ⊆ C)
    {D : Finset (Finset V × Finset V)} (hD : D ⊆ Q.parts ×ˢ Q.parts)
    {ε β : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hmass : ∑ p ∈ D, ((p.1.card : ℝ) * p.2.card) ≤ β * (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (hD01 : ∀ A ∈ Q.parts, ∀ B ∈ Q.parts, A ≠ B →
      ¬ IsUniformPair (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 0 1)) (g A) (g B) ε →
        (A, B) ∈ D)
    (hD02 : ∀ A ∈ Q.parts, ∀ B ∈ Q.parts, A ≠ B →
      ¬ IsUniformPair (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 0 2)) (g A) (g B) ε →
        (A, B) ∈ D)
    (hD12 : ∀ A ∈ Q.parts, ∀ B ∈ Q.parts, A ≠ B →

        (A, B) ∈ D) :

      ≤ (7 * ε + 3 * β) * (s.card : ℝ) ^ 3

    (hD01 : ∀ A ∈ Q.parts, ∀ B ∈ Q.parts,
      ¬ IsUniformPair (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 0 1)) A B ε → (A, B) ∈ D)
    (hD02 : ∀ A ∈ Q.parts, ∀ B ∈ Q.parts,
      ¬ IsUniformPair (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 0 2)) A B ε → (A, B) ∈ D)
    (hD12 : ∀ A ∈ Q.parts, ∀ B ∈ Q.parts,
      ¬ IsUniformPair (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 1 2)) A B ε → (A, B) ∈ D) :
    |(transversalInducedCount P M Q : ℝ) - coarseInducedEstimate P M Q|

statement:
theorem binaryPairPalette_ofSimpleGraph (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (a b : V) :
    binaryPairPalette (ofSimpleGraph G) a b
      = if G.Adj a b then adjPalette else nonadjPalette

name: RegularityLemmata.FiniteRelModel.directedPathCount_adjPalette
statement:
theorem directedPathCount_adjPalette (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (A B C : Finset V) :
    directedPathCount (HasBinaryPairPalette (ofSimpleGraph G) adjPalette)
        (HasBinaryPairPalette (ofSimpleGraph G) adjPalette) A B C

name: RegularityLemmata.FiniteRelModel.directedTriangleCount_adjPalette
statement:
theorem directedTriangleCount_adjPalette (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]

    directedTriangleCount (HasBinaryPairPalette (ofSimpleGraph G) adjPalette)
        (HasBinaryPairPalette (ofSimpleGraph G) adjPalette)
        (HasBinaryPairPalette (ofSimpleGraph G) adjPalette) A B C
      = directedTriangleCount G.Adj G.Adj G.Adj A B C

name: RegularityLemmata.FiniteRelModel.directedTriangleCount_adj_eq_six_mul_cliqueFinset
statement:
theorem directedTriangleCount_adj_eq_six_mul_cliqueFinset [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V)

    directedTriangleCount G.Adj G.Adj G.Adj Finset.univ Finset.univ Finset.univ
      = 6 * (G.cliqueFinset 3).card

statement:
theorem hasBinaryPairPalette_adjPalette_eq (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] :

name: RegularityLemmata.FiniteRelModel.hasBinaryPairPalette_adjPalette_iff
statement:
theorem hasBinaryPairPalette_adjPalette_iff (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (a b : V) :

name: RegularityLemmata.FiniteRelModel.hasBinaryPairPalette_binaryPairPalette_ofSimpleGraph
statement:
theorem hasBinaryPairPalette_binaryPairPalette_ofSimpleGraph {W : Type*} (P : SimpleGraph W)
