    HasBinaryPairPalette (ofSimpleGraph G) (binaryPairPalette (ofSimpleGraph P) i j)
      = if P.Adj i j then G.Adj else fun a b => ¬ G.Adj a b

theorem hasBinaryPairPalette_nonadjPalette_eq (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] :

name: RegularityLemmata.FiniteRelModel.inducedEmbeddingCountOn_three_ofSimpleGraph
statement:
theorem inducedEmbeddingCountOn_three_ofSimpleGraph (P : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)) [DecidableRel P.Adj]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] {A B C : Finset V}
    (hAB : Disjoint A B) (hAC : Disjoint A C) (hBC : Disjoint B C) :
    inducedEmbeddingCountOn (ofSimpleGraph P) (ofSimpleGraph G) ![A, B, C]
      = directedTriangleCount
          (HasBinaryPairPalette (ofSimpleGraph G) (binaryPairPalette (ofSimpleGraph P) 0 1))
          (HasBinaryPairPalette (ofSimpleGraph G) (binaryPairPalette (ofSimpleGraph P) 0 2))
          (HasBinaryPairPalette (ofSimpleGraph G) (binaryPairPalette (ofSimpleGraph P) 1 2))
          A B C

name: RegularityLemmata.FiniteRelModel.inducedEmbeddingCountOn_three_ofSimpleGraph_adj
statement:
theorem inducedEmbeddingCountOn_three_ofSimpleGraph_adj (P : SimpleGraph (Fin 3))
    [DecidableRel P.Adj] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] {A B C : Finset V}
    (hAB : Disjoint A B) (hAC : Disjoint A C) (hBC : Disjoint B C) :
    inducedEmbeddingCountOn (ofSimpleGraph P) (ofSimpleGraph G) ![A, B, C]
      = directedTriangleCount
          (if P.Adj 0 1 then G.Adj else fun a b => ¬ G.Adj a b)
          (if P.Adj 0 2 then G.Adj else fun a b => ¬ G.Adj a b)
          (if P.Adj 1 2 then G.Adj else fun a b => ¬ G.Adj a b) A B C

name: RegularityLemmata.BinaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness.exists_rep_certificate
statement:
theorem BinaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness.exists_rep_certificate [AtMostBinary L]
    (w : BinaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness M E δ P₀) {q : ℕ}
    (hq : w.fine.parts.card ≤ q) {α η : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hη : 0 < η)
    (harith : 24 * (w.coarse.parts.card : ℝ) ^ 2
        * (Fintype.card (BinaryPairPalette L) : ℝ)
        * (E w.coarse.parts.card + δ / η ^ 2) < α ^ 2) :
    ∃ rep : Finset V → Fin 3 → Finset V,
      (∀ C ∈ largeParts w.coarse α, ∀ i : Fin 3,
        rep C i ∈ w.fine.parts ∧ rep C i ⊆ C ∧ C.card ≤ 2 * q * (rep C i).card) ∧
      ∀ (P : FiniteRelModel L (Fin 3)) (T : Fin 3 → Finset V) {θ' : ℝ},
        (∀ i, T i ∈ largeParts w.coarse α) →
        NullaryCompatible P M →
        (∀ i, ∀ v ∈ rep (T i) i,
          binaryVertexProfile M v = binaryVertexProfile P i) →
        θ' ≤ pairDensity
          (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 0 1)) (T 0) (T 1) →
        θ' ≤ pairDensity
          (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 0 2)) (T 0) (T 2) →
        θ' ≤ pairDensity
          (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 1 2)) (T 1) (T 2) →
        η ≤ θ' →
        E w.coarse.parts.card ≤ 1 →
        7 * E w.coarse.parts.card < (θ' - η) ^ 3 →
        6 * q < ((θ' - η) ^ 3 - 7 * E w.coarse.parts.card) * (α * s.card) →
        0 < inducedEmbeddingCountOn P M ![rep (T 0) 0, rep (T 1) 1, rep (T 2) 2]

name: RegularityLemmata.collisionSlack_mul_le
statement:
theorem collisionSlack_mul_le {A₀ A₁ A₂ : Finset α} {q : ℕ} {a n : ℝ}
    (h0 : a * n ≤ 2 * q * A₀.card) (h1 : a * n ≤ 2 * q * A₁.card)
    (han : 0 ≤ a * n) :
    ((A₀ ∩ A₁).card * A₂.card + (A₀ ∩ A₂).card * A₁.card
        + A₀.card * (A₁ ∩ A₂).card : ℝ) * (a * n)
      ≤ 6 * q * ((A₀.card : ℝ) * A₁.card * A₂.card)

name: RegularityLemmata.deviant_condition_forces_gap_lt
statement:
theorem deviant_condition_forces_gap_lt (K : ℕ) {δ η δ' : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η)
    {k : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K) (hk : 0 < k)
    (h : 48 * (k : ℝ) ^ 2 * K * (δ / η ^ 2) < (δ' / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2) :
    δ < η ^ 2 * δ' ^ 2 / (48 * K * (k : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2)

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_selection_schedule
statement:
theorem exists_selection_schedule (K : ℕ) {ρ δ' : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hδ' : 0 < δ') :
    ∃ E : ErrorSchedule, ∀ k : ℕ,
      E k ≤ 1 ∧ 7 * E k < ρ ^ 3 ∧
      48 * (k : ℝ) ^ 2 * K * E k < (δ' / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2

name: RegularityLemmata.exists_viable_constants
statement:
theorem exists_viable_constants (K : ℕ) {θ : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθK : θ ≤ 1 / K) :
    ∃ η τ ρ : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ 0 < τ ∧ τ ≤ 1 ∧ ρ = min θ (1 / K) - η ∧ 0 < ρ ∧
      7 * τ < ρ ^ 3 ∧
      ∀ (q : ℕ) (a n : ℝ), 48 * q < ρ ^ 3 * (a * n) →
        6 * q < (ρ ^ 3 - 7 * τ) * (a * n)

name: RegularityLemmata.globalInducedCount_eq_sum_placementClass
statement:
theorem globalInducedCount_eq_sum_placementClass [AtMostBinary L] [Fintype V]
    {P : FiniteRelModel L (Fin 3)} {M : FiniteRelModel L V} (Q : Finpartition s) :
    ∑ c : PlacementClass,
      ∑ T ∈ (Fintype.piFinset fun _ : Fin 3 => Q.parts).filter
          (fun T => placementClass T = c),
        inducedEmbeddingCountOn P M T
      = globalInducedCount P M Q

name: RegularityLemmata.inducedEmbeddingCountOn_pos_of_representatives
statement:
theorem inducedEmbeddingCountOn_pos_of_representatives [AtMostBinary L]
    {P : FiniteRelModel L (Fin 3)} {M : FiniteRelModel L V} {A₀ A₁ A₂ : Finset V}
    {ρ τ : ℝ} {q : ℕ} {a n : ℝ}
    (hnull : NullaryCompatible P M)
    (hprof0 : ∀ v ∈ A₀, binaryVertexProfile M v = binaryVertexProfile P 0)
    (hprof1 : ∀ v ∈ A₁, binaryVertexProfile M v = binaryVertexProfile P 1)
    (hprof2 : ∀ v ∈ A₂, binaryVertexProfile M v = binaryVertexProfile P 2)
    (hτ0 : 0 ≤ τ) (hτ1 : τ ≤ 1) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (han : 0 < a * n)
    (h01u : IsUniformPair
      (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 0 1)) A₀ A₁ τ)
    (h02u : IsUniformPair
      (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 0 2)) A₀ A₂ τ)
    (h12u : IsUniformPair
      (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 1 2)) A₁ A₂ τ)
    (h01d : ρ ≤ pairDensity
      (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 0 1)) A₀ A₁)
    (h02d : ρ ≤ pairDensity
      (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 0 2)) A₀ A₂)
    (h12d : ρ ≤ pairDensity
      (HasBinaryPairPalette M (binaryPairPalette P 1 2)) A₁ A₂)
    (h0 : a * n ≤ 2 * q * A₀.card) (h1 : a * n ≤ 2 * q * A₁.card)
    (h2 : a * n ≤ 2 * q * A₂.card)
    (hhost : 6 * q < (ρ ^ 3 - 7 * τ) * (a * n)) :
    0 < inducedEmbeddingCountOn P M ![A₀, A₁, A₂]

name: RegularityLemmata.injectiveTriangleCount_ge_of_dense_uniform
statement:
theorem injectiveTriangleCount_ge_of_dense_uniform {A₀ A₁ A₂ : Finset α} {ρ τ : ℝ}
    (hτ0 : 0 ≤ τ) (hτ1 : τ ≤ 1) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (h01u : IsUniformPair R₀₁ A₀ A₁ τ) (h02u : IsUniformPair R₀₂ A₀ A₂ τ)
    (h12u : IsUniformPair R₁₂ A₁ A₂ τ)

    (h12d : ρ ≤ pairDensity R₁₂ A₁ A₂) :
    (ρ ^ 3 - 7 * τ) * (A₀.card * A₁.card * A₂.card)
        - ((A₀ ∩ A₁).card * A₂.card + (A₀ ∩ A₂).card * A₁.card
          + A₀.card * (A₁ ∩ A₂).card)
      ≤ (injectiveTriangleCount R₀₁ R₀₂ R₁₂ A₀ A₁ A₂ : ℝ)

theorem rep_swap_orientation {α η : ℝ}
    {rep : Finset V → Fin 3 → Finset V} {w : BinaryPaletteStrongDiagWitness M E δ P₀}
    (hgood : ∀ C ∈ largeParts w.coarse α, ∀ D ∈ largeParts w.coarse α,

theorem isTransversalizable_iff :
    IsTransversalizable N Q ↔
      ∀ P : FiniteRelModel L (Fin 3),
        (0 < globalInducedCount P N Q ↔ 0 < transversalInducedCount P N Q)

name: RegularityLemmata.isTransversalizable_of_forall_card_le_one
statement:
theorem isTransversalizable_of_forall_card_le_one (N : FiniteRelModel L V)
    (Q : Finpartition s) (hQ : ∀ C ∈ Q.parts, C.card ≤ 1) : IsTransversalizable N Q

name: RegularityLemmata.three_le_card_parts_of_isTransversalizable
statement:
theorem three_le_card_parts_of_isTransversalizable (h : IsTransversalizable N Q)
    (hP : 0 < globalInducedCount P N Q) : 3 ≤ Q.parts.card

name: RegularityLemmata.transversalCellTriples_eq_empty_of_card_lt_three
statement:
theorem transversalCellTriples_eq_empty_of_card_lt_three (Q : Finpartition s)
    (h : Q.parts.card < 3) : transversalCellTriples Q = (∅ : Finset (Fin 3 → Finset V))

name: RegularityLemmata.transversalInducedCount_le_globalInducedCount
statement:
theorem transversalInducedCount_le_globalInducedCount :
    transversalInducedCount P N Q ≤ globalInducedCount P N Q
